
--- FILE: ./install.sh ---
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
SRC_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/LinStack"
OPT_DIR="/opt/linstack"

echo "=== Preparing Build Environment ==="
# Automatically clean stale build / CMakeCache if paths mismatch
if [ -f "$SRC_DIR/build/CMakeCache.txt" ]; then
    cached_src=$(grep "CMAKE_HOME_DIRECTORY:INTERNAL=" "$SRC_DIR/build/CMakeCache.txt" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2 || true)
    if [ -n "$cached_src" ] && [ "$cached_src" != "$SRC_DIR" ]; then
        echo "Stale CMakeCache detected ($cached_src != $SRC_DIR). Cleaning build directory..."
        rm -rf "$SRC_DIR/build"
    fi
fi

echo "=== Building LinStack ==="
cmake -S "$SRC_DIR" -B "$SRC_DIR/build" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build "$SRC_DIR/build" -j"$(nproc)"

echo "=== Installing LinStack to $OPT_DIR (requires sudo) ==="
sudo bash -s "$OPT_DIR" "$SRC_DIR" "$SCRIPT_DIR" << 'EOF'
OPT_DIR="$1"
SRC_DIR="$2"
SCRIPT_DIR="$3"

mkdir -p "$OPT_DIR/bin" "$OPT_DIR/resources" /var/lib/linstack/images \
    /usr/share/dbus-1/system.d /usr/share/dbus-1/system-services /usr/share/polkit-1/actions \
    /usr/share/applications /usr/local/share/applications /usr/share/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps

# 1. Install binary
cp -f "$SRC_DIR/build/LinStack" "$OPT_DIR/bin/LinStack"
chmod 755 "$OPT_DIR/bin/LinStack"

# 2. Install LinStack_core
rm -rf "$OPT_DIR/LinStack_core"
cp -a "$SRC_DIR/LinStack_core" "$OPT_DIR/LinStack_core"
chmod +x "$OPT_DIR/LinStack_core/linstack.py"

# 3. Install LinStack_Scripts
if [ -d "$SCRIPT_DIR/LinStack_Scripts" ]; then
    rm -rf "$OPT_DIR/LinStack_Scripts"
    cp -a "$SCRIPT_DIR/LinStack_Scripts" "$OPT_DIR/LinStack_Scripts"
elif [ -d "$SCRIPT_DIR/waydroid_script" ]; then
    rm -rf "$OPT_DIR/LinStack_Scripts"
    cp -a "$SCRIPT_DIR/waydroid_script" "$OPT_DIR/LinStack_Scripts"
fi

# 4. Resolve symlinks (cp -L) when copying local system.img and vendor.img into /opt/linstack/resources/
if [ -f "$SRC_DIR/resources/system.img" ] && [ ! -f "$OPT_DIR/resources/system.img" ]; then
    echo "Copying local system.img (resolving symlinks) to $OPT_DIR/resources/system.img..."
    cp -L "$SRC_DIR/resources/system.img" "$OPT_DIR/resources/system.img"
fi
if [ -f "$SRC_DIR/resources/vendor.img" ] && [ ! -f "$OPT_DIR/resources/vendor.img" ]; then
    echo "Copying local vendor.img (resolving symlinks) to $OPT_DIR/resources/vendor.img..."
    cp -L "$SRC_DIR/resources/vendor.img" "$OPT_DIR/resources/vendor.img"
fi

# Link into /var/lib/linstack/images for container daemon
if [ -f "$OPT_DIR/resources/system.img" ]; then
    ln -sf "$OPT_DIR/resources/system.img" /var/lib/linstack/images/system.img
fi
if [ -f "$OPT_DIR/resources/vendor.img" ]; then
    ln -sf "$OPT_DIR/resources/vendor.img" /var/lib/linstack/images/vendor.img
fi

# 5. Create system-wide executable symlinks
ln -sf "$OPT_DIR/bin/LinStack" /usr/local/bin/LinStack
ln -sf "$OPT_DIR/LinStack_core/linstack.py" /usr/local/bin/linstack

# 6. Install App Icon and Desktop Launcher
ICON_SRC="$OPT_DIR/LinStack_core/data/AppIcon.png"
if [ -f "$ICON_SRC" ]; then
    cp -f "$ICON_SRC" /usr/share/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps/linstack.png
fi

cat > /usr/share/applications/LinStack.desktop << 'DESKTOP_EOF'
[Desktop Entry]
Name=LinStack
Comment=Linux-native Android Emulator & Container
Exec=/usr/local/bin/LinStack
Icon=linstack
Terminal=false
Type=Application
Categories=Game;System;Emulator;Utility;LinStack;
DESKTOP_EOF

cat > /usr/share/applications/linstack.app.install.desktop << 'APK_DESKTOP_EOF'
[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=Install with LinStack
Comment=Install Android Package (APK) into LinStack
Exec=/usr/local/bin/LinStack --install %f
Icon=linstack
MimeType=application/vnd.android.package-archive;
NoDisplay=true
Terminal=false
APK_DESKTOP_EOF

# 7. Clean up duplicate system desktop entries & disable waydroid-container.service
systemctl disable --now waydroid-container.service 2>/dev/null || true

# Remove leftover lowercase Linstack.desktop
rm -f /usr/share/applications/Linstack.desktop /usr/local/share/applications/Linstack.desktop

# Hide duplicate Waydroid launchers and context-menu entries via /usr/local/share/applications/
for dentry in Waydroid.desktop waydroid.desktop waydroid.install.desktop waydroid.app.install.desktop waydroid.market.desktop waydroid-helper.desktop; do
    cat > "/usr/local/share/applications/$dentry" << 'OVERRIDE_EOF'
[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
NoDisplay=true
Hidden=true
OVERRIDE_EOF
done

if command -v update-desktop-database >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    update-desktop-database /usr/local/share/applications 2>/dev/null || true
    update-desktop-database /usr/share/applications 2>/dev/null || true
fi

# 8. Configure systemd & D-Bus system container service
CORE_DIR="$OPT_DIR/LinStack_core"
sed "s|/usr/bin/linstack|$CORE_DIR/linstack.py|g" "$CORE_DIR/systemd/linstack-container.service" > /etc/systemd/system/linstack-container.service
cp -f "$CORE_DIR/dbus/id.linstack.Container.conf" /usr/share/dbus-1/system.d/
cp -f "$CORE_DIR/dbus/id.linstack.Container.policy" /usr/share/polkit-1/actions/
sed "s|/usr/bin/linstack|$CORE_DIR/linstack.py|g" "$CORE_DIR/dbus/id.linstack.Container.service" > /usr/share/dbus-1/system-services/id.linstack.Container.service

systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl reload dbus.service 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl enable linstack-container.service 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -f "/var/lib/linstack/linstack.cfg" ]; then
    echo "Starting linstack-container.service..."
    systemctl start linstack-container.service 2>/dev/null || true
else
    echo "Notice: Container is not yet initialized (/var/lib/linstack/linstack.cfg not found)."
    echo "The container service will start automatically after first-time initialization via 'LinStack' or 'sudo linstack init'."
fi

# 9. Restore SELinux security contexts if SELinux utilities are available (Fedora/RHEL/CentOS)
if command -v restorecon >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Applying SELinux security contexts..."
    restorecon -Rv "$OPT_DIR" /var/lib/linstack /var/lib/misc /etc/systemd/system/linstack-container.service /usr/share/dbus-1/system* 2>/dev/null || true
fi
if command -v chcon >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    chcon -t bin_t "$OPT_DIR/bin/LinStack" "$OPT_DIR/LinStack_core/linstack.py" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
EOF

# Also install launcher into current user local applications directory
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/share/applications" "$HOME/.local/share/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps"
rm -f "$HOME/.local/share/applications/Linstack.desktop"
if [ -f "/opt/linstack/LinStack_core/data/AppIcon.png" ]; then
    cp -f "/opt/linstack/LinStack_core/data/AppIcon.png" "$HOME/.local/share/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps/linstack.png"
fi
cat > "$HOME/.local/share/applications/LinStack.desktop" << 'EOF'
[Desktop Entry]
Name=LinStack
Comment=Linux-native Android Emulator & Container
Exec=/usr/local/bin/LinStack
Icon=linstack
Terminal=false
Type=Application
Categories=Game;System;Emulator;Utility;LinStack;
EOF

# Generate clean uninstaller
cat > "$SCRIPT_DIR/uninstall.sh" << 'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo "Uninstalling LinStack from /opt/linstack..."
sudo systemctl disable --now linstack-container.service 2>/dev/null || true
sudo rm -f /etc/systemd/system/linstack-container.service
sudo rm -f /usr/share/dbus-1/system.d/id.linstack.Container.conf
sudo rm -f /usr/share/dbus-1/system-services/id.linstack.Container.service
sudo rm -f /usr/share/polkit-1/actions/id.linstack.Container.policy
sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/LinStack /usr/local/bin/linstack
sudo rm -f /usr/share/applications/LinStack.desktop /usr/share/applications/linstack.app.install.desktop /usr/share/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps/linstack.png
sudo rm -f /usr/share/applications/Linstack.desktop /usr/local/share/applications/Linstack.desktop
for dentry in Waydroid.desktop waydroid.desktop waydroid.install.desktop waydroid.app.install.desktop waydroid.market.desktop waydroid-helper.desktop; do
    sudo rm -f "/usr/local/share/applications/$dentry"
done
rm -f "$HOME/.local/share/applications/LinStack.desktop" "$HOME/.local/share/applications/Linstack.desktop" "$HOME/.local/share/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps/linstack.png"
if command -v update-desktop-database >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    sudo update-desktop-database /usr/local/share/applications 2>/dev/null || true
    sudo update-desktop-database /usr/share/applications 2>/dev/null || true
fi
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo rm -rf /opt/linstack
echo "LinStack has been completely removed."
EOF
chmod +x "$SCRIPT_DIR/uninstall.sh"
sudo cp -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/uninstall.sh" "$OPT_DIR/uninstall.sh" 2>/dev/null || true

echo "=== LinStack installation complete! ==="
echo "Launch LinStack from your application menu or run: LinStack"

--- FILE: ./uninstall.sh ---
#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo "Uninstalling LinStack from /opt/linstack..."
sudo systemctl disable --now linstack-container.service 2>/dev/null || true
sudo rm -f /etc/systemd/system/linstack-container.service
sudo rm -f /usr/share/dbus-1/system.d/id.linstack.Container.conf
sudo rm -f /usr/share/dbus-1/system-services/id.linstack.Container.service
sudo rm -f /usr/share/polkit-1/actions/id.linstack.Container.policy
sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/LinStack /usr/local/bin/linstack
sudo rm -f /usr/share/applications/LinStack.desktop /usr/share/applications/linstack.app.install.desktop /usr/share/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps/linstack.png
sudo rm -f /usr/share/applications/Linstack.desktop /usr/local/share/applications/Linstack.desktop
for dentry in Waydroid.desktop waydroid.desktop waydroid.install.desktop waydroid.app.install.desktop waydroid.market.desktop waydroid-helper.desktop; do
    sudo rm -f "/usr/local/share/applications/$dentry"
done
rm -f "$HOME/.local/share/applications/LinStack.desktop" "$HOME/.local/share/applications/Linstack.desktop" "$HOME/.local/share/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps/linstack.png"
if command -v update-desktop-database >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    sudo update-desktop-database /usr/local/share/applications 2>/dev/null || true
    sudo update-desktop-database /usr/share/applications 2>/dev/null || true
fi
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo rm -rf /opt/linstack
echo "LinStack has been completely removed."

   - Description: Modular Wayland compositor library used for embedded
     headless surface composition and zero-copy DMA-BUF rendering.

   - Website: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/wlroots/wlroots
   - License: MIT License

4. nlohmann/json (wlroots_engine/include/nlohmann/json.hpp)
   - Description: JSON for Modern C++.

   - License: MIT License

--- FILE: ./README.md ---
<img align="left" src="LinStack/LinStack_core/data/AppIcon.png" width="64">
 LinStack

LinStack is a high-performance, Linux-native Android emulation and containerized gaming environment. It integrates an embedded **wlroots** Wayland compositor, zero-copy DMA-BUF OpenGL ES hardware rendering, an ultra-low latency `uinput` touch and keymapping bridge, and a modern Qt desktop UI.

---

## Features

- **Zero-Copy Hardware Rendering:** Direct Wayland surface composition using DMA-BUF and GLES2 textures for minimal latency and maximum frame rates.
- **Embedded wlroots Compositor:** Dedicated embedded compositor handling Android display pipelines independently from the host session.
- **Smart Container Initialization:**
  - Automated local fallback: Reuses local `system.img` and `vendor.img` in `LinStack/resources/` if already present.
  - Automated download & extract: Streams official Waydroid LineageOS Android 11 images directly from SourceForge with real-time progress and extraction.
  - Custom image support: Allows specifying custom system and vendor image URLs or OTA channels.
- **Integrated Keymapper & Touch Emulation:** Low-latency virtual touch emulation via Linux `uinput` with customizable on-screen control bindings.
- **Self-Healing Diagnostics:** Proactive diagnostics engine for Binder nodes, permissions, and container daemon status.

---

## System Requirements

- **Operating System:** Linux (x86_64 or aarch64)
- **Kernel Drivers:**
  - Android Binder IPC driver (`binderfs` or `binder_linux` module)
  - Anonymous Shared Memory (`ashmem_linux` or memfd fallback)
- **Display Server:** Wayland or X11 session (e.g., GNOME, KDE Plasma, XFCE, Linux Mint/Cinnamon, Sway, Hyprland, i3)
- **Container Infrastructure:** LXC, `dnsmasq`, `iptables` / `nftables`

### Required Packages

#### Debian / Ubuntu / Pop!_OS:
```bash
sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y build-essential cmake pkg-config \
    qt6-base-dev libgl1-mesa-dev libwayland-dev wayland-protocols \
    libwlroots-dev libdrm-dev libepoxy-dev libxkbcommon-dev libinput-dev libx11-dev \
    lxc dnsmasq python3 python3-requests python3-dbus python3-gi \
    gir1.2-gtk-3.0 curl
```

#### Fedora:
```bash
sudo dnf install -y gcc-c++ cmake pkgconf-pkg-config \
    qt6-qtbase-devel mesa-libGL-devel wayland-devel wayland-protocols-devel \
    wlroots-devel libdrm-devel libepoxy-devel libxkbcommon-devel libinput-devel libX11-devel \
    lxc dnsmasq python3 python3-requests python3-dbus python3-gobject \
    gtk3 curl
```

#### Arch Linux:
```bash
sudo pacman -S --needed base-devel cmake pkgconf \
    qt6-base mesa wayland wayland-protocols wlroots \
    libdrm libepoxy libxkbcommon libinput libx11 lxc dnsmasq \
    python python-requests python-dbus python-gobject gtk3 curl
```

---

## Installation

1. **Clone the repository:**
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/modomedoh-a11y/LinStack.git
   cd LinStack
   ```

2. **Run the installation script:**
   ```bash
   ./install.sh
   ```
   This will:
   - Compile the LinStack C++/Qt client and embedded wlroots engine in Release mode.
   - Install the application cleanly into `/opt/linstack` (`/opt/linstack/bin/LinStack`, `LinStack_core`, `LinStack_Scripts`, and `resources/`).
   - Create system-wide symlinks `/usr/local/bin/LinStack` and `/usr/local/bin/linstack`.
   - Install the main desktop launcher and icon into `/usr/share/applications/LinStack.desktop` and `~/.local/share/applications/LinStack.desktop`.
   - Configure D-Bus permissions, Polkit actions, and enable the systemd service (`linstack-container.service`).
   - Generate an automated `uninstall.sh` script.

---

## Container Initialization (`init`)

LinStack requires Android system and vendor partition images to boot the container. The initialization process is smart and automated:

### Option 1: Native Qt First-Run Wizard (Recommended)
1. Launch **LinStack** from your application menu or run:
   ```bash
   LinStack
   ```
2. If the container is not yet initialized, LinStack automatically displays the native **Qt Initialization Dialog** styled in the Cyber-Emerald theme.
3. The dialog comes pre-filled with official Waydroid LineageOS 18.1 (Android 11) image URLs:
   - **System URL:** `https://sourceforge.net/projects/waydroid/files/images/system/lineage/waydroid_x86_64/lineage-18.1-20250628-VANILLA-waydroid_x86_64-system.zip/download`
   - **Vendor URL:** `https://sourceforge.net/projects/waydroid/files/images/vendor/waydroid_x86_64/lineage-18.1-20250628-MAINLINE-waydroid_x86_64-vendor.zip/download`
   - **Helper Notice:**
     > *"These are links for Waydroid Lineage OS Android 11 you can put your android images links or you can copy them to LinStack/LinStack/resources as system.img and vendor.img"*
4. Click **Init**:
   - **Smart Local Fallback:** LinStack first checks if `system.img` and `vendor.img` already exist in `/opt/linstack/resources/` or the relative `LinStack/resources/` directory. If both files exist, downloading is bypassed and container initialization starts instantly.
   - **Download & Extract:** If files are missing, LinStack downloads the `.zip` archives directly from SourceForge (with redirect following and progress reporting), extracts `system.img` and `vendor.img`, removes temporary archives, performs container setup via `pkexec`, and transitions directly to the Android boot screen.

### Option 2: Terminal / Headless Initialization (CLI)
You can initialize directly from the terminal using elevated permissions:
```bash
sudo linstack init
```
Or specify custom image URLs:
```bash
sudo linstack init -s <SYSTEM_IMAGE_OR_ZIP_URL> -v <VENDOR_IMAGE_OR_ZIP_URL>
```

### Option 3: Offline / Manual Setup
If you have already downloaded `system.img` and `vendor.img`:
1. Copy both files into `/opt/linstack/resources/` (or `LinStack/resources/` prior to running `./install.sh`):
   ```bash
   sudo cp /path/to/system.img /opt/linstack/resources/system.img
   sudo cp /path/to/vendor.img /opt/linstack/resources/vendor.img
   ```
2. Launch `LinStack` or run `sudo linstack init`. LinStack will automatically detect the local `.img` files and initialize without downloading.

---

## Extras & Script Integration (`LinStack_Scripts`)

LinStack includes bundled scripts in `/opt/linstack/LinStack_Scripts` for installing Google Play Services (GApps/MicroG), Magisk root, Libndk / Houdini ARM translation bridges, and device spoofing:

```bash
cd /opt/linstack/LinStack_Scripts
# Or in repository root: cd LinStack_Scripts
python3 -m venv venv
venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt

# Interactive terminal manager:
sudo venv/bin/python3 main.py

# Or install specific components directly:
sudo venv/bin/python3 main.py install {libndk,microg,magisk}
```

---

## Running LinStack

After initialization, launch LinStack at any time:
- Desktop Application Menu: Search for **LinStack**.
- Command Line:
  ```bash
  LinStack
  ```

### CLI Service Controls
```bash
# Check container status
linstack status

# Start or stop the container session
linstack session start
linstack session stop

# Show real-time container logcat
linstack logcat

# Manage systemd service
sudo systemctl restart linstack-container.service
```

---

## Troubleshooting Guide

### 1. Missing Kernel Modules (`binder` & `ashmem`)
LinStack requires the Android Binder IPC kernel module. On modern Linux kernels (5.x / 6.x), Binder is typically built into the kernel or provided via `binderfs`:

- **Check if `binderfs` is already mounted:**
  ```bash
  ls -l /dev/binderfs /dev/binder
  ```
- **If `/dev/binder` or `/dev/binderfs` is missing:**
  Ensure the module is loaded:
  ```bash
  sudo modprobe binder_linux
  ```
  Mount `binderfs` if needed:
  ```bash
  sudo mkdir -p /dev/binderfs
  sudo mount -t binder binder /dev/binderfs
  sudo ln -sf /dev/binderfs/binder /dev/binder
  sudo ln -sf /dev/binderfs/hwbinder /dev/hwbinder
  sudo ln -sf /dev/binderfs/vndbinder /dev/vndbinder
  ```
- **Persistent configuration:** Add to `/etc/modules-load.d/linstack.conf`:
  ```
  binder_linux
  ```
  And add to `/etc/fstab`:
  ```
  binder   /dev/binderfs   binder   nofail   0   0
  ```

### 2. Wayland Session & GPU Rendering
LinStack requires a Wayland desktop environment (GNOME Wayland, KDE Plasma Wayland, Sway, Hyprland, etc.).

- **Verify Wayland session:**
  ```bash
  echo $WAYLAND_DISPLAY
  ```
  If this returns empty, log out and select a "Wayland" session from your display manager (GDM / SDDM).
- **Intel & AMD GPUs:**
  Out of the box support via standard Mesa DRI/GBM drivers (`mesa-dri-drivers`).
- **NVIDIA Proprietary Drivers:**
  NVIDIA proprietary drivers (525+ or 555+) require explicit EGL/GBM configuration:
  ```bash
  export GBM_BACKEND=nvidia-drm
  export __GLX_VENDOR_LIBRARY_NAME=nvidia
  export WLR_NO_HARDWARE_CURSORS=1
  export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-0
  ```
  If Android fails to render with hardware acceleration on NVIDIA, fall back to software rendering in `/var/lib/linstack/linstack.cfg`:
  ```ini
  [linstack]
  ro.hardware.gralloc = default
  ro.hardware.egl = swiftshader
  ```

### 3. Container Network & Firewall Conflicts
LinStack creates a virtual bridge (`linstack0` / `192.168.245.1`) and uses `dnsmasq` for DHCP and DNS resolution.

- **Missing Internet in Android container:**
  Verify the LinStack bridge interface:
  ```bash
  ip addr show linstack0
  ```
- **Firewall blocking packet forwarding:**
  - **`firewalld` users (Fedora/RHEL):**
    ```bash
    sudo firewall-cmd --zone=trusted --add-interface=linstack0 --permanent
    sudo firewall-cmd --reload
    ```
  - **`ufw` users (Ubuntu/Debian):**
    Set `DEFAULT_FORWARD_POLICY="ACCEPT"` in `/etc/default/ufw` and reload:
    ```bash
    sudo ufw reload
    ```
  - **`iptables` / `nftables`:**
    ```bash
    sudo iptables -A FORWARD -i linstack0 -j ACCEPT
    sudo iptables -A FORWARD -o linstack0 -j ACCEPT
    sudo iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 192.168.245.0/24 ! -d 192.168.245.0/24 -j MASQUERADE
    ```

### 4. Polkit & `pkexec` Permission Failures
During container initialization, LinStack invokes `pkexec` to run elevated setup actions without requiring terminal root access:

- If you receive `pkexec: must be setuid root`:
  ```bash
  sudo chmod 4755 /usr/bin/pkexec
  ```
- If Polkit authentication dialog does not pop up in your desktop environment, ensure your desktop session has an active Polkit agent running:
  - **GNOME:** Built-in.
  - **KDE Plasma:** `/usr/libexec/polkit-kde-authentication-agent-1`
  - **Hyprland / Sway:** Install and run `polkit-gnome` or `lxqt-policykit`.
- Alternatively, run initialization directly in terminal with `sudo`:
  ```bash
  sudo linstack init
  ```

--- FILE: ./rebrand.py ---
import os

# Strict character-sequence replacement dictionary
REPLACEMENTS = {
    "id.waydro": "id.linstack",
    "id.Waydro": "id.Linstack",
    "WayDroid": "LinStack",
    "waydroid": "linstack",
    "Waydroid": "LinStack",
    "WAYDROID": "LINSTACK"
}

def replace_raw_text(file_path):
    """Direct raw substring replacement inside file"""
    try:
        with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
            content = f.read()

        modified = False
        for old, new in REPLACEMENTS.items():
            if old in content:
                content = content.replace(old, new)
                modified = True

        if modified:
            with open(file_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                f.write(content)
            print(f"[Modified content] -> {os.path.basename(file_path)}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error reading {os.path.basename(file_path)}: {e}")

def run_rebrand_here():
    # Automatically get current directory where the script resides
    current_directory = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
    print(f"🔄 Running automatic rebrand inside directory: {current_directory}\n")

    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(current_directory, topdown=False):
        # Skip modifying the script itself while running
        if "rebrand.py" in files:
            files.remove("rebrand.py")

        # 1. Replace strings inside file contents
        for file in files:
            file_path = os.path.join(root, file)
            replace_raw_text(file_path)

        # 2. Rename files matching target strings
        for file in files:
            new_file_name = file
            for old, new in REPLACEMENTS.items():
                new_file_name = new_file_name.replace(old, new)

            if new_file_name != file:
                old_path = os.path.join(root, file)
                new_path = os.path.join(root, new_file_name)
                os.rename(old_path, new_path)
                print(f"[Renamed file]: {file} -> {new_file_name}")

        # 3. Rename directories matching target strings
        for d in dirs:
            new_dir_name = d
            for old, new in REPLACEMENTS.items():
                new_dir_name = new_dir_name.replace(old, new)

            if new_dir_name != d:
                old_path = os.path.join(root, d)
                new_path = os.path.join(root, new_dir_name)
                os.rename(old_path, new_path)
                print(f"[Renamed directory]: {d} -> {new_dir_name}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_rebrand_here()
    print("\nSuccessfully rebranded current directory and all contents!")

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

# Enable unstable wlroots features
add_compile_definitions(WLR_USE_UNSTABLE=1)

find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)

# Query wlroots versions (0.20, 0.19, 0.18, 0.17 or generic wlroots)
set(WLROOTS_VERSION_MINOR 0)
pkg_check_modules(WLROOTS IMPORTED_TARGET wlroots-0.20)
if(WLROOTS_FOUND)
    set(WLROOTS_VERSION_MINOR 20)
else()
    pkg_check_modules(WLROOTS IMPORTED_TARGET wlroots-0.19)
    if(WLROOTS_FOUND)
        set(WLROOTS_VERSION_MINOR 19)
    else()
        pkg_check_modules(WLROOTS IMPORTED_TARGET wlroots-0.18)
        if(WLROOTS_FOUND)
            set(WLROOTS_VERSION_MINOR 18)
        else()
            pkg_check_modules(WLROOTS IMPORTED_TARGET wlroots-0.17)
            if(WLROOTS_FOUND)
                set(WLROOTS_VERSION_MINOR 17)
            else()
                pkg_check_modules(WLROOTS REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET wlroots)
                if(WLROOTS_VERSION MATCHES "^0\\.([0-9]+)")
                    set(WLROOTS_VERSION_MINOR ${CMAKE_MATCH_1})
                else()
                    set(WLROOTS_VERSION_MINOR 20)
                endif()
            endif()
        endif()
    endif()
endif()

message(STATUS "Found wlroots version ${WLROOTS_VERSION} (minor: ${WLROOTS_VERSION_MINOR})")

macro(generate_wayland_protocol xml_path name)
    set(header "${PROTOCOL_GEN_DIR}/${name}-protocol.h")
    set(source "${PROTOCOL_GEN_DIR}/${name}-protocol.c")

    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${header}
        COMMAND ${WAYLAND_SCANNER_EXECUTABLE} server-header ${xml_path} ${header}
        DEPENDS ${xml_path}
        COMMENT "Generating Wayland server protocol header: ${name}"
    )

    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${source}
        COMMAND ${WAYLAND_SCANNER_EXECUTABLE} private-code ${xml_path} ${source}
        DEPENDS ${xml_path}
        COMMENT "Generating Wayland private protocol code: ${name}"
    )

    list(APPEND PROTOCOL_SOURCES ${header} ${source})
endmacro()

# Generate xdg-shell and linux-dmabuf protocols
generate_wayland_protocol(
    "${WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_DIR}/stable/xdg-shell/xdg-shell.xml"
    "xdg-shell"
)

generate_wayland_protocol(
    "${WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_DIR}/stable/linux-dmabuf/linux-dmabuf-v1.xml"
    "linux-dmabuf-v1"
)

)

add_executable(linstack_wlroots_compositor ${SOURCES})

#ifndef INPUT_MAPPER_H

enum class WlrKeyNodeType {
    Tap,
    Dpad,
    AimLock
};

struct KeyNode {
    std::string id;
    WlrKeyNodeType type = WlrKeyNodeType::Tap;
    uint32_t scanCode = 0; // Hardware scancode (layout-independent)
    float relX = 0.5f;
    float relY = 0.5f;
    int32_t touchSlot = 3;
    int mouseButton = 0;
};

struct DpadConfig {
    float centerX = 0.18f;
    float centerY = 0.70f;
    float radius = 0.08f;
    uint32_t scanUp = 25;    // W (evdev 17 + 8)
    uint32_t scanLeft = 38;  // A (evdev 30 + 8)
    uint32_t scanDown = 39;  // S (evdev 31 + 8)
    uint32_t scanRight = 40; // D (evdev 32 + 8)
    int32_t touchSlot = 0;
};

struct AimLockNodeConfig {
    std::string id;
    uint32_t toggleScanCode = 67; // F1 (evdev 59 + 8)
    int toggleMouseButton = 0;
    float centerX = 0.50f;
    float centerY = 0.50f;
    float fireX = 0.82f;
    float fireY = 0.64f;
    float sensitivityX = 1.2f;
    float sensitivityY = 1.2f;
    bool acceleration = false;
    float maxSweepRadius = 0.18f;
    int32_t cameraTouchSlot = 1;
    int32_t fireTouchSlot = 2;
};

struct BurstTapConfig {
    std::string id;
    uint32_t scanCode = 0;
    int mouseButton = 0;
    float relX = 0.5f;
    float relY = 0.5f;
    int burstHz = 10;
};

struct FreeLookConfig {
    std::string id;
    uint32_t holdScanCode = 0;
    int holdMouseButton = 0;
    float centerX = 0.5f;
    float centerY = 0.5f;
    float sensitivityX = 1.2f;
    float sensitivityY = 1.2f;
    bool acceleration = false;
};

struct SwipeConfig {
    std::string id;
    uint32_t scanCode = 0;
    int mouseButton = 0;
    float startX = 0.5f;
    float startY = 0.7f;
    float endX = 0.5f;
    float endY = 0.3f;
    int durationMs = 150;
    std::vector<std::pair<float, float>> pathPoints;
};

struct SmartCastConfig {
    std::string id;
    uint32_t scanCode = 0;
    int mouseButton = 0;
    float centerX = 0.75f;
    float centerY = 0.75f;
    float castRadius = 160.0f;
};

class InputMapper {
public:
    explicit InputMapper(struct wlr_seat *seat = nullptr,
                         struct wlr_relative_pointer_manager_v1 *relPointerMgr = nullptr);
    ~InputMapper();

    void setSeat(struct wlr_seat *seat) { m_seat = seat; }
    void setRelativePointerManager(struct wlr_relative_pointer_manager_v1 *mgr) { m_relPointerMgr = mgr; }

    void setGeometry(const ViewportRect &viewport, int androidWidth, int androidHeight);
    void windowToAndroid(int winX, int winY, double &outAndroidX, double &outAndroidY) const;
    void windowToNormalized(int winX, int winY, float &outNormX, float &outNormY) const;

    // Hardware Scancode Event Handlers (works across all keyboard languages)
    bool handleScanCodeDown(uint32_t scanCode, struct wlr_surface *surface);
    bool handleScanCodeUp(uint32_t scanCode, struct wlr_surface *surface);
    bool handleMappedMouseDown(int button, struct wlr_surface *surface);
    bool handleMappedMouseUp(int button, struct wlr_surface *surface);
    void forwardNativeKey(uint32_t scanCode, bool pressed, struct wlr_surface *surface);
    void sendSystemKey(uint32_t evdevKeyCode, struct wlr_surface *surface);
    void sendRecentsCombo(struct wlr_surface *surface);

    bool handleMouseDown(int button, int winX, int winY, struct wlr_surface *surface);
    bool handleMouseUp(int button, int winX, int winY, struct wlr_surface *surface);
    bool handleMouseMove(int winX, int winY, float deltaX, float deltaY, struct wlr_surface *surface);

    // Periodic tick for BurstTap and Swipe animations
    void tick(struct wlr_surface *surface);

    // Multi-Node Aim Lock & Free Look Management
    void setAimLockActive(bool active, int nodeIndex = 0);
    bool isAimLockActive() const { return m_aimLockActive; }
    int activeAimNodeIndex() const { return m_activeAimIndex; }
    const AimLockNodeConfig* activeAimNode() const;

    bool isFreeLookActive() const { return m_freeLookActive; }
    const FreeLookConfig* activeFreeLookNode() const;
    bool isSmartCasting() const { return m_smartCasting; }

    void setupDefaultProfile();

    void clearTapNodes() { m_tapNodes.clear(); }
    void addTapNode(const KeyNode &node) { m_tapNodes.push_back(node); }
    void setDpad(const DpadConfig &dpad) { m_dpad = dpad; }
    void clearAimNodes() { m_aimNodes.clear(); }
    void addAimNode(const AimLockNodeConfig &aim) { m_aimNodes.push_back(aim); }

    void clearExtraNodes() {
        m_burstNodes.clear();
        m_freeLookNodes.clear();
        m_swipeNodes.clear();
        m_smartCastNodes.clear();
    }
    void addBurstNode(const BurstTapConfig &b) { m_burstNodes.push_back(b); }
    void addFreeLookNode(const FreeLookConfig &fl) { m_freeLookNodes.push_back(fl); }
    void addSwipeNode(const SwipeConfig &sw) { m_swipeNodes.push_back(sw); }
    void addSmartCastNode(const SmartCastConfig &sc) { m_smartCastNodes.push_back(sc); }

    const std::vector<KeyNode>& getTapNodes() const { return m_tapNodes; }
    const DpadConfig& getDpad() const { return m_dpad; }
    const std::vector<AimLockNodeConfig>& getAimNodes() const { return m_aimNodes; }

private:
    uint32_t getTimestampMs() const;
    void updateDpad(struct wlr_surface *surface);
    int32_t allocateSlot();
    void releaseSlot(int32_t slot);

    struct wlr_seat *m_seat = nullptr;
    struct wlr_relative_pointer_manager_v1 *m_relPointerMgr = nullptr;

    ViewportRect m_viewport;
    int m_androidWidth = 1920;
    int m_androidHeight = 1080;

    std::vector<KeyNode> m_tapNodes;
    DpadConfig m_dpad;
    std::vector<AimLockNodeConfig> m_aimNodes;
    std::vector<BurstTapConfig> m_burstNodes;
    std::vector<FreeLookConfig> m_freeLookNodes;
    std::vector<SwipeConfig> m_swipeNodes;
    std::vector<SmartCastConfig> m_smartCastNodes;

    std::set<uint32_t> m_heldScanCodes;
    std::set<int32_t> m_activeSlots;
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::vector<int32_t>> m_scanCodeToSlots;

    bool m_dpadActive = false;
    int32_t m_activeDpadSlot = -1;

    bool m_aimLockActive = false;
    bool m_aimSuspendedByFreeLook = false;
    int m_suspendedAimIndex = -1;
    int m_activeAimIndex = -1;
    int32_t m_activeAimCameraSlot = -1;
    int32_t m_pendingReleaseCameraSlot = -1;
    bool m_aimNeedsTouchDown = true;
    float m_smoothAimDx = 0.0f;
    float m_smoothAimDy = 0.0f;
    int32_t m_activeAimFireSlot = -1;
    bool m_firing = false;
    std::unordered_map<int, std::vector<int32_t>> m_mouseBtnToSlots;

    bool m_isTouching = false;
    int32_t m_activeMouseSlot = -1;

    float m_accumAimX = 0.0f;
    float m_accumAimY = 0.0f;
    uint32_t m_lastAimMoveMs = 0;

    // Burst Tap state
    struct ActiveBurst {
        BurstTapConfig cfg;
        int32_t slot = -1;

        bool isDown = false;
    };
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::vector<ActiveBurst>> m_activeBursts;

    // Free Look state
    bool m_freeLookActive = false;
    int m_activeFreeLookIndex = -1;
    int32_t m_activeFreeLookSlot = -1;
    int32_t m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot = -1;

    // Swipe state
    struct ActiveSwipe {

    };
    std::vector<ActiveSwipe> m_activeSwipes;

        int32_t slot = -1;
        float accumX = 0.0f;
        float accumY = 0.0f;
    };
    bool m_smartCasting = false;
    std::vector<ActiveSmartCast> m_activeSmartCasts;
};

#ifndef ASPECT_RATIO_WINDOW_H
#define ASPECT_RATIO_WINDOW_H

#include "WaylandSurfaceRenderer.h"

class AspectRatioWindow {
public:
    AspectRatioWindow(int targetWidth = 1920, int targetHeight = 1080);
    ~AspectRatioWindow();

    void setTargetResolution(int width, int height);
    int getTargetWidth() const { return m_targetWidth; }
    int getTargetHeight() const { return m_targetHeight; }
    float getAspectRatio() const { return m_aspectRatio; }

    /**
     * @brief Computes the centered viewport rectangle inside the given window size
     * preserving the strict aspect ratio (handling letterbox/pillarbox).
     */
    ViewportRect computeViewport(int windowWidth, int windowHeight) const;

    /**
     * @brief Adjusts a requested resize dimension to strictly preserve the aspect ratio.
     * @param inOutWidth Input/output width in pixels.
     * @param inOutHeight Input/output height in pixels.
     * @param anchorWidth If true, width is kept and height is snapped; else height is kept.
     */
    void snapSizeToAspectRatio(int &inOutWidth, int &inOutHeight, bool anchorWidth = true) const;

private:
    int m_targetWidth = 1920;
    int m_targetHeight = 1080;
    float m_aspectRatio = 1.777778f;
};

#endif // ASPECT_RATIO_WINDOW_H

--- FILE: ./wlroots_engine/include/EmbeddedCompositor.h ---
#ifndef EMBEDDED_COMPOSITOR_H
#define EMBEDDED_COMPOSITOR_H

#include <string>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>
#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

#include "wlr_c_bridge.h"

struct EmbeddedCompositorConfig {
    std::string socketName = "wayland-linstack-0";
    int defaultWidth = 1920;
    int defaultHeight = 1080;
    int refreshRate = 60;
};

class EmbeddedCompositor {
public:
    explicit EmbeddedCompositor(const EmbeddedCompositorConfig &config = EmbeddedCompositorConfig{});
    ~EmbeddedCompositor();

    // Non-copyable
    EmbeddedCompositor(const EmbeddedCompositor &) = delete;
    EmbeddedCompositor &operator=(const EmbeddedCompositor &) = delete;

    /**
     * @brief Initializes Wayland display, headless wlroots backend, GLES2 renderer,
     * DMA-BUF importer, XDG Shell, seat, and binds the socket.
     */
    bool initialize();

    /**
     * @brief Starts the wlroots backend.
     */
    bool start();

    /**
     * @brief Dispatches any pending Wayland display and event loop events.
     * @param timeoutMs Timeout in milliseconds (0 for non-blocking poll).
     */
    int dispatch(int timeoutMs = 0);

    /**
     * @brief Shuts down the compositor, releases listeners, and removes the socket.
     */
    void shutdown();

    /**
     * @brief Binds the compositor's EGL context to the current thread.
     */
    bool makeCurrent();

    // Getters returning opaque pointers
    struct wl_display *getDisplay() const { return m_display; }
    struct wl_event_loop *getEventLoop() const { return m_eventLoop; }
    int getEventLoopFd() const { return wlr_bridge_event_loop_get_fd(m_eventLoop); }
    void flush() const { if (m_display) wlr_bridge_display_flush_clients(m_display); }
    struct wlr_backend *getBackend() const { return m_backend; }
    struct wlr_renderer *getRenderer() const { return m_renderer; }
    struct wlr_seat *getSeat() const { return m_seat; }
    struct wlr_relative_pointer_manager_v1 *getRelativePointerManager() const { return m_relativePointerManager; }
    struct wlr_output_layout *getOutputLayout() const { return m_outputLayout; }
    struct wlr_output *getHeadlessOutput() const { return m_headlessOutput; }
    struct wlr_presentation *getPresentation() const { return m_presentation; }
    struct wlr_viewporter *getViewporter() const { return m_viewporter; }
    struct wlr_xdg_output_manager_v1 *getXdgOutputManager() const { return m_xdgOutputManager; }
    struct wlr_fractional_scale_manager_v1 *getFractionalScale() const { return m_fractionalScale; }
    struct wlr_pointer_constraints_v1 *getPointerConstraints() const { return m_pointerConstraints; }
    struct wlr_data_device_manager *getDataDeviceManager() const { return m_dataDeviceManager; }
    struct wlr_surface *getActiveSurface() const { return m_activeSurface; }
    struct wlr_surface *getRenderableSurface() const;
    std::string getSocketName() const { return m_config.socketName; }
    int getWidth() const { return m_config.defaultWidth; }
    int getHeight() const { return m_config.defaultHeight; }

    /**
     * @brief Returns the EGL display used by the wlroots GLES2 renderer.
     */
    EGLDisplay getEglDisplay() const;

    /**
     * @brief Returns the EGL context used by the wlroots GLES2 renderer.
     */
    EGLContext getEglContext() const;

    // Surface lifecycle callbacks
    std::function<void(struct wlr_surface *surface)> onSurfaceMapped;
    std::function<void(struct wlr_surface *surface)> onSurfaceUnmapped;
    std::function<void(struct wlr_surface *surface)> onSurfaceCommit;
    std::function<void(struct wl_client *client)> onClientConnected;

    // Internal bridge callbacks
    void handleClientCreated(struct wl_client *client);
    void handleNewSurface(struct wlr_surface *surface);
    void handleNewXdgSurface(struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdgSurface);
    void handleNewXdgToplevel(struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *toplevel);
    void handleXdgSurfaceMap(struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdgSurface);
    void handleXdgSurfaceUnmap(struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdgSurface);
    void handleXdgSurfaceDestroy(struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdgSurface);
    void handleSurfaceCommit(struct wlr_surface *surface);
    void handleRawSurfaceDestroy(struct wlr_surface *surface);

private:
    EmbeddedCompositorConfig m_config;

    struct wl_display *m_display = nullptr;
    struct wl_event_loop *m_eventLoop = nullptr;
    struct wlr_backend *m_backend = nullptr;
    struct wlr_renderer *m_renderer = nullptr;
    struct wlr_allocator *m_allocator = nullptr;
    struct wlr_compositor *m_compositor = nullptr;
    struct wlr_subcompositor *m_subcompositor = nullptr;
    struct wlr_data_device_manager *m_dataDeviceManager = nullptr;
    struct wlr_shm *m_shm = nullptr;
    struct wlr_linux_dmabuf_v1 *m_linuxDmabuf = nullptr;
    struct wlr_presentation *m_presentation = nullptr;
    struct wlr_viewporter *m_viewporter = nullptr;
    struct wlr_xdg_output_manager_v1 *m_xdgOutputManager = nullptr;
    struct wlr_fractional_scale_manager_v1 *m_fractionalScale = nullptr;
    struct wlr_pointer_constraints_v1 *m_pointerConstraints = nullptr;
    struct wlr_single_pixel_buffer_manager_v1 *m_singlePixelBuffer = nullptr;
    struct wlr_xdg_shell *m_xdgShell = nullptr;
    struct wlr_seat *m_seat = nullptr;
    struct wlr_keyboard *m_virtualKeyboard = nullptr;
    struct wlr_relative_pointer_manager_v1 *m_relativePointerManager = nullptr;
    struct wlr_output_layout *m_outputLayout = nullptr;
    struct wlr_output *m_headlessOutput = nullptr;
    int m_drmFd = -1;

    struct wlr_surface *m_activeSurface = nullptr;
    struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *m_activeToplevel = nullptr;

    // Signal listeners from C bridge
    struct wlr_bridge_listener *m_clientCreatedListener = nullptr;
    struct wlr_bridge_listener *m_newSurfaceListener = nullptr;
    struct wlr_bridge_listener *m_newXdgSurfaceListener = nullptr;
    struct wlr_bridge_listener *m_newXdgToplevelListener = nullptr;

    // Track active XDG surface records
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<struct wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record, void(*)(struct wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record*)>> m_surfaceRecords;

    // Track XDG toplevel records
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<struct wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record, void(*)(struct wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record*)>> m_toplevelRecords;

    // Track raw surface records
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<struct wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record, void(*)(struct wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record*)>> m_rawSurfaceRecords;
};

#endif // EMBEDDED_COMPOSITOR_H

--- FILE: ./wlroots_engine/include/WaylandSurfaceRenderer.h ---
#ifndef WAYLAND_SURFACE_RENDERER_H
#define WAYLAND_SURFACE_RENDERER_H

#ifndef WLR_USE_UNSTABLE
#define WLR_USE_UNSTABLE 1
#endif

#include <array>
#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdint>
#include <GLES2/gl2.h>
#include <GLES2/gl2ext.h>

// EGL headers for EGLImageKHR cross-context texture import
#ifndef EGL_NO_X11
#define EGL_NO_X11
#endif
#ifndef EGL_NO_PLATFORM_SPECIFIC_TYPES
#define EGL_NO_PLATFORM_SPECIFIC_TYPES
#endif
#include <EGL/egl.h>
#include <EGL/eglext.h>

#include "wlr_c_bridge.h"

struct ViewportRect {
    int x = 0;
    int y = 0;
    int width = 1920;
    int height = 1080;
};

class WaylandSurfaceRenderer {
public:
    WaylandSurfaceRenderer();
    ~WaylandSurfaceRenderer();

    /**
     * @brief Initializes OpenGL shaders, quad VBOs, and GL state.
     *        Must be called with Qt's OpenGL context current (inside initializeGL).
     */
    bool initialize();

    /**
     * @brief [Legacy] Renders a wlr_surface directly — only valid when wlroots'
     *        EGL context is current. Kept for reference; use renderEglImage() or
     *        renderCpuPixels() from paintGL() instead.
     */
    bool renderSurface(struct wlr_surface *surface, const ViewportRect &destRect,
                       int windowWidth, int windowHeight);

    /**
     * @brief Zero-copy path: renders a cross-context EGLImage into Qt's
     *        framebuffer using GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES.
     *        Call with Qt's OpenGL context current.
     *
     * @param eglImage  An EGLImage created from wlroots' GL_TEXTURE_2D texture
     *                  via eglCreateImage(..., EGL_GL_TEXTURE_2D, ...).
     * @param hasAlpha  Whether the source texture has an alpha channel.
     * @param srcW/srcH Source texture dimensions (for aspect ratio computation).
     */
    bool renderEglImage(EGLImage eglImage, bool hasAlpha,
                        int srcW, int srcH,
                        const ViewportRect &destRect,
                        int windowWidth, int windowHeight);

    /**
     * @brief CPU-readback path: uploads raw RGBA8888 pixels into a GL_TEXTURE_2D
     *        and renders it. Used when wlroots gives us a GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES
     *        texture that cannot be directly wrapped in an EGLImageKHR.
     *        Call with Qt's OpenGL context current.
     *
     * @param pixels  Pointer to RGBA/ABGR pixel data.
     * @param srcW    Width of the pixel buffer.
     * @param srcH    Height of the pixel buffer.
     */
    bool renderCpuPixels(const uint8_t *pixels, int srcW, int srcH,
                         const ViewportRect &destRect,
                         int windowWidth, int windowHeight);

    /**
     * @brief Sends wl_surface.frame done callback to signal Android SurfaceFlinger
     *        that presentation has finished and the next frame can be committed.
     *        Must be called with wlroots' EGL context current.
     */
    void sendFrameDone(struct wlr_surface *surface);

    /**
     * @brief Clears letterbox / pillarbox margins with cyber dark background color.
     */
    void clearLetterboxBars(const ViewportRect &destRect, int windowWidth, int windowHeight);

private:
    GLuint createProgram(const char *vertSrc, const char *fragSrc);
    void   setupOrthoMatrix(float left, float right, float bottom, float top,
                            std::array<float, 16> &out);
    bool   drawQuad(GLuint program, GLint uProj, GLint uTex,
                    GLenum texTarget, GLuint texId,
                    const ViewportRect &destRect,
                    int windowWidth, int windowHeight);

    GLuint m_program2D = 0;
    GLuint m_programExternalOES = 0;

    GLint m_uProj2D = -1;
    GLint m_uTex2D  = -1;

    GLint m_uProjExternal = -1;
    GLint m_uTexExternal  = -1;

    GLuint m_vbo = 0;

    // Persistent CPU-upload texture (reused across frames to avoid re-allocation)
    GLuint m_cpuTex = 0;
    int    m_cpuTexW = 0;
    int    m_cpuTexH = 0;

    // Persistent OES texture for EGLImageKHR import
    GLuint m_oesTex = 0;

    bool m_initialized = false;
};

#endif // WAYLAND_SURFACE_RENDERER_H

void                     wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record_destroy(struct wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record *record);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* WLR_C_BRIDGE_H */

--- FILE: ./wlroots_engine/src/WaylandSurfaceRenderer.cpp ---
#include "WaylandSurfaceRenderer.h"

#include <iostream>
#include <ctime>
#include <cmath>

// Load glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES at runtime via eglGetProcAddress.
// The function may not be exported directly by libGLESv2.so on all Mesa builds,
// but is always available via the EGL proc-address mechanism.
static PFNGLEGLIMAGETARGETTEXTURE2DOESPROC s_glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES = nullptr;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Shader sources
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
namespace {

// Standard vertex shader shared by all programs
const char *VERTEX_SHADER_SRC = R"(
    attribute vec2 a_pos;
    attribute vec2 a_texcoord;
    varying vec2 v_texcoord;
    uniform mat4 u_proj;

    void main() {
        gl_Position = u_proj * vec4(a_pos, 0.0, 1.0);
        v_texcoord = a_texcoord;
    }
)";

// Standard sampler2D fragment shader (CPU-upload textures, GL_TEXTURE_2D)
const char *FRAGMENT_SHADER_2D_SRC = R"(
    precision mediump float;
    varying vec2 v_texcoord;
    uniform sampler2D u_texture;

    void main() {
        gl_FragColor = texture2D(u_texture, v_texcoord);
    }
)";

// GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES shader — required for EGLImageKHR import and
// for DMA-BUF textures created directly in wlroots' context.
const char *FRAGMENT_SHADER_EXTERNAL_SRC = R"(
    #extension GL_OES_EGL_image_external : require
    precision mediump float;
    varying vec2 v_texcoord;
    uniform samplerExternalOES u_texture;

    void main() {
        gl_FragColor = texture2D(u_texture, v_texcoord);
    }
)";

} // namespace

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Construction / destruction
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

WaylandSurfaceRenderer::WaylandSurfaceRenderer() = default;

WaylandSurfaceRenderer::~WaylandSurfaceRenderer() {
    if (m_program2D)         glDeleteProgram(m_program2D);
    if (m_programExternalOES) glDeleteProgram(m_programExternalOES);
    if (m_vbo)   glDeleteBuffers(1, &m_vbo);
    if (m_cpuTex) glDeleteTextures(1, &m_cpuTex);
    if (m_oesTex) glDeleteTextures(1, &m_oesTex);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Shader helpers
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

GLuint WaylandSurfaceRenderer::createProgram(const char *vertSrc, const char *fragSrc) {
    auto compileShader = [](GLenum type, const char *src) -> GLuint {
        GLuint shader = glCreateShader(type);
        glShaderSource(shader, 1, &src, nullptr);
        glCompileShader(shader);

        GLint compiled = 0;
        glGetShaderiv(shader, GL_COMPILE_STATUS, &compiled);
        if (!compiled) {
            GLint infoLen = 0;
            glGetShaderiv(shader, GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH, &infoLen);
            if (infoLen > 0) {
                std::string log(infoLen, '\0');
                glGetShaderInfoLog(shader, infoLen, nullptr, log.data());
                std::cerr << "[Renderer] Shader compilation error: " << log << std::endl;
            }
            glDeleteShader(shader);
            return 0;
        }
        return shader;
    };

    GLuint vert = compileShader(GL_VERTEX_SHADER, vertSrc);
    if (!vert) return 0;

    GLuint frag = compileShader(GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragSrc);
    if (!frag) { glDeleteShader(vert); return 0; }

    GLuint program = glCreateProgram();
    glAttachShader(program, vert);
    glAttachShader(program, frag);
    glBindAttribLocation(program, 0, "a_pos");
    glBindAttribLocation(program, 1, "a_texcoord");
    glLinkProgram(program);
    glDeleteShader(vert);
    glDeleteShader(frag);

    GLint linked = 0;
    glGetProgramiv(program, GL_LINK_STATUS, &linked);
    if (!linked) {
        GLint infoLen = 0;
        glGetProgramiv(program, GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH, &infoLen);
        if (infoLen > 0) {
            std::string log(infoLen, '\0');
            glGetProgramInfoLog(program, infoLen, nullptr, log.data());
            std::cerr << "[Renderer] Program link error: " << log << std::endl;
        }
        glDeleteProgram(program);
        return 0;
    }
    return program;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Initialize (call inside Qt's initializeGL)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

bool WaylandSurfaceRenderer::initialize() {
    if (m_initialized) return true;

    // 1. GL_TEXTURE_2D sampler (CPU-upload & readback textures)
    m_program2D = createProgram(VERTEX_SHADER_SRC, FRAGMENT_SHADER_2D_SRC);
    if (!m_program2D) {
        std::cerr << "[Renderer] Error: Failed to compile 2D shader program." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }
    m_uProj2D = glGetUniformLocation(m_program2D, "u_proj");
    m_uTex2D  = glGetUniformLocation(m_program2D, "u_texture");

    // 2. samplerExternalOES (EGLImageKHR cross-context import and DMA-BUF)
    m_programExternalOES = createProgram(VERTEX_SHADER_SRC, FRAGMENT_SHADER_EXTERNAL_SRC);
    if (!m_programExternalOES) {
        std::cerr << "[Renderer] Warning: GL_OES_EGL_image_external unavailable; "
                     "falling back to 2D sampler." << std::endl;
    } else {
        m_uProjExternal = glGetUniformLocation(m_programExternalOES, "u_proj");
        m_uTexExternal  = glGetUniformLocation(m_programExternalOES, "u_texture");
    }

    // 3. Dynamic VBO for quad geometry
    glGenBuffers(1, &m_vbo);

    // 4. Persistent CPU-upload texture (avoid per-frame allocation)
    glGenTextures(1, &m_cpuTex);

    // 5. Persistent OES texture for EGLImageKHR import
    glGenTextures(1, &m_oesTex);

    // 6. Load OES EGL image extension function pointer at runtime
    s_glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES =
        reinterpret_cast<PFNGLEGLIMAGETARGETTEXTURE2DOESPROC>(
            eglGetProcAddress("glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES"));
    if (!s_glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES) {
        std::cerr << "[Renderer] Warning: glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES unavailable — "
                     "EGLImageKHR import path disabled; will use CPU readback." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "[Renderer] glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES loaded successfully." << std::endl;
    }

    m_initialized = true;
    std::cout << "[Renderer] Wayland Surface GLES2 Renderer initialized successfully." << std::endl;
    return true;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Ortho projection matrix
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

void WaylandSurfaceRenderer::setupOrthoMatrix(float left, float right, float bottom, float top,
                                              std::array<float, 16> &out) {
    out.fill(0.0f);
    out[0]  =  2.0f / (right - left);
    out[5]  =  2.0f / (top - bottom);
    out[10] = -1.0f;
    out[12] = -(right + left) / (right - left);
    out[13] = -(top + bottom) / (top - bottom);
    out[15] =  1.0f;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Internal helper: draw a textured quad into destRect
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

bool WaylandSurfaceRenderer::drawQuad(GLuint program, GLint uProj, GLint uTex,
                                      GLenum texTarget, GLuint texId,
                                      const ViewportRect &destRect,
                                      int windowWidth, int windowHeight) {
    if (!program || texId == 0) return false;

    glUseProgram(program);

    std::array<float, 16> orthoMatrix;
    setupOrthoMatrix(0.0f, static_cast<float>(windowWidth),
                     static_cast<float>(windowHeight), 0.0f, orthoMatrix);
    glUniformMatrix4fv(uProj, 1, GL_FALSE, orthoMatrix.data());

    float x1 = static_cast<float>(destRect.x);
    float y1 = static_cast<float>(destRect.y);
    float x2 = x1 + static_cast<float>(destRect.width);
    float y2 = y1 + static_cast<float>(destRect.height);

    // {pos.x, pos.y, tex.u, tex.v}
    float vertices[] = {
        x1, y1,  0.0f, 0.0f,
        x1, y2,  0.0f, 1.0f,
        x2, y1,  1.0f, 0.0f,
        x2, y1,  1.0f, 0.0f,
        x1, y2,  0.0f, 1.0f,
        x2, y2,  1.0f, 1.0f
    };

    glBindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, m_vbo);
    glBufferData(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, sizeof(vertices), vertices, GL_DYNAMIC_DRAW);

    glEnableVertexAttribArray(0);
    glVertexAttribPointer(0, 2, GL_FLOAT, GL_FALSE, 4 * sizeof(float),
                          reinterpret_cast<void *>(0));
    glEnableVertexAttribArray(1);
    glVertexAttribPointer(1, 2, GL_FLOAT, GL_FALSE, 4 * sizeof(float),
                          reinterpret_cast<void *>(2 * sizeof(float)));

    glActiveTexture(GL_TEXTURE0);
    glBindTexture(texTarget, texId);
    glTexParameteri(texTarget, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
    glTexParameteri(texTarget, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
    glTexParameteri(texTarget, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S, GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    glTexParameteri(texTarget, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T, GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    glUniform1i(uTex, 0);

    glEnable(GL_BLEND);
    glBlendFunc(GL_ONE, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);

    glDrawArrays(GL_TRIANGLES, 0, 6);

    glBindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0);
    glBindTexture(texTarget, 0);
    glUseProgram(0);

    return true;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// renderSurface — legacy path (wlroots context must be current)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

bool WaylandSurfaceRenderer::renderSurface(struct wlr_surface *surface,
                                           const ViewportRect &destRect,
                                           int windowWidth, int windowHeight) {
    if (!surface || !m_initialized) return false;

    struct wlr_texture *wlrTex = wlr_bridge_surface_get_texture(surface);
    if (!wlrTex) return false;
    if (!wlr_bridge_texture_is_gles2(wlrTex)) {
        std::cerr << "[Renderer] Warning: Surface texture is not GLES2." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    uint32_t target = 0, tex = 0;
    if (!wlr_bridge_gles2_texture_get_attribs(wlrTex, &target, &tex) || tex == 0) {
        return false;
    }

    GLuint prog  = (target == GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES && m_programExternalOES)
                   ? m_programExternalOES : m_program2D;
    GLint  uProj = (prog == m_programExternalOES) ? m_uProjExternal : m_uProj2D;
    GLint  uTex  = (prog == m_programExternalOES) ? m_uTexExternal  : m_uTex2D;

    return drawQuad(prog, uProj, uTex, target, tex,
                    destRect, windowWidth, windowHeight);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// renderEglImage — zero-copy path (Qt context current, wlroots GL_TEXTURE_2D source)
//
// Creates an OES texture in Qt's context backed by the EGLImageKHR that was
// created from wlroots' GL_TEXTURE_2D.  This is a true zero-copy path:
// no pixel data crosses the CPU.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

bool WaylandSurfaceRenderer::renderEglImage(EGLImage eglImage, bool /*hasAlpha*/,
                                            int /*srcW*/, int /*srcH*/,
                                            const ViewportRect &destRect,
                                            int windowWidth, int windowHeight) {
    if (!m_initialized || eglImage == EGL_NO_IMAGE) return false;
    if (!m_programExternalOES) {
        std::cerr << "[Renderer] renderEglImage: OES shader unavailable." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }
    if (!s_glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES) {
        std::cerr << "[Renderer] renderEglImage: glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES not loaded." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // Bind the persistent OES texture and attach the EGLImage to it
    glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES, m_oesTex);
    s_glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES(GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES,
                                   static_cast<GLeglImageOES>(eglImage));

    bool ok = drawQuad(m_programExternalOES, m_uProjExternal, m_uTexExternal,
                       GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES, m_oesTex,
                       destRect, windowWidth, windowHeight);

    glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES, 0);
    return ok;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// renderCpuPixels — CPU-readback fallback (Qt context current)
//
// Used when wlroots gives us a GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES (DMA-BUF import) that
// cannot be wrapped in an EGL_GL_TEXTURE_2D_KHR EGLImage.  Uploads RGBA8888
// pixels into a persistent GL_TEXTURE_2D and renders with the standard 2D shader.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

bool WaylandSurfaceRenderer::renderCpuPixels(const uint8_t *pixels,
                                             int srcW, int srcH,
                                             const ViewportRect &destRect,
                                             int windowWidth, int windowHeight) {
    if (!m_initialized || !pixels || srcW <= 0 || srcH <= 0) return false;

    glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, m_cpuTex);

    if (srcW != m_cpuTexW || srcH != m_cpuTexH) {
        // Re-allocate the texture storage for the new dimensions
        glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, GL_RGBA,
                     srcW, srcH, 0, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, pixels);
        m_cpuTexW = srcW;
        m_cpuTexH = srcH;
    } else {
        // Same size — cheaper sub-image upload
        glTexSubImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, 0, 0,
                        srcW, srcH, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, pixels);
    }

    glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0);

    return drawQuad(m_program2D, m_uProj2D, m_uTex2D,
                    GL_TEXTURE_2D, m_cpuTex,
                    destRect, windowWidth, windowHeight);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// sendFrameDone — must be called with wlroots' EGL context current
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

void WaylandSurfaceRenderer::sendFrameDone(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!surface) return;
    wlr_bridge_surface_send_frame_done(surface);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// clearLetterboxBars
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

void WaylandSurfaceRenderer::clearLetterboxBars(const ViewportRect &destRect,
                                                int windowWidth, int windowHeight) {
    glEnable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
    glClearColor(0.05f, 0.05f, 0.07f, 1.0f);

    // Top bar
    if (destRect.y > 0) {
        glScissor(0, windowHeight - destRect.y, windowWidth, destRect.y);
        glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
    }
    // Bottom bar
    int bottomY = destRect.y + destRect.height;
    if (bottomY < windowHeight) {
        glScissor(0, 0, windowWidth, windowHeight - bottomY);
        glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
    }
    // Left bar
    if (destRect.x > 0) {
        glScissor(0, 0, destRect.x, windowHeight);
        glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
    }
    // Right bar
    int rightX = destRect.x + destRect.width;
    if (rightX < windowWidth) {
        glScissor(rightX, 0, windowWidth - rightX, windowHeight);
        glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
    }

    glDisable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
}

--- FILE: ./wlroots_engine/src/EmbeddedCompositor.cpp ---
#include "EmbeddedCompositor.h"

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <algorithm>

EmbeddedCompositor::EmbeddedCompositor(const EmbeddedCompositorConfig &config)
    : m_config(config)
{
}

EmbeddedCompositor::~EmbeddedCompositor() {
    shutdown();
}

bool EmbeddedCompositor::makeCurrent() {
    EGLDisplay dpy = getEglDisplay();
    EGLContext ctx = getEglContext();
    if (dpy == EGL_NO_DISPLAY || ctx == EGL_NO_CONTEXT) return false;
    return eglMakeCurrent(dpy, EGL_NO_SURFACE, EGL_NO_SURFACE, ctx) == EGL_TRUE;
}

EGLDisplay EmbeddedCompositor::getEglDisplay() const {
    if (!m_renderer) return EGL_NO_DISPLAY;
    return wlr_bridge_get_egl_display(m_renderer);
}

EGLContext EmbeddedCompositor::getEglContext() const {
    if (!m_renderer) return EGL_NO_CONTEXT;
    return wlr_bridge_get_egl_context(m_renderer);
}

bool EmbeddedCompositor::initialize() {
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Initializing Wayland display server..." << std::endl;

    m_display = wlr_bridge_display_create();
    if (!m_display) {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Error: Failed to create Wayland display." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    m_eventLoop = wlr_bridge_display_get_event_loop(m_display);
    if (!m_eventLoop) {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Error: Failed to get Wayland event loop." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // Listen to incoming Wayland client connections
    m_clientCreatedListener = wlr_bridge_display_add_client_created_listener(
        m_display,
        [](void *user, struct wl_client *client) {
            static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleClientCreated(client);
        },
        this
    );

    // 1. Create headless backend for the embedded container
    m_backend = wlr_bridge_headless_backend_create(m_eventLoop);
    if (!m_backend) {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Error: Failed to create headless wlroots backend." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // 2. Hardware-accelerated GLES2 renderer bound to Intel / AMD / DRM render node
    setenv("WLR_RENDER_DRM_DEVICE", "/dev/dri/renderD128", 1);
    m_drmFd = open("/dev/dri/renderD128", O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (m_drmFd >= 0) {
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Opened DRM render node /dev/dri/renderD128 (fd: " << m_drmFd << ")" << std::endl;
        m_renderer = wlr_bridge_gles2_renderer_create_with_drm_fd(m_drmFd);
    }
    if (!m_renderer) {
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Falling back to wlr_renderer_autocreate..." << std::endl;
        m_renderer = wlr_bridge_renderer_autocreate(m_backend);
    }
    if (!m_renderer) {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Error: Failed to create wlroots renderer." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    m_allocator = wlr_bridge_allocator_autocreate(m_backend, m_renderer);
    if (!m_allocator) {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Error: Failed to create wlroots allocator." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // Bind renderer to Wayland display
    wlr_bridge_renderer_init_wl_display(m_renderer, m_display);

    // 3. Register virtual headless output and output layout for Android hwcomposer
    m_outputLayout = wlr_bridge_output_layout_create(m_display);
    m_headlessOutput = wlr_bridge_headless_add_output(m_backend, m_config.defaultWidth, m_config.defaultHeight);
    if (m_headlessOutput) {
        wlr_bridge_output_init_render(m_headlessOutput, m_allocator, m_renderer);
        wlr_bridge_output_configure(m_headlessOutput, m_config.defaultWidth, m_config.defaultHeight,
                                    m_config.refreshRate > 0 ? m_config.refreshRate : 60);
        wlr_bridge_output_layout_add_auto(m_outputLayout, m_headlessOutput);
        wlr_bridge_output_create_global(m_headlessOutput, m_display);
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Virtual headless output configured: "
                  << m_config.defaultWidth << "x" << m_config.defaultHeight << " @ "
                  << (m_config.refreshRate > 0 ? m_config.refreshRate : 60) << "Hz" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Warning: Failed to create headless output for container." << std::endl;
    }

    // XDG Output Manager
    m_xdgOutputManager = wlr_bridge_xdg_output_manager_create(m_display, m_outputLayout);
    if (m_xdgOutputManager) {
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] zxdg_output_manager_v1 interface registered." << std::endl;
    }

    // 4. Core Wayland Compositor (version 5) with renderer backing
    m_compositor = wlr_bridge_compositor_create(m_display, 5, m_renderer);
    m_newSurfaceListener = wlr_bridge_compositor_add_new_surface_listener(
        m_compositor,
        [](void *user, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
            static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleNewSurface(surface);
        },
        this
    );

    // Subcompositor & Data Device Manager
    m_subcompositor = wlr_bridge_subcompositor_create(m_display);
    m_dataDeviceManager = wlr_bridge_data_device_manager_create(m_display);

    // 5. Shared Memory (wl_shm) + Linux DMA-BUF v1 zero-copy buffer sharing
    m_shm = wlr_bridge_shm_create_with_renderer(m_display, 1, m_renderer);
    if (!m_shm) {
        wlr_bridge_display_init_shm(m_display);
    }
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] wl_shm interface registered." << std::endl;

    m_linuxDmabuf = wlr_bridge_linux_dmabuf_create(m_display, 4, m_renderer);
    if (!m_linuxDmabuf) {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Warning: Failed to create linux-dmabuf-v1 global." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] linux-dmabuf-v1 interface initialized for zero-copy DMA-BUF import." << std::endl;
    }

    // 6. Presentation Time Protocol for VSync frame synchronization feedback
    m_presentation = wlr_bridge_presentation_create(m_display, m_backend, 1);
    if (m_presentation) {
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] wp_presentation interface registered for VSync presentation feedback." << std::endl;
    }

    // 7. Viewporter & Single Pixel Buffer Manager
    m_viewporter = wlr_bridge_viewporter_create(m_display);
    if (m_viewporter) {
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] wp_viewporter interface registered." << std::endl;
    }
    m_singlePixelBuffer = wlr_bridge_single_pixel_buffer_create(m_display);

    // Fractional scale & Pointer constraints
    m_fractionalScale = wlr_bridge_fractional_scale_create(m_display, 1);
    if (m_fractionalScale) {
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] wp_fractional_scale_manager_v1 interface registered." << std::endl;
    }
    m_pointerConstraints = wlr_bridge_pointer_constraints_create(m_display);
    if (m_pointerConstraints) {
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] zwp_pointer_constraints_v1 interface registered." << std::endl;
    }

    // 8. XDG Shell v3 interface
    m_xdgShell = wlr_bridge_xdg_shell_create(m_display, 3);
    m_newXdgSurfaceListener = wlr_bridge_xdg_shell_add_new_surface_listener(
        m_xdgShell,
        [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdgSurface) {
            static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleNewXdgSurface(xdgSurface);
        },
        this
    );
    m_newXdgToplevelListener = wlr_bridge_xdg_shell_add_new_toplevel_listener(
        m_xdgShell,
        [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *toplevel) {
            static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleNewXdgToplevel(toplevel);
        },
        this
    );

    // 9. Wayland input seat (multi-touch, pointer, keyboard)
    m_seat = wlr_bridge_seat_create(m_display, "linstack-seat-0");
    wlr_bridge_seat_set_capabilities(m_seat,
                                    WLR_BRIDGE_SEAT_CAP_POINTER |
                                    WLR_BRIDGE_SEAT_CAP_KEYBOARD |
                                    WLR_BRIDGE_SEAT_CAP_TOUCH);

    // Initialize virtual keyboard directly via C bridge
    m_virtualKeyboard = wlr_bridge_virtual_keyboard_create(m_seat);

    // 10. Relative pointer manager for FPS mouse look
    m_relativePointerManager = wlr_bridge_relative_pointer_manager_create(m_display);

    // 11. Bind dedicated Wayland display socket
    const char *xdgRuntime = getenv("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR");
    if (xdgRuntime) {
        std::string sock = std::string(xdgRuntime) + "/" + m_config.socketName;
        std::string lock = sock + ".lock";
        unlink(sock.c_str());
        unlink(lock.c_str());
    }

    int res = wlr_bridge_display_add_socket(m_display, m_config.socketName.c_str());
    if (res != 0) {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Error: Failed to bind socket: " << m_config.socketName << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Successfully listening on Wayland socket: " << m_config.socketName << std::endl;
    return true;
}

bool EmbeddedCompositor::start() {
    if (!m_backend) return false;
    if (!wlr_bridge_backend_start(m_backend)) {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Error: Failed to start wlroots backend." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Headless backend running successfully." << std::endl;
    return true;
}

int EmbeddedCompositor::dispatch(int timeoutMs) {
    if (!m_display || !m_eventLoop) return -1;
    wlr_bridge_display_flush_clients(m_display);
    int res = wlr_bridge_event_loop_dispatch(m_eventLoop, timeoutMs);
    wlr_bridge_display_flush_clients(m_display);
    return res;
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::shutdown() {
    if (!m_display) return;

    EGLDisplay dpy = getEglDisplay();
    if (dpy != EGL_NO_DISPLAY) {
        eglMakeCurrent(dpy, EGL_NO_SURFACE, EGL_NO_SURFACE, EGL_NO_CONTEXT);
    }

    m_toplevelRecords.clear();
    m_surfaceRecords.clear();
    m_rawSurfaceRecords.clear();
    m_activeSurface = nullptr;
    m_activeToplevel = nullptr;

    if (m_clientCreatedListener) {
        wlr_bridge_listener_destroy(m_clientCreatedListener);
        m_clientCreatedListener = nullptr;
    }
    if (m_newSurfaceListener) {
        wlr_bridge_listener_destroy(m_newSurfaceListener);
        m_newSurfaceListener = nullptr;
    }
    if (m_newXdgSurfaceListener) {
        wlr_bridge_listener_destroy(m_newXdgSurfaceListener);
        m_newXdgSurfaceListener = nullptr;
    }
    if (m_newXdgToplevelListener) {
        wlr_bridge_listener_destroy(m_newXdgToplevelListener);
        m_newXdgToplevelListener = nullptr;
    }

    if (m_virtualKeyboard) {
        wlr_bridge_virtual_keyboard_destroy(m_virtualKeyboard);
        m_virtualKeyboard = nullptr;
    }

    if (m_outputLayout) {
        wlr_bridge_output_layout_destroy(m_outputLayout);
        m_outputLayout = nullptr;
    }
    m_headlessOutput = nullptr;

    if (m_backend) {
        wlr_bridge_backend_destroy(m_backend);
        m_backend = nullptr;
    }

    if (m_display) {
        wlr_bridge_display_destroy_clients(m_display);
        wlr_bridge_display_destroy(m_display);
        m_display = nullptr;
    }

    if (m_drmFd >= 0) {
        close(m_drmFd);
        m_drmFd = -1;
    }
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Compositor shutdown complete." << std::endl;
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleClientCreated(struct wl_client *client) {
    pid_t pid = 0;
    uid_t uid = 0;
    gid_t gid = 0;
    wlr_bridge_client_get_credentials(client, &pid, &uid, &gid);
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] >>> Wayland Client Connected: PID=" << pid
              << ", UID=" << uid << ", GID=" << gid << " <<<" << std::endl;
    if (onClientConnected) {
        onClientConnected(client);
    }
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleNewSurface(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!surface) return;
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] New wlr_surface created (" << surface << ")" << std::endl;

    auto record = std::unique_ptr<struct wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record, void(*)(struct wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record*)>(
        wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record_create(
            surface,
            [](void *user, struct wlr_surface *s) {
                static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleSurfaceCommit(s);
            },
            [](void *user, struct wlr_surface *s) {
                static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleRawSurfaceDestroy(s);
            },
            this
        ),
        wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record_destroy
    );

    if (record) {
        m_rawSurfaceRecords.push_back(std::move(record));
    }
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleRawSurfaceDestroy(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!surface) return;
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] wlr_surface destroyed (" << surface << ")" << std::endl;
    if (m_activeSurface == surface) {
        m_activeSurface = nullptr;
        for (const auto &rec : m_rawSurfaceRecords) {
            struct wlr_surface *s = wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record_get_surface(rec.get());
            if (s && s != surface && wlr_bridge_surface_has_buffer(s)) {
                m_activeSurface = s;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (onSurfaceUnmapped) {
            onSurfaceUnmapped(surface);
        }
    }

    auto it = std::remove_if(m_rawSurfaceRecords.begin(), m_rawSurfaceRecords.end(),
                             [surface](const auto &rec) {
                                 return wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record_get_surface(rec.get()) == surface;
                             });
    m_rawSurfaceRecords.erase(it, m_rawSurfaceRecords.end());
}

struct wlr_surface *EmbeddedCompositor::getRenderableSurface() const {
    struct wlr_surface *bestSurface = nullptr;
    int maxArea = 0;

    for (const auto &rec : m_rawSurfaceRecords) {
        struct wlr_surface *s = wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record_get_surface(rec.get());
        if (s && (wlr_bridge_surface_has_buffer(s) || wlr_bridge_surface_get_texture(s))) {
            int w = 0, h = 0;
            wlr_bridge_surface_get_size(s, &w, &h);
            int area = w * h;
            if (area > maxArea) {
                maxArea = area;
                bestSurface = s;
            }
        }
    }
    if (bestSurface) return bestSurface;
    return m_activeSurface;
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleNewXdgSurface(struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdgSurface) {
    if (!xdgSurface) return;

    struct wlr_surface *surf = wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_get_surface(xdgSurface);
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Incoming XDG surface created (surface: "
              << surf << ") — awaiting role assignment" << std::endl;

    auto record = std::unique_ptr<struct wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record, void(*)(struct wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record*)>(
        wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record_create(
            xdgSurface,
            [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xs) {
                static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleXdgSurfaceMap(xs);
            },
            [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xs) {
                static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleXdgSurfaceUnmap(xs);
            },
            [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xs) {
                static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleXdgSurfaceDestroy(xs);
            },
            [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xs) {
                EmbeddedCompositor *comp = static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user);
                struct wlr_surface *s = wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_get_surface(xs);
                struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *xdgToplevel = wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_try_from_surface(s);
                if (xdgToplevel && wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_is_initial_commit(xdgToplevel)) {
                    wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_set_size(xdgToplevel, comp->m_config.defaultWidth, comp->m_config.defaultHeight);
                    wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_set_activated(xdgToplevel, true);
                    wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_set_fullscreen(xdgToplevel, true);
                    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] initial_commit: configure "
                              << comp->m_config.defaultWidth << "x" << comp->m_config.defaultHeight
                              << " fullscreen+activated -> toplevel " << xdgToplevel << std::endl;
                }
                comp->handleSurfaceCommit(s);
            },
            this
        ),
        wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record_destroy
    );

    if (record) {
        m_surfaceRecords.push_back(std::move(record));
    }
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleXdgSurfaceMap(struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdgSurface) {
    if (!xdgSurface) return;
    struct wlr_surface *surf = wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_get_surface(xdgSurface);
    if (!surf) return;

    m_activeSurface = surf;
    struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *toplevel = wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_try_from_surface(surf);
    int surfW = 0, surfH = 0;
    wlr_bridge_surface_get_size(surf, &surfW, &surfH);

    if (toplevel && (surfW != m_config.defaultWidth || surfH != m_config.defaultHeight)) {
        wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_set_size(toplevel, m_config.defaultWidth, m_config.defaultHeight);
        wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_schedule_configure(xdgSurface);
    }
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Android Wayland surface mapped ("
              << surfW << "x" << surfH << ", surface: " << surf << ")" << std::endl;

    if (onSurfaceMapped) {
        onSurfaceMapped(m_activeSurface);
    }
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleXdgSurfaceUnmap(struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdgSurface) {
    if (!xdgSurface) return;
    struct wlr_surface *surf = wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_get_surface(xdgSurface);
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Android Wayland surface unmapped (" << surf << ")" << std::endl;
    if (m_activeSurface == surf) {
        m_activeSurface = nullptr;
    }
    if (onSurfaceUnmapped) {
        onSurfaceUnmapped(surf);
    }
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleXdgSurfaceDestroy(struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdgSurface) {
    if (!xdgSurface) return;
    struct wlr_surface *surf = wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_get_surface(xdgSurface);
    struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *top = wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_get_toplevel(xdgSurface);

    if (m_activeSurface == surf) {
        m_activeSurface = nullptr;
    }
    if (m_activeToplevel == top) {
        m_activeToplevel = nullptr;
    }

    auto it = std::remove_if(m_surfaceRecords.begin(), m_surfaceRecords.end(),
                             [xdgSurface](const auto &rec) {
                                 return wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record_get_xdg_surface(rec.get()) == xdgSurface;
                             });
    m_surfaceRecords.erase(it, m_surfaceRecords.end());
