}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleNewXdgToplevel(struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *toplevel) {
    if (!toplevel) return;

    struct wlr_surface *surf = wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_get_surface(toplevel);
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] >>> New XDG toplevel (role assigned): "
              << toplevel << " surface=" << surf << std::endl;

    m_activeToplevel = toplevel;

    auto record = std::unique_ptr<struct wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record, void(*)(struct wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record*)>(
        wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record_create(
            toplevel,
            [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *tl) {
                (void)user;
                if (tl && wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_is_initialized(tl)) {
                    wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_set_maximized(tl, true);
                    wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_schedule_configure(wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_get_base(tl));
                }
            },
            [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *tl) {
                (void)user;
                if (tl && wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_is_initialized(tl)) {
                    wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_set_fullscreen(tl, true);
                    wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_schedule_configure(wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_get_base(tl));
                    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Granted fullscreen to XDG toplevel" << std::endl;
                }
            },
            [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *tl) {
                (void)user;
                if (tl && wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_is_initialized(tl)) {
                    wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_schedule_configure(wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_get_base(tl));
                }
            },
            [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *tl) {
                EmbeddedCompositor *comp = static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user);
                if (comp->m_activeToplevel == tl) {
                    comp->m_activeToplevel = nullptr;
                }
                auto it = std::remove_if(comp->m_toplevelRecords.begin(), comp->m_toplevelRecords.end(),
                                         [tl](const auto &r) {
                                             return wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record_get_toplevel(r.get()) == tl;
                                         });
                comp->m_toplevelRecords.erase(it, comp->m_toplevelRecords.end());
                std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] XDG toplevel destroyed" << std::endl;
            },
            this
        ),
        wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record_destroy
    );

    if (record) {
        m_toplevelRecords.push_back(std::move(record));
    }
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleSurfaceCommit(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!surface) return;

    bool hasBuf = wlr_bridge_surface_has_buffer(surface);
    int surfW = 0, surfH = 0;
    wlr_bridge_surface_get_size(surface, &surfW, &surfH);

    if (!m_activeSurface && (hasBuf || surfW > 200)) {
        m_activeSurface = surface;
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Promoting wlr_surface " << surface << " to active surface" << std::endl;
        if (onSurfaceMapped) {
            onSurfaceMapped(m_activeSurface);
        }
    }

    if (onSurfaceCommit) {
        onSurfaceCommit(surface);
    }
}

--- FILE: ./wlroots_engine/src/InputMapper.cpp ---
#include "InputMapper.h"
#include <iostream>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

InputMapper::InputMapper(struct wlr_seat *seat, struct wlr_relative_pointer_manager_v1 *relPointerMgr)
: m_seat(seat)
, m_relPointerMgr(relPointerMgr)
{
    setupDefaultProfile();
}

InputMapper::~InputMapper() = default;

uint32_t InputMapper::getTimestampMs() const {
    auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch();
    return static_cast<uint32_t>(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(now).count());
}

int32_t InputMapper::allocateSlot() {
    for (int32_t s = 0; s < 10; ++s) {
        if (m_activeSlots.find(s) == m_activeSlots.end()) {
            m_activeSlots.insert(s);
            return s;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

void InputMapper::releaseSlot(int32_t slot) {
    if (slot >= 0) {
        m_activeSlots.erase(slot);
    }
}

void InputMapper::setGeometry(const ViewportRect &viewport, int androidWidth, int androidHeight) {
    m_viewport = viewport;
    m_androidWidth = std::max(1, androidWidth);
    m_androidHeight = std::max(1, androidHeight);
}

void InputMapper::windowToAndroid(int winX, int winY, double &outAndroidX, double &outAndroidY) const {
    if (m_viewport.width <= 0 || m_viewport.height <= 0) {
        outAndroidX = 0.0;
        outAndroidY = 0.0;
        return;
    }
    double relX = std::clamp(static_cast<double>(winX - m_viewport.x) / m_viewport.width, 0.0, 1.0);
    double relY = std::clamp(static_cast<double>(winY - m_viewport.y) / m_viewport.height, 0.0, 1.0);
    outAndroidX = relX * m_androidWidth;
    outAndroidY = relY * m_androidHeight;
}

void InputMapper::windowToNormalized(int winX, int winY, float &outNormX, float &outNormY) const {
    if (m_viewport.width <= 0 || m_viewport.height <= 0) {
        outNormX = 0.0f;
        outNormY = 0.0f;
        return;
    }
    outNormX = std::clamp(static_cast<float>(winX - m_viewport.x) / m_viewport.width, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    outNormY = std::clamp(static_cast<float>(winY - m_viewport.y) / m_viewport.height, 0.0f, 1.0f);
}

void InputMapper::setupDefaultProfile() {
    m_tapNodes.clear();
    m_tapNodes.push_back(KeyNode{"jump", WlrKeyNodeType::Tap, 65, 0.88f, 0.78f, 0});
    m_tapNodes.push_back(KeyNode{"reload", WlrKeyNodeType::Tap, 27, 0.88f, 0.52f, 0});
    m_tapNodes.push_back(KeyNode{"crouch", WlrKeyNodeType::Tap, 54, 0.82f, 0.86f, 0});
    m_tapNodes.push_back(KeyNode{"interact", WlrKeyNodeType::Tap, 26, 0.75f, 0.40f, 0});

    m_dpad.centerX = 0.18f;
    m_dpad.centerY = 0.70f;
    m_dpad.radius = 0.08f;
    m_dpad.scanUp = 25;
    m_dpad.scanLeft = 38;
    m_dpad.scanDown = 39;
    m_dpad.scanRight = 40;
    m_dpad.touchSlot = 0;

    m_aimNodes.clear();
    AimLockNodeConfig aim;
    aim.id = "aim_lock_1";
    aim.toggleScanCode = 67;
    aim.centerX = 0.50f;
    aim.centerY = 0.50f;
    aim.fireX = 0.82f;
    aim.fireY = 0.64f;
    aim.sensitivityX = 1.2f;
    aim.sensitivityY = 1.2f;
    aim.acceleration = false;
    aim.maxSweepRadius = 0.18f;
    aim.cameraTouchSlot = 0;
    aim.fireTouchSlot = 1;
    m_aimNodes.push_back(aim);
}

const AimLockNodeConfig* InputMapper::activeAimNode() const {
    if (m_aimLockActive && m_activeAimIndex >= 0 && m_activeAimIndex < static_cast<int>(m_aimNodes.size())) {
        return &m_aimNodes[m_activeAimIndex];
    }
    return nullptr;
}

const FreeLookConfig* InputMapper::activeFreeLookNode() const {
    if (m_freeLookActive && m_activeFreeLookIndex >= 0 && m_activeFreeLookIndex < static_cast<int>(m_freeLookNodes.size())) {
        return &m_freeLookNodes[m_activeFreeLookIndex];
    }
    return nullptr;
}

void InputMapper::setAimLockActive(bool active, int nodeIndex) {
    if (active && (nodeIndex < 0 || nodeIndex >= static_cast<int>(m_aimNodes.size()))) {
        return;
    }

    if (m_aimLockActive == active && (!active || m_activeAimIndex == nodeIndex)) {
        return;
    }

    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();

    if (m_aimLockActive && m_seat) {
        if (m_pendingReleaseCameraSlot >= 0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_pendingReleaseCameraSlot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            releaseSlot(m_pendingReleaseCameraSlot);
            m_pendingReleaseCameraSlot = -1;
        }
        if (m_activeAimCameraSlot >= 0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now + 1, m_activeAimCameraSlot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            releaseSlot(m_activeAimCameraSlot);
            m_activeAimCameraSlot = -1;
        }
        if (m_firing && m_activeAimFireSlot >= 0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now + 2, m_activeAimFireSlot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            releaseSlot(m_activeAimFireSlot);
            m_activeAimFireSlot = -1;
            m_firing = false;
        }
    }

    m_aimLockActive = active;
    m_activeAimIndex = active ? nodeIndex : -1;
    m_accumAimX = 0.0f;
    m_accumAimY = 0.0f;
    m_lastAimMoveMs = 0;
    m_smoothAimDx = 0.0f;
    m_smoothAimDy = 0.0f;
    m_aimNeedsTouchDown = true;
    if (!active && !m_aimSuspendedByFreeLook) {
        m_suspendedAimIndex = -1;
    }
}

void InputMapper::tick(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!m_seat || !surface) return;
    struct wlr_surface *rootSurf = wlr_bridge_surface_get_root_surface(surface);
    if (!rootSurf) rootSurf = surface;
    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();

    // 0. Aim Lock Idle Reset: silently reset touch point to anchor after 450ms of mouse idle
    if (m_aimLockActive && !m_freeLookActive && m_activeAimCameraSlot >= 0 && m_lastAimMoveMs > 0) {
        if (now - m_lastAimMoveMs >= 450) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_activeAimCameraSlot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            releaseSlot(m_activeAimCameraSlot);
            m_activeAimCameraSlot = -1;
            m_accumAimX = 0.0f;
            m_accumAimY = 0.0f;
            m_lastAimMoveMs = 0;
        }
    }

    // 1. Burst Tap (supports triggering multiple Burst buttons simultaneously)
    for (auto &kv : m_activeBursts) {
        for (ActiveBurst &b : kv.second) {
            uint32_t intervalMs = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::max(10, 1000 / std::clamp(b.cfg.burstHz, 1, 100)));
            if (b.isDown && (now - b.lastClickMs >= intervalMs / 2)) {
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, b.slot);
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
                b.isDown = false;
            } else if (!b.isDown && (now - b.lastClickMs >= intervalMs)) {
                double tx = b.cfg.relX * m_androidWidth;
                double ty = b.cfg.relY * m_androidHeight;
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, b.slot, tx, ty);
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
                b.isDown = true;
                b.lastClickMs = now;
            }
        }
    }

    // 2. Swipe
    for (auto it = m_activeSwipes.begin(); it != m_activeSwipes.end(); ) {
        uint32_t elapsed = now - it->startMs;
        float progress = std::clamp(static_cast<float>(elapsed) / std::max(1, it->cfg.durationMs), 0.0f, 1.0f);

        float rx = 0.0f, ry = 0.0f;
        if (it->cfg.pathPoints.size() >= 2) {
            float scaled = progress * (it->cfg.pathPoints.size() - 1);
            size_t idx0 = std::min(static_cast<size_t>(scaled), it->cfg.pathPoints.size() - 1);
            size_t idx1 = std::min(idx0 + 1, it->cfg.pathPoints.size() - 1);
            float localT = scaled - idx0;
            rx = it->cfg.pathPoints[idx0].first + (it->cfg.pathPoints[idx1].first - it->cfg.pathPoints[idx0].first) * localT;
            ry = it->cfg.pathPoints[idx0].second + (it->cfg.pathPoints[idx1].second - it->cfg.pathPoints[idx0].second) * localT;
        } else {
            rx = it->cfg.startX + (it->cfg.endX - it->cfg.startX) * progress;
            ry = it->cfg.startY + (it->cfg.endY - it->cfg.startY) * progress;
        }

        double ax = std::clamp(static_cast<double>(rx * m_androidWidth), 1.0, static_cast<double>(m_androidWidth - 2));
        double ay = std::clamp(static_cast<double>(ry * m_androidHeight), 1.0, static_cast<double>(m_androidHeight - 2));

        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_motion(m_seat, now, it->slot, ax, ay);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);

        if (progress >= 1.0f) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now + 1, it->slot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            releaseSlot(it->slot);
            it = m_activeSwipes.erase(it);
        } else {
            ++it;
        }
    }
}

void InputMapper::updateDpad(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!m_seat || !surface) return;
    struct wlr_surface *rootSurf = wlr_bridge_surface_get_root_surface(surface);
    if (!rootSurf) rootSurf = surface;

    bool up    = m_heldScanCodes.count(m_dpad.scanUp) > 0;
    bool down  = m_heldScanCodes.count(m_dpad.scanDown) > 0;
    bool left  = m_heldScanCodes.count(m_dpad.scanLeft) > 0;
    bool right = m_heldScanCodes.count(m_dpad.scanRight) > 0;

    float dx = 0.0f;
    float dy = 0.0f;

    if (up) dy -= 1.0f;
    if (down) dy += 1.0f;
    if (left) dx -= 1.0f;
    if (right) dx += 1.0f;

    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();

    if (dx == 0.0f && dy == 0.0f) {
        if (m_dpadActive && m_activeDpadSlot >= 0) {
            m_dpadActive = false;
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_activeDpadSlot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            releaseSlot(m_activeDpadSlot);
            m_activeDpadSlot = -1;
        }
        return;
    }

    float len = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    dx /= len;
    dy /= len;

    double centerX = m_dpad.centerX * m_androidWidth;
    double centerY = m_dpad.centerY * m_androidHeight;
    double targetX = (m_dpad.centerX + dx * m_dpad.radius) * m_androidWidth;
    double targetY = (m_dpad.centerY + dy * m_dpad.radius) * m_androidHeight;

    if (!m_dpadActive) {
        m_dpadActive = true;
        m_activeDpadSlot = allocateSlot();
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, m_activeDpadSlot, centerX, centerY);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_motion(m_seat, now + 1, m_activeDpadSlot, targetX, targetY);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
    } else if (m_activeDpadSlot >= 0) {
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_motion(m_seat, now, m_activeDpadSlot, targetX, targetY);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
    }
}


void InputMapper::sendRecentsCombo(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!m_seat || !surface) return;
    struct wlr_surface *rootSurf = wlr_bridge_surface_get_root_surface(surface);
    if (!rootSurf) rootSurf = surface;

    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_enter(m_seat, rootSurf);

    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_key(m_seat, now, 56, 1);
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_modifiers(m_seat);
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_key(m_seat, now + 10, 15, 1);
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_key(m_seat, now + 25, 15, 0);
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_key(m_seat, now + 35, 56, 0);
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_modifiers(m_seat);
}

void InputMapper::sendSystemKey(uint32_t evdevKeyCode, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!m_seat || !surface) return;
    struct wlr_surface *rootSurf = wlr_bridge_surface_get_root_surface(surface);
    if (!rootSurf) rootSurf = surface;

    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_enter(m_seat, rootSurf);

    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_key(m_seat, now, evdevKeyCode, 1);
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_key(m_seat, now + 15, evdevKeyCode, 0);
}

void InputMapper::forwardNativeKey(uint32_t scanCode, bool pressed, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!m_seat || !surface || scanCode == 0) return;
    struct wlr_surface *rootSurf = wlr_bridge_surface_get_root_surface(surface);
    if (!rootSurf) rootSurf = surface;

    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_enter(m_seat, rootSurf);

    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();
    uint32_t evdevKey = (scanCode >= 8) ? (scanCode - 8) : scanCode;
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_key(m_seat, now, evdevKey, pressed ? 1 : 0);
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_modifiers(m_seat);
}

bool InputMapper::handleScanCodeDown(uint32_t scanCode, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (scanCode == 0) return false;

    for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(m_aimNodes.size()); ++i) {
        if (m_aimNodes[i].toggleScanCode == scanCode) {
            if (m_aimLockActive && m_activeAimIndex == i) {
                setAimLockActive(false, -1);
            } else {
                setAimLockActive(true, i);
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    if (scanCode == 9) {
        bool handledEsc = false;
        if (m_aimLockActive) {
            setAimLockActive(false, -1);
            handledEsc = true;
        }
        if (m_freeLookActive && m_seat) {
            uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();
            m_freeLookActive = false;
            m_activeFreeLookIndex = -1;
            if (m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot >= 0) {
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot);
                releaseSlot(m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot);
                m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot = -1;
            }
            if (m_activeFreeLookSlot >= 0) {
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now + 1, m_activeFreeLookSlot);
                releaseSlot(m_activeFreeLookSlot);
                m_activeFreeLookSlot = -1;
            }
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            handledEsc = true;
        }
        if (handledEsc) return true;
    }

    m_heldScanCodes.insert(scanCode);
    bool handled = false;

    if (scanCode == m_dpad.scanUp || scanCode == m_dpad.scanDown ||
        scanCode == m_dpad.scanLeft || scanCode == m_dpad.scanRight) {
        updateDpad(surface);
        handled = true;
    }

    if (!m_seat || !surface) return handled;
    struct wlr_surface *rootSurf = wlr_bridge_surface_get_root_surface(surface);
    if (!rootSurf) rootSurf = surface;
    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();

    // 1. Free Look
    for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(m_freeLookNodes.size()); ++i) {
        if (m_freeLookNodes[i].holdScanCode == scanCode) {
            if (!m_freeLookActive) {
                if (m_aimLockActive) {
                    m_aimSuspendedByFreeLook = true;
                    m_suspendedAimIndex = m_activeAimIndex;
                    setAimLockActive(false, -1);
                    m_aimSuspendedByFreeLook = true;
                }
                m_freeLookActive = true;
                m_activeFreeLookIndex = i;
                m_accumFreeLookX = 0.0f;
                m_accumFreeLookY = 0.0f;
            }
            handled = true;
            break;
        }
    }

    // 2. Burst Tap (trigger all Burst buttons bound to this key simultaneously)
    if (m_activeBursts.find(scanCode) == m_activeBursts.end()) {
        std::vector<ActiveBurst> bursts;
        for (const auto &bn : m_burstNodes) {
            if (bn.scanCode == scanCode) {
                ActiveBurst ab;
                ab.cfg = bn;
                ab.slot = allocateSlot();
                ab.lastClickMs = now;
                ab.isDown = true;
                bursts.push_back(ab);

                double tx = bn.relX * m_androidWidth;
                double ty = bn.relY * m_androidHeight;
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, ab.slot, tx, ty);
            }
        }
        if (!bursts.empty()) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            m_activeBursts[scanCode] = std::move(bursts);
            handled = true;
        }
    } else {
        handled = true;
    }

    // 3. Swipe (trigger all Swipe paths bound to this key simultaneously)
    bool anySwipe = false;
    for (const auto &sw : m_swipeNodes) {
        if (sw.scanCode == scanCode) {
            ActiveSwipe as;
            as.cfg = sw;
            as.slot = allocateSlot();
            as.startMs = now;
            m_activeSwipes.push_back(as);

            double sx = sw.startX * m_androidWidth;
            double sy = sw.startY * m_androidHeight;
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, as.slot, sx, sy);
            anySwipe = true;
        }
    }
    if (anySwipe) {
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        handled = true;
    }

    // 4. Smart Cast (trigger all Smart Cast buttons bound to this key simultaneously)
    bool anySmartCast = false;
    for (const auto &sc : m_smartCastNodes) {
        if (sc.scanCode == scanCode) {
            bool alreadyActive = false;
            for (const auto &asc : m_activeSmartCasts) {
                if (asc.cfg.id == sc.id && asc.cfg.scanCode == scanCode) {
                    alreadyActive = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!alreadyActive) {
                ActiveSmartCast asc;
                asc.cfg = sc;
                asc.slot = allocateSlot();
                asc.accumX = 0.0f;
                asc.accumY = 0.0f;
                m_activeSmartCasts.push_back(asc);

                double cx = sc.centerX * m_androidWidth;
                double cy = sc.centerY * m_androidHeight;
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, asc.slot, cx, cy);
                anySmartCast = true;
            }
            handled = true;
        }
    }
    if (anySmartCast) {
        m_smartCasting = true;
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
    }

    // 5. Tap (trigger all Tap buttons bound to this key simultaneously)
    if (m_scanCodeToSlots.find(scanCode) == m_scanCodeToSlots.end()) {
        std::vector<int32_t> slots;
        for (const auto &node : m_tapNodes) {
            if (node.scanCode == scanCode) {
                int32_t slot = allocateSlot();
                slots.push_back(slot);

                double tx = node.relX * m_androidWidth;
                double ty = node.relY * m_androidHeight;
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, slot, tx, ty);
            }
        }
        if (!slots.empty()) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            m_scanCodeToSlots[scanCode] = std::move(slots);
            handled = true;
        }
    } else {
        handled = true;
    }

    return handled;
}

bool InputMapper::handleScanCodeUp(uint32_t scanCode, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (scanCode == 0) return false;
    m_heldScanCodes.erase(scanCode);

    bool handled = false;
    if (scanCode == m_dpad.scanUp || scanCode == m_dpad.scanDown ||
        scanCode == m_dpad.scanLeft || scanCode == m_dpad.scanRight) {
        updateDpad(surface);
        handled = true;
    }

    if (!m_seat) return handled;
    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();

    // Free Look release
    if (m_freeLookActive && m_activeFreeLookIndex >= 0 &&
        m_freeLookNodes[m_activeFreeLookIndex].holdScanCode == scanCode) {
        m_freeLookActive = false;
        m_activeFreeLookIndex = -1;
        if (m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot >= 0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot);
            releaseSlot(m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot);
            m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot = -1;
        }
        if (m_activeFreeLookSlot >= 0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now + 1, m_activeFreeLookSlot);
            releaseSlot(m_activeFreeLookSlot);
            m_activeFreeLookSlot = -1;
        }
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        if (m_aimSuspendedByFreeLook && m_suspendedAimIndex >= 0) {
            int restoreIdx = m_suspendedAimIndex;
            m_aimSuspendedByFreeLook = false;
            m_suspendedAimIndex = -1;
            setAimLockActive(true, restoreIdx);
        }
        handled = true;
    }

    // Burst Tap release (release all Burst buttons bound to this key)
    auto burstIt = m_activeBursts.find(scanCode);
    if (burstIt != m_activeBursts.end()) {
        bool anyUp = false;
        for (const auto &b : burstIt->second) {
            if (b.isDown) {
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, b.slot);
                anyUp = true;
            }
            releaseSlot(b.slot);
        }
        if (anyUp) wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        m_activeBursts.erase(burstIt);
        handled = true;
    }

    // Smart Cast release (release all Smart Cast buttons bound to this key)
    bool anyScUp = false;
    for (auto it = m_activeSmartCasts.begin(); it != m_activeSmartCasts.end(); ) {
        if (it->cfg.scanCode == scanCode) {
            if (it->slot >= 0) {
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, it->slot);
                releaseSlot(it->slot);
                anyScUp = true;
            }
            it = m_activeSmartCasts.erase(it);
            handled = true;
        } else {
            ++it;
        }
    }
    if (anyScUp) {
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
    }
    m_smartCasting = !m_activeSmartCasts.empty();

    // Tap release (release all Tap buttons bound to this key)
    auto it = m_scanCodeToSlots.find(scanCode);
    if (it != m_scanCodeToSlots.end()) {
        for (int32_t slot : it->second) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, slot);
            releaseSlot(slot);
        }
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        m_scanCodeToSlots.erase(it);
        handled = true;
    }

    return handled;
}

bool InputMapper::handleMappedMouseDown(int button, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (button <= 1 || !m_seat || !surface) return false;
    struct wlr_surface *rootSurf = wlr_bridge_surface_get_root_surface(surface);
    if (!rootSurf) rootSurf = surface;
    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();

    for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(m_aimNodes.size()); ++i) {
        if (m_aimNodes[i].toggleMouseButton == button) {
            if (m_aimLockActive && m_activeAimIndex == i) setAimLockActive(false, -1);
            else setAimLockActive(true, i);
            return true;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(m_freeLookNodes.size()); ++i) {
        if (m_freeLookNodes[i].holdMouseButton == button) {
            if (!m_freeLookActive) {
                if (m_aimLockActive) {
                    m_aimSuspendedByFreeLook = true;
                    m_suspendedAimIndex = m_activeAimIndex;
                    setAimLockActive(false, -1);
                    m_aimSuspendedByFreeLook = true;
                }
                m_freeLookActive = true;
                m_activeFreeLookIndex = i;
                m_accumFreeLookX = 0.0f;
                m_accumFreeLookY = 0.0f;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
    bool handled = false;
    uint32_t pseudoKey = 0x10000 + button;

    if (m_activeBursts.find(pseudoKey) == m_activeBursts.end()) {
        std::vector<ActiveBurst> bursts;
        for (const auto &bn : m_burstNodes) {
            if (bn.mouseButton == button) {
                ActiveBurst ab{bn, allocateSlot(), now, true};
                bursts.push_back(ab);
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, ab.slot, bn.relX * m_androidWidth, bn.relY * m_androidHeight);
            }
        }
        if (!bursts.empty()) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            m_activeBursts[pseudoKey] = std::move(bursts);
            handled = true;
        }
    } else {
        handled = true;
    }

    bool anySwipe = false;
    for (const auto &sw : m_swipeNodes) {
        if (sw.mouseButton == button) {
            ActiveSwipe as{sw, allocateSlot(), now};
            m_activeSwipes.push_back(as);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, as.slot, sw.startX * m_androidWidth, sw.startY * m_androidHeight);
            anySwipe = true;
        }
    }
    if (anySwipe) {
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        handled = true;
    }

    bool anySc = false;
    for (const auto &sc : m_smartCastNodes) {
        if (sc.mouseButton == button) {
            bool alreadyActive = false;
            for (const auto &asc : m_activeSmartCasts) {
                if (asc.cfg.id == sc.id && asc.cfg.mouseButton == button) {
                    alreadyActive = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!alreadyActive) {
                ActiveSmartCast asc{sc, allocateSlot(), 0.0f, 0.0f};
                m_activeSmartCasts.push_back(asc);
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, asc.slot, sc.centerX * m_androidWidth, sc.centerY * m_androidHeight);
                anySc = true;
            }
            handled = true;
        }
    }
    if (anySc) {
        m_smartCasting = true;
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
    }

    if (m_mouseBtnToSlots.find(button) == m_mouseBtnToSlots.end()) {
        std::vector<int32_t> slots;
        for (const auto &node : m_tapNodes) {
            if (node.mouseButton == button) {
                int32_t slot = allocateSlot();
                slots.push_back(slot);
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, slot, node.relX * m_androidWidth, node.relY * m_androidHeight);
            }
        }
        if (!slots.empty()) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            m_mouseBtnToSlots[button] = std::move(slots);
            handled = true;
        }
    } else {
        handled = true;
    }

    return handled;
}

bool InputMapper::handleMappedMouseUp(int button, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    (void)surface;
    if (button <= 1 || !m_seat) return false;
    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();
    bool handled = false;

    if (m_freeLookActive && m_activeFreeLookIndex >= 0 &&
        m_freeLookNodes[m_activeFreeLookIndex].holdMouseButton == button) {
        m_freeLookActive = false;
        m_activeFreeLookIndex = -1;
        if (m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot >= 0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot);
            releaseSlot(m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot);
            m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot = -1;
        }
        if (m_activeFreeLookSlot >= 0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now + 1, m_activeFreeLookSlot);
            releaseSlot(m_activeFreeLookSlot);
            m_activeFreeLookSlot = -1;
        }
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        if (m_aimSuspendedByFreeLook && m_suspendedAimIndex >= 0) {
            int restoreIdx = m_suspendedAimIndex;
            m_aimSuspendedByFreeLook = false;
            m_suspendedAimIndex = -1;
            setAimLockActive(true, restoreIdx);
        }
        handled = true;
    }

    uint32_t pseudoKey = 0x10000 + button;
    auto burstIt = m_activeBursts.find(pseudoKey);
    if (burstIt != m_activeBursts.end()) {
        bool anyUp = false;
        for (const auto &b : burstIt->second) {
            if (b.isDown) {
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, b.slot);
                anyUp = true;
            }
            releaseSlot(b.slot);
        }
        if (anyUp) wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        m_activeBursts.erase(burstIt);
        handled = true;
    }

    bool anyScUp = false;
    for (auto it = m_activeSmartCasts.begin(); it != m_activeSmartCasts.end(); ) {
        if (it->cfg.mouseButton == button) {
            if (it->slot >= 0) {
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, it->slot);
                releaseSlot(it->slot);
                anyScUp = true;
            }
            it = m_activeSmartCasts.erase(it);
            handled = true;
        } else {
            ++it;
        }
    }
    if (anyScUp) wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
    m_smartCasting = !m_activeSmartCasts.empty();

    auto it = m_mouseBtnToSlots.find(button);
    if (it != m_mouseBtnToSlots.end()) {
        for (int32_t slot : it->second) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, slot);
            releaseSlot(slot);
        }
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        m_mouseBtnToSlots.erase(it);
        handled = true;
    }

    return handled;
}

bool InputMapper::handleMouseDown(int button, int winX, int winY, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!m_seat || !surface) return false;
    struct wlr_surface *rootSurf = wlr_bridge_surface_get_root_surface(surface);
    if (!rootSurf) rootSurf = surface;
    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();

    if (button > 1 && handleMappedMouseDown(button, surface)) {
        return true;
    }

    const auto *aim = activeAimNode();
    if (aim) {
        if (button == 1 && !m_firing) {
            m_firing = true;
            m_activeAimFireSlot = allocateSlot();
            double fx = aim->fireX * m_androidWidth;
            double fy = aim->fireY * m_androidHeight;
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, m_activeAimFireSlot, fx, fy);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    if (button == 1 && !m_isTouching) {
        m_isTouching = true;
        m_activeMouseSlot = allocateSlot();
        double ax, ay;
        windowToAndroid(winX, winY, ax, ay);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, m_activeMouseSlot, ax, ay);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

bool InputMapper::handleMouseUp(int button, int winX, int winY, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    (void)winX;
    (void)winY;
    (void)surface;

    if (!m_seat) return false;
    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();

    if (button > 1 && handleMappedMouseUp(button, surface)) {
        return true;
    }

    const auto *aim = activeAimNode();
    if (aim) {
        if (button == 1 && m_firing) {
            m_firing = false;
            if (m_activeAimFireSlot >= 0) {
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_activeAimFireSlot);
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
                releaseSlot(m_activeAimFireSlot);
                m_activeAimFireSlot = -1;
            }
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    if (button == 1 && m_isTouching) {
        m_isTouching = false;
        if (m_activeMouseSlot >= 0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_activeMouseSlot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            releaseSlot(m_activeMouseSlot);
            m_activeMouseSlot = -1;
        }
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

bool InputMapper::handleMouseMove(int winX, int winY, float deltaX, float deltaY, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!m_seat || !surface) return false;
    struct wlr_surface *rootSurf = wlr_bridge_surface_get_root_surface(surface);
    if (!rootSurf) rootSurf = surface;
    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();

    // 1. Smart Cast (move all active Smart Cast nodes simultaneously)
    if (m_smartCasting && !m_activeSmartCasts.empty()) {
        for (auto &asc : m_activeSmartCasts) {
            if (asc.slot < 0) continue;
            double cx = asc.cfg.centerX * m_androidWidth;
            double cy = asc.cfg.centerY * m_androidHeight;

            float mx = 0.0f, my = 0.0f;
            if (m_aimLockActive && (deltaX != 0 || deltaY != 0)) {
                asc.accumX += deltaX * 1.5f;
                asc.accumY += deltaY * 1.5f;
                mx = asc.accumX;
                my = asc.accumY;
            } else {
                double ax, ay;
                windowToAndroid(winX, winY, ax, ay);
                mx = static_cast<float>(ax - cx);
                my = static_cast<float>(ay - cy);
            }

            float dist = std::sqrt(mx * mx + my * my);
            float maxR = asc.cfg.castRadius;
            if (dist > maxR && dist > 0.001f) {
                mx = (mx / dist) * maxR;
                my = (my / dist) * maxR;
                asc.accumX = mx;
                asc.accumY = my;
            }

            double tx = std::clamp(cx + mx, 2.0, static_cast<double>(m_androidWidth - 3));
            double ty = std::clamp(cy + my, 2.0, static_cast<double>(m_androidHeight - 3));
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_motion(m_seat, now, asc.slot, tx, ty);
        }
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        return true;
    }

    // 2. Infinite Unbounded Free Look (1:1 Linear, Zero Acceleration, Zero Drift, No Limits)
    if (m_freeLookActive && m_activeFreeLookIndex >= 0 && m_activeFreeLookIndex < static_cast<int>(m_freeLookNodes.size())) {
        const auto &fl = m_freeLookNodes[m_activeFreeLookIndex];
        float rawDx = deltaX;
        float rawDy = deltaY;
        if (rawDx == 0.0f && rawDy == 0.0f) return true;

        const float refScale = static_cast<float>(std::max(1, m_viewport.height));
        float pixelDx = (rawDx * fl.sensitivityX) * (static_cast<float>(m_androidHeight) / refScale);
        float pixelDy = (rawDy * fl.sensitivityY) * (static_cast<float>(m_androidHeight) / refScale);

        const double startX = std::clamp(static_cast<double>(fl.centerX * m_androidWidth), m_androidWidth * 0.05, m_androidWidth * 0.95);
        const double startY = std::clamp(static_cast<double>(fl.centerY * m_androidHeight), m_androidHeight * 0.05, m_androidHeight * 0.95);

        if (m_activeFreeLookSlot < 0) {
            m_activeFreeLookSlot = allocateSlot();
            m_accumFreeLookX = static_cast<float>(startX);
            m_accumFreeLookY = static_cast<float>(startY);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, m_activeFreeLookSlot, startX, startY);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        }

        m_accumFreeLookX += pixelDx;
        m_accumFreeLookY += pixelDy;
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_motion(m_seat, now, m_activeFreeLookSlot, m_accumFreeLookX, m_accumFreeLookY);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        return true;
    }

    // 3. Pure 1:1 Linear Aim Lock (Zero Acceleration, Zero Drift, ±10,000px + 450ms Idle Reset)
    const auto *aim = activeAimNode();
    if (aim && !m_freeLookActive) {
        float rawDx = deltaX;
        float rawDy = deltaY;
        if (rawDx == 0.0f && rawDy == 0.0f) return true;

        m_lastAimMoveMs = now;

        const float refScale = static_cast<float>(std::max(1, m_viewport.height));
        float pixelDx = (rawDx * aim->sensitivityX) * (static_cast<float>(m_androidHeight) / refScale);
        float pixelDy = (rawDy * aim->sensitivityY) * (static_cast<float>(m_androidHeight) / refScale);

        const double startX = std::clamp(static_cast<double>(aim->centerX * m_androidWidth), m_androidWidth * 0.55, m_androidWidth * 0.85);
        const double startY = std::clamp(static_cast<double>(aim->centerY * m_androidHeight), m_androidHeight * 0.25, m_androidHeight * 0.75);

        if (m_activeAimCameraSlot < 0) {
            m_activeAimCameraSlot = allocateSlot();
            m_accumAimX = static_cast<float>(startX);
            m_accumAimY = static_cast<float>(startY);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, m_activeAimCameraSlot, startX, startY);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        }

        m_accumAimX += pixelDx;
        m_accumAimY += pixelDy;

        if (std::abs(m_accumAimX - startX) >= 10000.0 || std::abs(m_accumAimY - startY) >= 10000.0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_activeAimCameraSlot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            releaseSlot(m_activeAimCameraSlot);
            m_activeAimCameraSlot = -1;
            m_accumAimX = 0.0f;
            m_accumAimY = 0.0f;
            return true;
        }

        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_motion(m_seat, now, m_activeAimCameraSlot, m_accumAimX, m_accumAimY);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        return true;
    }

    if (!m_isTouching || m_activeMouseSlot < 0) return false;

    double ax, ay;
    windowToAndroid(winX, winY, ax, ay);
    wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_motion(m_seat, now, m_activeMouseSlot, ax, ay);
    wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
    return true;
}

--- FILE: ./wlroots_engine/src/main.cpp ---
#include "EmbeddedCompositor.h"
#include "WaylandSurfaceRenderer.h"
#include "InputMapper.h"
#include "AspectRatioWindow.h"

#include <iostream>
#include <csignal>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <thread>

static std::atomic<bool> g_running{true};

static void sigHandler(int sig) {
    (void)sig;
    g_running = false;
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    std::cout << "========================================================" << std::endl;
    std::cout << "  LinStack Embedded wlroots Compositor Engine v1.0      " << std::endl;
    std::cout << "  Native Waydroid / Android Container Integration       " << std::endl;
    std::cout << "========================================================" << std::endl;

    std::signal(SIGINT, sigHandler);
    std::signal(SIGTERM, sigHandler);

    // 1. Configure Compositor with dedicated socket and resolution
    EmbeddedCompositorConfig config;
    config.socketName = "wayland-linstack-0";
    config.defaultWidth = 1920;
    config.defaultHeight = 1080;

    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        std::string arg = argv[i];
        if (arg == "--socket" && i + 1 < argc) {
            config.socketName = argv[++i];
        } else if (arg == "--res" && i + 1 < argc) {
            std::string resStr = argv[++i];
            size_t xPos = resStr.find('x');
            if (xPos != std::string::npos) {
                config.defaultWidth = std::stoi(resStr.substr(0, xPos));
                config.defaultHeight = std::stoi(resStr.substr(xPos + 1));
            }
        }
    }

    EmbeddedCompositor compositor(config);

    if (!compositor.initialize()) {
        std::cerr << "[Main] Fatal: Failed to initialize embedded compositor." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

    if (!compositor.start()) {
        std::cerr << "[Main] Fatal: Failed to start wlroots backend." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

    // Bind EGL context to current thread
    compositor.makeCurrent();

    // 2. Initialize Hardware-Accelerated Zero-Copy Renderer
    WaylandSurfaceRenderer renderer;
    // Renderer GLES2 shader compilation
    renderer.initialize();

    // 3. Aspect Ratio and Window geometry manager
    AspectRatioWindow window(config.defaultWidth, config.defaultHeight);
    int currentWinWidth = 1280;
    int currentWinHeight = 720;
    ViewportRect viewport = window.computeViewport(currentWinWidth, currentWinHeight);

    // 4. Native Multi-Touch Input Engine
    InputMapper inputMapper(compositor.getSeat(), compositor.getRelativePointerManager());
    inputMapper.setGeometry(viewport, config.defaultWidth, config.defaultHeight);

    // Setup default game profile
    inputMapper.setupDefaultProfile();

    // 5. Connect Surface lifecycle callbacks
    compositor.onSurfaceMapped = [&](struct wlr_surface *surface) {
        std::cout << "[Main] >>> Android Surface is now ACTIVE and rendering inside viewport <<<" << std::endl;
    };

    compositor.onSurfaceUnmapped = [&](struct wlr_surface *surface) {
        (void)surface;
        std::cout << "[Main] <<< Android Surface unmapped >>>" << std::endl;
    };

    compositor.onSurfaceCommit = [&](struct wlr_surface *surface) {
        // Zero-copy render loop invocation on client commit
        renderer.clearLetterboxBars(viewport, currentWinWidth, currentWinHeight);
        if (renderer.renderSurface(surface, viewport, currentWinWidth, currentWinHeight)) {
            // Signal SurfaceFlinger that the frame has been presented
            renderer.sendFrameDone(surface);
        }
    };

    std::cout << "\n[Main] Compositor is READY." << std::endl;
    std::cout << "[Main] Socket: " << compositor.getSocketName() << std::endl;
    std::cout << "[Main] Launch container with:" << std::endl;
    std::cout << "  export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=" << compositor.getSocketName() << std::endl;
    std::cout << "  waydroid session start" << std::endl;
    std::cout << "  waydroid show-full-ui\n" << std::endl;

    // Main event loop
    while (g_running) {
        // Dispatch Wayland events (16ms = ~60 FPS polling timeout)
        compositor.dispatch(16);

        // Check if an active Android surface exists to render
        struct wlr_surface *activeSurface = compositor.getActiveSurface();
        if (activeSurface) {
            renderer.clearLetterboxBars(viewport, currentWinWidth, currentWinHeight);
            if (renderer.renderSurface(activeSurface, viewport, currentWinWidth, currentWinHeight)) {
                renderer.sendFrameDone(activeSurface);
            }
        }

        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
    }

    std::cout << "[Main] Stopping embedded compositor..." << std::endl;
    compositor.shutdown();

    return 0;
}

--- FILE: ./wlroots_engine/src/AspectRatioWindow.cpp ---
#include "AspectRatioWindow.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

AspectRatioWindow::AspectRatioWindow(int targetWidth, int targetHeight) {
    setTargetResolution(targetWidth, targetHeight);
}

AspectRatioWindow::~AspectRatioWindow() = default;

void AspectRatioWindow::setTargetResolution(int width, int height) {
    m_targetWidth = std::max(1, width);
    m_targetHeight = std::max(1, height);
    m_aspectRatio = static_cast<float>(m_targetWidth) / static_cast<float>(m_targetHeight);
}

ViewportRect AspectRatioWindow::computeViewport(int windowWidth, int windowHeight) const {
    if (windowWidth <= 0 || windowHeight <= 0) {
        return ViewportRect{0, 0, m_targetWidth, m_targetHeight};
    }

    int vpW = 0;
    int vpH = 0;

    // Compare aspect ratio of window against target aspect ratio
    if (windowWidth * m_targetHeight > windowHeight * m_targetWidth) {
        // Window is wider than target ratio -> Pillarbox (vertical bars on sides)
        vpH = windowHeight;
        vpW = static_cast<int>(std::round(vpH * (static_cast<float>(m_targetWidth) / m_targetHeight)));
    } else {
        // Window is taller than target ratio -> Letterbox (horizontal bars top & bottom)
        vpW = windowWidth;
        vpH = static_cast<int>(std::round(vpW * (static_cast<float>(m_targetHeight) / m_targetWidth)));
    }

    int vpX = (windowWidth - vpW) / 2;
    int vpY = (windowHeight - vpH) / 2;

    return ViewportRect{vpX, vpY, vpW, vpH};
}

void AspectRatioWindow::snapSizeToAspectRatio(int &inOutWidth, int &inOutHeight, bool anchorWidth) const {
    if (anchorWidth) {
        inOutHeight = static_cast<int>(std::round(inOutWidth / m_aspectRatio));
    } else {
        inOutWidth = static_cast<int>(std::round(inOutHeight * m_aspectRatio));
    }
}

    wlr_output_state_set_enabled(&state, true);
    int mhz = (refresh_hz > 0 ? refresh_hz : 60) * 1000;
    wlr_output_state_set_custom_mode(&state, width, height, mhz);
    bool ok = wlr_output_commit_state(output, &state);
    wlr_output_state_finish(&state);
    return ok;
}

    if (!display || !name) return NULL;
    return wlr_seat_create(display, name);
}

void wlr_bridge_seat_set_capabilities(struct wlr_seat *seat, uint32_t caps) {
    if (!seat) return;
    uint32_t wl_caps = 0;
    if (caps & WLR_BRIDGE_SEAT_CAP_POINTER)  wl_caps |= WL_SEAT_CAPABILITY_POINTER;
    if (caps & WLR_BRIDGE_SEAT_CAP_KEYBOARD) wl_caps |= WL_SEAT_CAPABILITY_KEYBOARD;
    if (caps & WLR_BRIDGE_SEAT_CAP_TOUCH)    wl_caps |= WL_SEAT_CAPABILITY_TOUCH;
    wlr_seat_set_capabilities(seat, wl_caps);
}

struct wlr_keyboard *wlr_bridge_virtual_keyboard_create(struct wlr_seat *seat) {
    if (!seat) return NULL;
    struct wlr_keyboard *kbd = calloc(1, sizeof(*kbd));
    if (!kbd) return NULL;

    static const struct wlr_keyboard_impl virtual_kbd_impl = {
        .name = "linstack-virtual-kbd",
        .led_update = NULL
    };
#if WLR_VERSION_MINOR >= 18
    wlr_keyboard_init(kbd, &virtual_kbd_impl, "linstack-virtual-kbd");
#else
    wlr_keyboard_init(kbd, &virtual_kbd_impl);
#endif

    struct xkb_context *ctx = xkb_context_new(XKB_CONTEXT_NO_FLAGS);
    if (ctx) {
        struct xkb_keymap *keymap = xkb_keymap_new_from_names(ctx, NULL, XKB_KEYMAP_COMPILE_NO_FLAGS);
        if (keymap) {
            wlr_keyboard_set_keymap(kbd, keymap);
            wlr_seat_set_keyboard(seat, kbd);
            xkb_keymap_unref(keymap);
        }
        xkb_context_unref(ctx);
    }
    return kbd;
}

void wlr_bridge_virtual_keyboard_destroy(struct wlr_keyboard *keyboard) {
    if (!keyboard) return;
    wlr_keyboard_finish(keyboard);
    free(keyboard);
}

void wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(struct wlr_seat *seat, struct wlr_surface *surface,
                                       uint32_t time_ms, int32_t touch_id, double sx, double sy) {
    if (seat && surface) {
        wlr_seat_touch_notify_down(seat, surface, time_ms, touch_id, sx, sy);
    }
}

    }
}

    }
}

void wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(struct wlr_seat *seat) {
    if (seat) {
        wlr_seat_touch_notify_frame(seat);
    }
}

void wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_enter(struct wlr_seat *seat, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!seat || !surface) return;
    struct wlr_keyboard *kbd = wlr_seat_get_keyboard(seat);
    if (kbd) {
        wlr_seat_keyboard_notify_enter(seat, surface, kbd->keycodes, kbd->num_keycodes, &kbd->modifiers);
    } else {
        wlr_seat_keyboard_notify_enter(seat, surface, NULL, 0, NULL);
    }
}

void wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_key(struct wlr_seat *seat, uint32_t time_ms, uint32_t key, uint32_t state) {
    if (seat) {
        wlr_seat_keyboard_notify_key(seat, time_ms, key, state);
    }
}

void wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_modifiers(struct wlr_seat *seat) {
    if (seat) {
        struct wlr_keyboard *kbd = wlr_seat_get_keyboard(seat);
        if (kbd) {
            wlr_seat_keyboard_notify_modifiers(seat, &kbd->modifiers);
        } else {
            wlr_seat_keyboard_notify_modifiers(seat, NULL);
        }
    }
}

bool wlr_bridge_surface_has_buffer(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!surface) return false;
    return wlr_surface_has_buffer(surface);
}

void wlr_bridge_surface_get_size(struct wlr_surface *surface, int *w, int *h) {
    if (!surface) {
        if (w) *w = 0;
        if (h) *h = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (w) *w = surface->current.width;
    if (h) *h = surface->current.height;
}

struct wlr_texture *wlr_bridge_surface_get_texture(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!surface) return NULL;
    return wlr_surface_get_texture(surface);
}

void wlr_bridge_surface_send_frame_done(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!surface) return;
    struct timespec now;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now);
    wlr_surface_send_frame_done(surface, &now);
}

bool wlr_bridge_surface_get_dmabuf(struct wlr_surface *surface, struct wlr_bridge_dmabuf_attribs *out) {
    if (!surface || !surface->buffer || !out) return false;
    struct wlr_dmabuf_attributes dmabuf = {0};
    if (!wlr_buffer_get_dmabuf(&surface->buffer->base, &dmabuf)) {
        return false;
    }
    out->width = dmabuf.width;
    out->height = dmabuf.height;
    out->format = dmabuf.format;
    out->modifier = dmabuf.modifier;
    out->n_planes = dmabuf.n_planes;
    for (int i = 0; i < dmabuf.n_planes && i < 4; ++i) {
        out->offset[i] = (int)dmabuf.offset[i];
        out->stride[i] = (int)dmabuf.stride[i];
        out->fd[i] = dmabuf.fd[i];
    }
    return true;
}

bool wlr_bridge_texture_is_gles2(struct wlr_texture *texture) {
    if (!texture) return false;
    return wlr_texture_is_gles2(texture);
}

void wlr_bridge_texture_get_size(struct wlr_texture *texture, int *w, int *h) {
    if (!texture) {
        if (w) *w = 0;
        if (h) *h = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (w) *w = (int)texture->width;
    if (h) *h = (int)texture->height;
}

bool wlr_bridge_gles2_texture_get_attribs(struct wlr_texture *texture, uint32_t *target, uint32_t *tex) {
    if (!texture || !wlr_texture_is_gles2(texture)) return false;
    struct wlr_gles2_texture_attribs attribs;
    wlr_gles2_texture_get_attribs(texture, &attribs);
    if (target) *target = attribs.target;
    if (tex) *tex = attribs.tex;
    return true;
}

bool wlr_bridge_texture_read_pixels(struct wlr_texture *texture, uint32_t drm_format, uint32_t stride, void *data) {
    if (!texture || !data) return false;
    struct wlr_texture_read_pixels_options opts = {
        .format = drm_format,
        .stride = stride,
        .data = data
    };
    return wlr_texture_read_pixels(texture, &opts);
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Event Listeners Registration & Tracking
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

struct wlr_bridge_listener {
    struct wl_listener listener;
    void (*callback)(void *user, void *data);
    void *user;
};

static void generic_listener_notify(struct wl_listener *listener, void *data) {
    struct wlr_bridge_listener *bl = wl_container_of(listener, bl, listener);
    if (bl && bl->callback) {
        bl->callback(bl->user, data);
    }
}

struct wlr_bridge_listener *wlr_bridge_display_add_client_created_listener(struct wl_display *display,
                                                                          wlr_bridge_client_created_cb cb, void *user) {
    if (!display || !cb) return NULL;
    struct wlr_bridge_listener *bl = calloc(1, sizeof(*bl));
    if (!bl) return NULL;
    bl->callback = (void (*)(void *, void *))cb;
    bl->user = user;
    bl->listener.notify = generic_listener_notify;
    wl_list_init(&bl->listener.link);
    wl_display_add_client_created_listener(display, &bl->listener);
    return bl;
}

struct wlr_bridge_listener *wlr_bridge_compositor_add_new_surface_listener(struct wlr_compositor *compositor,
                                                                          wlr_bridge_surface_cb cb, void *user) {
    if (!compositor || !cb) return NULL;
    struct wlr_bridge_listener *bl = calloc(1, sizeof(*bl));
    if (!bl) return NULL;
    bl->callback = (void (*)(void *, void *))cb;
    bl->user = user;
    bl->listener.notify = generic_listener_notify;
    wl_list_init(&bl->listener.link);
    wl_signal_add(&compositor->events.new_surface, &bl->listener);
    return bl;
}

struct wlr_bridge_listener *wlr_bridge_xdg_shell_add_new_surface_listener(struct wlr_xdg_shell *shell,
                                                                          wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_cb cb, void *user) {
    if (!shell || !cb) return NULL;
    struct wlr_bridge_listener *bl = calloc(1, sizeof(*bl));
    if (!bl) return NULL;
    bl->callback = (void (*)(void *, void *))cb;
    bl->user = user;
    bl->listener.notify = generic_listener_notify;
    wl_list_init(&bl->listener.link);
    wl_signal_add(&shell->events.new_surface, &bl->listener);
    return bl;
}

struct wlr_bridge_listener *wlr_bridge_xdg_shell_add_new_toplevel_listener(struct wlr_xdg_shell *shell,
                                                                          wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_cb cb, void *user) {
    if (!shell || !cb) return NULL;
    struct wlr_bridge_listener *bl = calloc(1, sizeof(*bl));
    if (!bl) return NULL;
    bl->callback = (void (*)(void *, void *))cb;
    bl->user = user;
    bl->listener.notify = generic_listener_notify;
    wl_list_init(&bl->listener.link);
    wl_signal_add(&shell->events.new_toplevel, &bl->listener);
    return bl;
}

void wlr_bridge_listener_destroy(struct wlr_bridge_listener *listener) {
    if (!listener) return;
    if (listener->listener.link.prev && listener->listener.link.next) {
        wl_list_remove(&listener->listener.link);
    }
    free(listener);
}

/* --- Raw Surface Record --- */
struct wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record {
    struct wlr_surface *surface;
    void *user;
    void (*on_commit)(void *user, struct wlr_surface *surface);
    void (*on_destroy)(void *user, struct wlr_surface *surface);
    struct wl_listener commit_listener;
    struct wl_listener destroy_listener;
};

static void raw_surface_commit_notify(struct wl_listener *listener, void *data) {
    (void)data;
    struct wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record *rec =
        wl_container_of(listener, rec, commit_listener);
    if (rec && rec->on_commit) {
        rec->on_commit(rec->user, rec->surface);
    }
}

static void raw_surface_destroy_notify(struct wl_listener *listener, void *data) {
    (void)data;
    struct wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record *rec =
        wl_container_of(listener, rec, destroy_listener);
    if (rec) {
        if (rec->destroy_listener.link.prev && rec->destroy_listener.link.next) {
            wl_list_remove(&rec->destroy_listener.link);
            wl_list_init(&rec->destroy_listener.link);
        }
        if (rec->on_destroy) {
            rec->on_destroy(rec->user, rec->surface);
        }
    }
}

struct wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record *wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record_create(
    struct wlr_surface *surface,
    void (*on_commit)(void *user, struct wlr_surface *surface),
    void (*on_destroy)(void *user, struct wlr_surface *surface),
    void *user
) {
    if (!surface) return NULL;
    struct wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record *rec = calloc(1, sizeof(*rec));
    if (!rec) return NULL;
    rec->surface = surface;
    rec->user = user;
    rec->on_commit = on_commit;
    rec->on_destroy = on_destroy;

    rec->commit_listener.notify = raw_surface_commit_notify;
    wl_list_init(&rec->commit_listener.link);
    wl_signal_add(&surface->events.commit, &rec->commit_listener);

    rec->destroy_listener.notify = raw_surface_destroy_notify;
    wl_list_init(&rec->destroy_listener.link);
    wl_signal_add(&surface->events.destroy, &rec->destroy_listener);

    return rec;
}

struct wlr_surface *wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record_get_surface(struct wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record *record) {
    return record ? record->surface : NULL;
}

void wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record_destroy(struct wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record *record) {
    if (!record) return;
    if (record->commit_listener.link.prev && record->commit_listener.link.next) {
        wl_list_remove(&record->commit_listener.link);
    }
    if (record->destroy_listener.link.prev && record->destroy_listener.link.next) {
        wl_list_remove(&record->destroy_listener.link);
    }
    free(record);
}

/* --- XDG Surface Record --- */
struct wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record {
    struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdg_surface;
    void *user;
    void (*on_map)(void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdg_surface);
    void (*on_unmap)(void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdg_surface);
    void (*on_destroy)(void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdg_surface);
    void (*on_commit)(void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdg_surface);
    struct wl_listener map_listener;
    struct wl_listener unmap_listener;
    struct wl_listener destroy_listener;
    struct wl_listener commit_listener;
};

static void xdg_surface_map_notify(struct wl_listener *listener, void *data) {
    (void)data;
    struct wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record *rec = wl_container_of(listener, rec, map_listener);
    if (rec && rec->on_map) rec->on_map(rec->user, rec->xdg_surface);
}

static void xdg_surface_unmap_notify(struct wl_listener *listener, void *data) {
    (void)data;
    struct wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record *rec = wl_container_of(listener, rec, unmap_listener);
    if (rec && rec->on_unmap) rec->on_unmap(rec->user, rec->xdg_surface);
}

static void xdg_surface_destroy_notify(struct wl_listener *listener, void *data) {
    (void)data;
    struct wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record *rec = wl_container_of(listener, rec, destroy_listener);
    if (rec) {
        if (rec->destroy_listener.link.prev && rec->destroy_listener.link.next) {
            wl_list_remove(&rec->destroy_listener.link);
            wl_list_init(&rec->destroy_listener.link);
        }
        if (rec->on_destroy) rec->on_destroy(rec->user, rec->xdg_surface);
    }
}

static void xdg_surface_commit_notify(struct wl_listener *listener, void *data) {
    (void)data;
    struct wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record *rec = wl_container_of(listener, rec, commit_listener);
    if (rec && rec->on_commit) rec->on_commit(rec->user, rec->xdg_surface);
}

struct wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record *wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record_create(
    struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdg_surface,
    void (*on_map)(void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdg_surface),
    void (*on_unmap)(void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdg_surface),
    void (*on_destroy)(void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdg_surface),
    void (*on_commit)(void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdg_surface),
    void *user
) {
    if (!xdg_surface || !xdg_surface->surface) return NULL;
    struct wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record *rec = calloc(1, sizeof(*rec));
    if (!rec) return NULL;
    rec->xdg_surface = xdg_surface;
    rec->user = user;
    rec->on_map = on_map;
    rec->on_unmap = on_unmap;
    rec->on_destroy = on_destroy;
    rec->on_commit = on_commit;

    rec->map_listener.notify = xdg_surface_map_notify;
    wl_list_init(&rec->map_listener.link);
    wl_signal_add(&xdg_surface->surface->events.map, &rec->map_listener);

    rec->unmap_listener.notify = xdg_surface_unmap_notify;
    wl_list_init(&rec->unmap_listener.link);
    wl_signal_add(&xdg_surface->surface->events.unmap, &rec->unmap_listener);

    rec->destroy_listener.notify = xdg_surface_destroy_notify;
    wl_list_init(&rec->destroy_listener.link);
    wl_signal_add(&xdg_surface->events.destroy, &rec->destroy_listener);

    rec->commit_listener.notify = xdg_surface_commit_notify;
    wl_list_init(&rec->commit_listener.link);
    wl_signal_add(&xdg_surface->surface->events.commit, &rec->commit_listener);

    return rec;
}

struct wlr_xdg_surface *wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record_get_xdg_surface(struct wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record *record) {
    return record ? record->xdg_surface : NULL;
}

void wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record_destroy(struct wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record *record) {
    if (!record) return;
    if (record->map_listener.link.prev && record->map_listener.link.next) {
        wl_list_remove(&record->map_listener.link);
    }
    if (record->unmap_listener.link.prev && record->unmap_listener.link.next) {
        wl_list_remove(&record->unmap_listener.link);
    }
    if (record->destroy_listener.link.prev && record->destroy_listener.link.next) {
        wl_list_remove(&record->destroy_listener.link);
    }
    if (record->commit_listener.link.prev && record->commit_listener.link.next) {
        wl_list_remove(&record->commit_listener.link);
    }
    free(record);
}

/* --- XDG Toplevel Record --- */
struct wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record {
    struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *toplevel;
    void *user;
    void (*on_request_maximize)(void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *toplevel);
    void (*on_request_fullscreen)(void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *toplevel);
    void (*on_request_minimize)(void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *toplevel);
    void (*on_destroy)(void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *toplevel);
    struct wl_listener request_maximize_listener;
    struct wl_listener request_fullscreen_listener;
    struct wl_listener request_minimize_listener;
    struct wl_listener destroy_listener;
};

static void xdg_toplevel_maximize_notify(struct wl_listener *listener, void *data) {
    (void)data;
    struct wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record *rec = wl_container_of(listener, rec, request_maximize_listener);
    if (rec && rec->on_request_maximize) rec->on_request_maximize(rec->user, rec->toplevel);
}

static void xdg_toplevel_fullscreen_notify(struct wl_listener *listener, void *data) {
    (void)data;
    struct wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record *rec = wl_container_of(listener, rec, request_fullscreen_listener);
    if (rec && rec->on_request_fullscreen) rec->on_request_fullscreen(rec->user, rec->toplevel);
}

static void xdg_toplevel_minimize_notify(struct wl_listener *listener, void *data) {
    (void)data;
    struct wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record *rec = wl_container_of(listener, rec, request_minimize_listener);
    if (rec && rec->on_request_minimize) rec->on_request_minimize(rec->user, rec->toplevel);
}

static void xdg_toplevel_destroy_notify(struct wl_listener *listener, void *data) {
    (void)data;
    struct wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record *rec = wl_container_of(listener, rec, destroy_listener);
    if (rec) {
        if (rec->destroy_listener.link.prev && rec->destroy_listener.link.next) {
            wl_list_remove(&rec->destroy_listener.link);
            wl_list_init(&rec->destroy_listener.link);
        }
        if (rec->on_destroy) rec->on_destroy(rec->user, rec->toplevel);
    }
}

struct wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record *wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record_create(
    struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *toplevel,
    void (*on_request_maximize)(void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *toplevel),
    void (*on_request_fullscreen)(void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *toplevel),
    void (*on_request_minimize)(void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *toplevel),
    void (*on_destroy)(void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *toplevel),
    void *user
) {
    if (!toplevel) return NULL;
    struct wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record *rec = calloc(1, sizeof(*rec));
    if (!rec) return NULL;
    rec->toplevel = toplevel;
    rec->user = user;
    rec->on_request_maximize = on_request_maximize;
    rec->on_request_fullscreen = on_request_fullscreen;
    rec->on_request_minimize = on_request_minimize;
    rec->on_destroy = on_destroy;

    rec->request_maximize_listener.notify = xdg_toplevel_maximize_notify;
    wl_list_init(&rec->request_maximize_listener.link);
    wl_signal_add(&toplevel->events.request_maximize, &rec->request_maximize_listener);

    rec->request_fullscreen_listener.notify = xdg_toplevel_fullscreen_notify;
    wl_list_init(&rec->request_fullscreen_listener.link);
    wl_signal_add(&toplevel->events.request_fullscreen, &rec->request_fullscreen_listener);

    rec->request_minimize_listener.notify = xdg_toplevel_minimize_notify;
    wl_list_init(&rec->request_minimize_listener.link);
    wl_signal_add(&toplevel->events.request_minimize, &rec->request_minimize_listener);

    rec->destroy_listener.notify = xdg_toplevel_destroy_notify;
    wl_list_init(&rec->destroy_listener.link);
    wl_signal_add(&toplevel->events.destroy, &rec->destroy_listener);

    return rec;
}

struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record_get_toplevel(struct wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record *record) {
    return record ? record->toplevel : NULL;
}

void wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record_destroy(struct wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record *record) {
    if (!record) return;
    if (record->request_maximize_listener.link.prev && record->request_maximize_listener.link.next) {
        wl_list_remove(&record->request_maximize_listener.link);
    }
    if (record->request_fullscreen_listener.link.prev && record->request_fullscreen_listener.link.next) {
        wl_list_remove(&record->request_fullscreen_listener.link);
    }
    if (record->request_minimize_listener.link.prev && record->request_minimize_listener.link.next) {
        wl_list_remove(&record->request_minimize_listener.link);
    }
    if (record->destroy_listener.link.prev && record->destroy_listener.link.next) {
        wl_list_remove(&record->destroy_listener.link);
    }
    free(record);
}

# Wayland Scanner for protocol code generation
find_program(WAYLAND_SCANNER_EXECUTABLE NAMES wayland-scanner REQUIRED)
pkg_get_variable(WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_DIR wayland-protocols pkgdatadir)

set(PROTOCOL_GEN_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/protocols)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${PROTOCOL_GEN_DIR})

macro(generate_wayland_protocol xml_path name)
    set(header "${PROTOCOL_GEN_DIR}/${name}-protocol.h")
    set(source "${PROTOCOL_GEN_DIR}/${name}-protocol.c")

    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${header}
        COMMAND ${WAYLAND_SCANNER_EXECUTABLE} server-header ${xml_path} ${header}
        DEPENDS ${xml_path}
        COMMENT "Generating Wayland server protocol header: ${name}"
    )

    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${source}
        COMMAND ${WAYLAND_SCANNER_EXECUTABLE} private-code ${xml_path} ${source}
        DEPENDS ${xml_path}
        COMMENT "Generating Wayland private protocol code: ${name}"
    )

    list(APPEND PROTOCOL_SOURCES ${header} ${source})
endmacro()

generate_wayland_protocol(
    "${WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_DIR}/stable/xdg-shell/xdg-shell.xml"
    "xdg-shell"
)

generate_wayland_protocol(
    "${WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_DIR}/stable/linux-dmabuf/linux-dmabuf-v1.xml"
    "linux-dmabuf-v1"
)

set(PTR_CONSTRAINTS_XML "${WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_DIR}/unstable/pointer-constraints/pointer-constraints-unstable-v1.xml")
set(PTR_CONSTRAINTS_HDR "${PROTOCOL_GEN_DIR}/pointer-constraints-unstable-v1-client-protocol.h")
set(PTR_CONSTRAINTS_SRC "${PROTOCOL_GEN_DIR}/pointer-constraints-unstable-v1-client-protocol.c")
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${PTR_CONSTRAINTS_HDR} ${PTR_CONSTRAINTS_SRC}
    COMMAND ${WAYLAND_SCANNER_EXECUTABLE} client-header ${PTR_CONSTRAINTS_XML} ${PTR_CONSTRAINTS_HDR}
    COMMAND ${WAYLAND_SCANNER_EXECUTABLE} private-code ${PTR_CONSTRAINTS_XML} ${PTR_CONSTRAINTS_SRC}
    DEPENDS ${PTR_CONSTRAINTS_XML}
    COMMENT "Generating Wayland client pointer-constraints protocol"
)

set(REL_PTR_XML "${WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_DIR}/unstable/relative-pointer/relative-pointer-unstable-v1.xml")
set(REL_PTR_HDR "${PROTOCOL_GEN_DIR}/relative-pointer-unstable-v1-client-protocol.h")
set(REL_PTR_SRC "${PROTOCOL_GEN_DIR}/relative-pointer-unstable-v1-client-protocol.c")
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${REL_PTR_HDR} ${REL_PTR_SRC}
    COMMAND ${WAYLAND_SCANNER_EXECUTABLE} client-header ${REL_PTR_XML} ${REL_PTR_HDR}
    COMMAND ${WAYLAND_SCANNER_EXECUTABLE} private-code ${REL_PTR_XML} ${REL_PTR_SRC}
    DEPENDS ${REL_PTR_XML}
    COMMENT "Generating Wayland client relative-pointer protocol"
)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Copyright 2021 Oliver Smith
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
# PYTHON_ARGCOMPLETE_OK
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# Add local directory and standard install directories to sys.path
_current_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
_possible_tools_paths = [
    _current_dir,
    _current_dir / "tools",
    Path("/opt/linstack/LinStack_core"),
    Path("/opt/linstack"),
    Path("/usr/lib/linstack"),
    Path("/usr/share/linstack"),
    Path("/usr/local/lib/linstack"),
]
for _p in _possible_tools_paths:
    if (_p / "tools").is_dir() or (_p / "__init__.py").is_file():
        if str(_p) not in sys.path:
            sys.path.insert(0, str(_p))
        break

import tools

if __name__ == "__main__":
    os.umask(0o0022)
    sys.exit(tools.main())

--- FILE: ./LinStack/LinStack_core/Makefile ---
PREFIX := /usr

USE_SYSTEMD ?= 1
USE_DBUS_ACTIVATION ?= 1
USE_NFTABLES ?= 0

SYSCONFDIR := /etc
LINSTACK_DIR := $(PREFIX)/lib/linstack
BIN_DIR := $(PREFIX)/bin
APPS_DIR := $(PREFIX)/share/applications
APPS_DIRECTORY_DIR := $(PREFIX)/share/desktop-directories
APPS_MENU_DIR := $(SYSCONFDIR)/xdg/menus/applications-merged
METAINFO_DIR := $(PREFIX)/share/metainfo
ICONS_DIR := $(PREFIX)/share/icons
SYSD_DIR := $(PREFIX)/lib/systemd/system
DBUS_DIR := $(PREFIX)/share/dbus-1
POLKIT_DIR := $(PREFIX)/share/polkit-1
APPARMOR_DIR := $(SYSCONFDIR)/apparmor.d

INSTALL_LINSTACK_DIR := $(DESTDIR)$(LINSTACK_DIR)
INSTALL_BIN_DIR := $(DESTDIR)$(BIN_DIR)
INSTALL_APPS_DIR := $(DESTDIR)$(APPS_DIR)
INSTALL_APPS_DIRECTORY_DIR := $(DESTDIR)$(APPS_DIRECTORY_DIR)
INSTALL_APPS_MENU_DIR := $(DESTDIR)$(APPS_MENU_DIR)
INSTALL_METAINFO_DIR := $(DESTDIR)$(METAINFO_DIR)
INSTALL_ICONS_DIR := $(DESTDIR)$(ICONS_DIR)
INSTALL_SYSD_DIR := $(DESTDIR)$(SYSD_DIR)
INSTALL_DBUS_DIR := $(DESTDIR)$(DBUS_DIR)
INSTALL_POLKIT_DIR := $(DESTDIR)$(POLKIT_DIR)
INSTALL_APPARMOR_DIR := $(DESTDIR)$(APPARMOR_DIR)
VAR_LIB_DIR := $(DESTDIR)/var/lib/linstack
IMAGES_DIR := $(VAR_LIB_DIR)/images

build:
	@echo "Nothing to build, run 'make install' to copy the files!"

install:
	install -d $(INSTALL_LINSTACK_DIR) $(INSTALL_BIN_DIR) $(INSTALL_DBUS_DIR)/system.d $(INSTALL_POLKIT_DIR)/actions
	install -d $(INSTALL_APPS_DIR) $(INSTALL_METAINFO_DIR) $(INSTALL_ICONS_DIR)/hicolor/512x512/apps
	install -d $(INSTALL_APPS_DIRECTORY_DIR) $(INSTALL_APPS_MENU_DIR)
	install -d $(IMAGES_DIR)
	@for res in ../resources resources ../LinStack/resources; do \
		if [ -f "$$res/system.img" ] && [ -f "$$res/vendor.img" ]; then \
			if [ ! -f "$(IMAGES_DIR)/system.img" ] || [ ! -f "$(IMAGES_DIR)/vendor.img" ]; then \
				echo "Copying preinstalled images from $$res to $(IMAGES_DIR)..."; \
				cp -n "$$res/system.img" "$$res/vendor.img" $(IMAGES_DIR)/ || true; \
			fi; \
			break; \
		fi; \
	done
	cp -a data tools linstack.py $(INSTALL_LINSTACK_DIR)
	ln -sf \
		$$(realpath --relative-to=$(INSTALL_BIN_DIR) $(INSTALL_LINSTACK_DIR)/linstack.py) \
		$(INSTALL_BIN_DIR)/linstack
	mv $(INSTALL_LINSTACK_DIR)/data/AppIcon.png $(INSTALL_ICONS_DIR)/hicolor/512x512/apps/linstack.png
	mv $(INSTALL_LINSTACK_DIR)/data/*.desktop $(INSTALL_APPS_DIR)
	mv $(INSTALL_LINSTACK_DIR)/data/*.menu $(INSTALL_APPS_MENU_DIR)
	mv $(INSTALL_LINSTACK_DIR)/data/*.directory $(INSTALL_APPS_DIRECTORY_DIR)
	mv $(INSTALL_LINSTACK_DIR)/data/*.metainfo.xml $(INSTALL_METAINFO_DIR)
	cp dbus/id.linstack.Container.conf $(INSTALL_DBUS_DIR)/system.d/
	cp dbus/id.linstack.Container.policy $(INSTALL_POLKIT_DIR)/actions/
	if [ $(USE_DBUS_ACTIVATION) = 1 ]; then \
		install -d $(INSTALL_DBUS_DIR)/system-services; \
		cp dbus/id.linstack.Container.service $(INSTALL_DBUS_DIR)/system-services/; \
	fi
	if [ $(USE_SYSTEMD) = 1 ]; then \
		install -d $(INSTALL_SYSD_DIR); \
		cp systemd/linstack-container.service $(INSTALL_SYSD_DIR); \
	fi
	if [ $(USE_NFTABLES) = 1 ]; then \
		sed '/LXC_USE_NFT=/ s/false/true/' -i $(INSTALL_LINSTACK_DIR)/data/scripts/linstack-net.sh; \
	fi

install_apparmor:
	install -d $(INSTALL_APPARMOR_DIR) $(INSTALL_APPARMOR_DIR)/lxc
	mkdir -p $(INSTALL_APPARMOR_DIR)/local/
	touch $(INSTALL_APPARMOR_DIR)/local/adbd
	touch $(INSTALL_APPARMOR_DIR)/local/android_app
	touch $(INSTALL_APPARMOR_DIR)/local/lxc-linstack
	cp -f data/configs/apparmor_profiles/adbd $(INSTALL_APPARMOR_DIR)/adbd
	cp -f data/configs/apparmor_profiles/android_app $(INSTALL_APPARMOR_DIR)/android_app
	cp -f data/configs/apparmor_profiles/lxc-linstack $(INSTALL_APPARMOR_DIR)/lxc/lxc-linstack
	# Load the profiles if not just packaging
	if [ -z $(DESTDIR) ] && { aa-enabled --quiet || systemctl is-active -q apparmor; } 2>/dev/null; then \
		apparmor_parser -r -T -W "$(INSTALL_APPARMOR_DIR)/adbd"; \
		apparmor_parser -r -T -W "$(INSTALL_APPARMOR_DIR)/android_app"; \
		apparmor_parser -r -T -W "$(INSTALL_APPARMOR_DIR)/lxc/lxc-linstack"; \
	fi

--- FILE: ./LinStack/LinStack_core/rebrand.py ---
import os

# Strict character-sequence replacement dictionary
REPLACEMENTS = {
    "id.waydro": "id.linstack",
    "id.Waydro": "id.Linstack",
    "WayDroid": "LinStack",
    "waydroid": "linstack",
    "Waydroid": "LinStack",
    "WAYDROID": "LINSTACK"
}

def replace_raw_text(file_path):
    """Direct raw substring replacement inside file"""
    try:
        with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
            content = f.read()

        modified = False
        for old, new in REPLACEMENTS.items():
            if old in content:
                content = content.replace(old, new)
                modified = True

        if modified:
            with open(file_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                f.write(content)
            print(f"[Modified content] -> {os.path.basename(file_path)}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error reading {os.path.basename(file_path)}: {e}")

def run_rebrand_here():
    # Automatically get current directory where the script resides
    current_directory = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
    print(f"🔄 Running automatic rebrand inside directory: {current_directory}\n")

    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(current_directory, topdown=False):
        # Skip modifying the script itself while running
        if "rebrand.py" in files:
            files.remove("rebrand.py")

        # 1. Replace strings inside file contents
        for file in files:
            file_path = os.path.join(root, file)
            replace_raw_text(file_path)

        # 2. Rename files matching target strings
        for file in files:
            new_file_name = file
            for old, new in REPLACEMENTS.items():
                new_file_name = new_file_name.replace(old, new)

            if new_file_name != file:
                old_path = os.path.join(root, file)
                new_path = os.path.join(root, new_file_name)
                os.rename(old_path, new_path)
                print(f"[Renamed file]: {file} -> {new_file_name}")

        # 3. Rename directories matching target strings
        for d in dirs:
            new_dir_name = d
            for old, new in REPLACEMENTS.items():
                new_dir_name = new_dir_name.replace(old, new)

            if new_dir_name != d:
                old_path = os.path.join(root, d)
                new_path = os.path.join(root, new_dir_name)
                os.rename(old_path, new_path)
                print(f"[Renamed directory]: {d} -> {new_dir_name}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_rebrand_here()
    print("\nSuccessfully rebranded current directory and all contents!")
