--- FILE: ./LinStack/src/PathResolver.cpp ---
#include "PathResolver.h"
#include <QCoreApplication>
#include <QDir>
#include <QFileInfo>
#include <QStandardPaths>
#include <QProcessEnvironment>

#ifndef LIN_STACK_INSTALL_PREFIX
#define LIN_STACK_INSTALL_PREFIX "/usr"
#endif

#ifndef LIN_STACK_DATADIR
#define LIN_STACK_DATADIR LIN_STACK_INSTALL_PREFIX "/share/linstack"
#endif

QString PathResolver::resolveResourcesDir()
{
    QString appDir = QCoreApplication::applicationDirPath();
    QStringList candidates = {
        // 1. Candidate resources directories (post-install or local project paths)
        "/opt/linstack/resources",
        appDir + "/resources",
        appDir + "/../resources",
        appDir + "/../../resources",
        appDir + "/../LinStack/resources",
        appDir + "/../../LinStack/resources",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/resources",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/LinStack/resources",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/../resources",
        QDir::homePath() + "/LinStack/LinStack/resources",
        QDir::homePath() + "/LinStack/resources",
        // 2. System Android images directory
        "/var/lib/linstack/images",
        QString(LIN_STACK_DATADIR) + "/resources",
        "/usr/share/linstack/resources",
        "/usr/local/share/linstack/resources"
    };

    // Prioritize any directory containing valid non-empty system.img and vendor.img
    for (const QString &dir : candidates) {
        QFileInfo sysFi(dir + "/system.img");
        QFileInfo vndFi(dir + "/vendor.img");
        if (sysFi.exists() && sysFi.size() > 0 && vndFi.exists() && vndFi.size() > 0) {
            return QDir::cleanPath(dir);
        }
    }

    // Fallback to default install resources directory if images are not found yet
    if (QFileInfo::exists("/opt/linstack/resources") && QFileInfo("/opt/linstack/resources").isDir()) {
        return "/opt/linstack/resources";
    }
    for (const QString &dir : candidates) {
        if (QFileInfo::exists(dir) && QFileInfo(dir).isDir()) {
            return QDir::cleanPath(dir);
        }
    }
    return QDir::cleanPath(appDir + "/resources");
}

QString PathResolver::resolveResource(const QString &fileName)
{
    if (QFileInfo::exists(fileName) && QFileInfo(fileName).isAbsolute()) {
        return QDir::cleanPath(fileName);
    }

    QString cleanName = fileName;
    if (cleanName.startsWith("resources/")) {
        cleanName = cleanName.mid(10);
    }

    QString dir = resolveResourcesDir();
    QString fullPath = dir + "/" + cleanName;
    if (QFileInfo::exists(fullPath)) {
        return QDir::cleanPath(fullPath);
    }

    // Also check direct candidates relative to app and cwd
    QString appDir = QCoreApplication::applicationDirPath();
    QStringList directCandidates = {
        appDir + "/" + fileName,
        appDir + "/../" + fileName,
        appDir + "/resources/" + cleanName,
        appDir + "/../resources/" + cleanName,
        QDir::currentPath() + "/" + fileName,
        QDir::currentPath() + "/resources/" + cleanName,
        QString(LIN_STACK_DATADIR) + "/resources/" + cleanName,
        "/usr/share/linstack/resources/" + cleanName,
        "/usr/local/share/linstack/resources/" + cleanName
    };

    for (const QString &path : directCandidates) {
        if (QFileInfo::exists(path)) {
            return QDir::cleanPath(path);
        }
    }

    return fullPath;
}

QString PathResolver::resolvePython3()
{
    QString py = QStandardPaths::findExecutable("python3");
    if (!py.isEmpty()) {
        return py;
    }
    return "python3";
}

QString PathResolver::resolveLinstackExecutable()
{
    QString appDir = QCoreApplication::applicationDirPath();
    QStringList candidatePaths = {
        // 1. Local project / portable builds (LinStack_core/linstack.py or wrapper)
        appDir + "/linstack",
        appDir + "/../linstack",
        appDir + "/LinStack_core/linstack.py",
        appDir + "/../LinStack_core/linstack.py",
        appDir + "/../../LinStack_core/linstack.py",
        appDir + "/../linstack.py",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/linstack",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/LinStack_core/linstack.py",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/../LinStack_core/linstack.py",
        // 2. Standard system installation directories
        "/opt/linstack/LinStack_core/linstack.py",
        "/usr/local/bin/linstack",
        QString(LIN_STACK_INSTALL_PREFIX) + "/bin/linstack",
        "/usr/bin/linstack"
    };

    for (const QString &p : candidatePaths) {
        if (QFileInfo::exists(p)) {
            return QDir::cleanPath(p);
        }
    }

    QString systemExe = QStandardPaths::findExecutable("linstack");
    if (!systemExe.isEmpty()) {
        return systemExe;
    }

    return "linstack";
}

QString PathResolver::resolveToolsDir()
{
    QString appDir = QCoreApplication::applicationDirPath();
    QStringList candidates = {
        appDir + "/tools",
        appDir + "/../tools",
        appDir + "/LinStack_core/tools",
        appDir + "/../LinStack_core/tools",
        appDir + "/../../LinStack_core/tools",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/tools",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/LinStack_core/tools",
        QString(LIN_STACK_DATADIR) + "/tools",
        "/opt/linstack/LinStack_core/tools",
        "/opt/linstack/tools",
        "/usr/lib/linstack/tools",
        "/usr/share/linstack/tools"
    };

    for (const QString &d : candidates) {
        if (QFileInfo::exists(d) && QFileInfo(d).isDir()) {
            return QDir::cleanPath(d);
        }
    }
    return QString();
}

QString PathResolver::resolveCoreDir()
{
    QString appDir = QCoreApplication::applicationDirPath();
    QStringList candidates = {
        appDir + "/LinStack_core",
        appDir + "/../LinStack_core",
        appDir + "/../../LinStack_core",
        "/opt/linstack/LinStack_core",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/LinStack_core",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/../LinStack_core",
    };
    for (const QString &d : candidates) {
        if (QFileInfo::exists(d + "/Makefile") || QFileInfo::exists(d + "/linstack.py")) {
            return QDir::cleanPath(d);
        }
    }
    return QString();
}

QString PathResolver::resolveLinstackCommand(QStringList &args)
{
    QString exe = resolveLinstackExecutable();
    if (exe.endsWith(".py")) {
        args.prepend(exe);
        return resolvePython3();
    }
    return exe;
}

void PathResolver::configureProcess(QProcess *proc, const QStringList &args)
{
    if (!proc) return;

    QStringList effectiveArgs = args;
    QString prog = resolveLinstackCommand(effectiveArgs);
    proc->setProgram(prog);
    proc->setArguments(effectiveArgs);

    // Setup process environment with PYTHONPATH and dynamic LINSTACK_IMAGES_PATH
    QProcessEnvironment env = proc->processEnvironment();
    if (env.isEmpty()) {
        env = QProcessEnvironment::systemEnvironment();
    }

    QString resDir = resolveResourcesDir();
    if (!resDir.isEmpty()) {
        env.insert("LINSTACK_IMAGES_PATH", resDir);
    }

    QString exe = resolveLinstackExecutable();
    QString toolsParent;
    if (exe.endsWith(".py")) {
        toolsParent = QFileInfo(exe).absolutePath();
        proc->setWorkingDirectory(toolsParent);
    } else {
        QString toolsDir = resolveToolsDir();
        if (!toolsDir.isEmpty()) {
            toolsParent = QFileInfo(toolsDir).absolutePath();
        }
    }

    if (!toolsParent.isEmpty()) {
        QString cur = env.value("PYTHONPATH");
        if (!cur.isEmpty()) {
            env.insert("PYTHONPATH", toolsParent + ":" + cur);
        } else {
            env.insert("PYTHONPATH", toolsParent);
        }
    }
    proc->setProcessEnvironment(env);
}

int PathResolver::executeLinstack(const QStringList &args, int timeoutMs)
{
    QProcess proc;
    configureProcess(&proc, args);
    proc.start();
    if (!proc.waitForFinished(timeoutMs)) {
        proc.kill();
        proc.waitForFinished(200);
        return -1;
    }
    return proc.exitCode();
}

bool PathResolver::startDetachedLinstack(const QStringList &args)
{
    QProcess proc;
    configureProcess(&proc, args);
    return proc.startDetached();
}

QString PathResolver::userDataDir()
{
    QString dir = QStandardPaths::writableLocation(QStandardPaths::AppLocalDataLocation);
    if (dir.isEmpty()) {
        dir = QDir::homePath() + "/.local/share/linStack";
    }
    QDir().mkpath(dir);
    return dir;
}

QString PathResolver::userStateDir()
{
    QString stateDir = QStandardPaths::writableLocation(QStandardPaths::GenericDataLocation)
                           .replace("/share", "/state") + "/linStack";
    if (!QDir().mkpath(stateDir)) {
        stateDir = QDir::homePath() + "/.local/state/linStack";
        QDir().mkpath(stateDir);
    }
    return stateDir;
}

--- FILE: ./LinStack/src/ScriptEngine.cpp ---
#include "ScriptEngine.h"
#include "UInputTouchBridge.h"

#include <QFile>
#include <QTextStream>
#include <QKeySequence>
#include <cmath>

// Swipe steps per 100ms budget (each step ~25ms)
static constexpr int kSwipeStepIntervalMs = 25;

ScriptEngine::ScriptEngine(UInputTouchBridge *bridge, QObject *parent)
    : QObject(parent)
    , m_bridge(bridge)
{
    m_stepTimer = new QTimer(this);
    m_stepTimer->setSingleShot(false);
    m_stepTimer->setInterval(kSwipeStepIntervalMs);
    connect(m_stepTimer, &QTimer::timeout, this, &ScriptEngine::onStepTimer);
}

ScriptEngine::~ScriptEngine()
{
    stop();
}

void ScriptEngine::setBridge(UInputTouchBridge *bridge)
{
    m_bridge = bridge;
}

bool ScriptEngine::loadScript(const QString &scriptText, QString *errorOut)
{
    stop();
    m_program.clear();
    m_loopStack.clear();
    m_ip = 0;

    QStringList lines = scriptText.split('\n', Qt::SkipEmptyParts);
    return compile(lines, errorOut);
}

bool ScriptEngine::loadScriptFile(const QString &filePath, QString *errorOut)
{
    QFile f(filePath);
    if (!f.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
        if (errorOut) *errorOut = QString("Cannot open script file: %1").arg(filePath);
        return false;
    }
    return loadScript(QTextStream(&f).readAll(), errorOut);
}

bool ScriptEngine::compile(const QStringList &lines, QString *errorOut)
{
    // Stack of (loopBeginIndex, loopCount) for matching loopEnd
    QList<int> openLoopIndices;

    for (int lineNum = 0; lineNum < lines.size(); ++lineNum) {
        QString raw = lines[lineNum].trimmed();
        if (raw.isEmpty() || raw.startsWith('#') || raw.startsWith("//")) {
            continue; // skip comments / blank lines
        }

        QStringList parts = raw.split(' ', Qt::SkipEmptyParts);
        QString cmd = parts[0].toLower();
        Instruction instr;

        if (cmd == "tap") {
            if (parts.size() < 3) {
                if (errorOut) *errorOut = QString("Line %1: tap requires X Y").arg(lineNum + 1);
                return false;
            }
            instr.op = OpCode::Tap;
            instr.x1 = parts[1].toInt();
            instr.y1 = parts[2].toInt();

        } else if (cmd == "swipe") {
            if (parts.size() < 6) {
                if (errorOut) *errorOut = QString("Line %1: swipe requires X1 Y1 X2 Y2 DurationMs").arg(lineNum + 1);
                return false;
            }
            instr.op = OpCode::Swipe;
            instr.x1 = parts[1].toInt();
            instr.y1 = parts[2].toInt();
            instr.x2 = parts[3].toInt();
            instr.y2 = parts[4].toInt();
            instr.duration = qMax(50, parts[5].toInt());

        } else if (cmd == "wait") {
            if (parts.size() < 2) {
                if (errorOut) *errorOut = QString("Line %1: wait requires DelayMs").arg(lineNum + 1);
                return false;
            }
            instr.op = OpCode::Wait;
            instr.duration = qMax(1, parts[1].toInt());

        } else if (cmd == "keydown") {
            if (parts.size() < 2) {
                if (errorOut) *errorOut = QString("Line %1: keyDown requires Key").arg(lineNum + 1);
                return false;
            }
            instr.op = OpCode::KeyDown;
            instr.keyName = parts[1];

        } else if (cmd == "keyup") {
            if (parts.size() < 2) {
                if (errorOut) *errorOut = QString("Line %1: keyUp requires Key").arg(lineNum + 1);
                return false;
            }
            instr.op = OpCode::KeyUp;
            instr.keyName = parts[1];

        } else if (cmd == "entershoot") {
            instr.op = OpCode::EnterShoot;

        } else if (cmd == "exitshoot") {
            instr.op = OpCode::ExitShoot;

        } else if (cmd == "loop") {
            instr.op = OpCode::LoopBegin;
            instr.loopCount = (parts.size() >= 2) ? parts[1].toInt() : 1;
            openLoopIndices.append(m_program.size());
            m_program.append(instr);
            continue; // don't re-append below

        } else if (cmd == "loopend") {
            if (openLoopIndices.isEmpty()) {
                if (errorOut) *errorOut = QString("Line %1: loopEnd without matching loop").arg(lineNum + 1);
                return false;
            }
            int beginIdx = openLoopIndices.takeLast();
            instr.op = OpCode::LoopEnd;
            instr.loopTarget = beginIdx;
            m_program.append(instr);
            continue;

        } else {
            // Unknown command — emit warning but continue (NOP)
            instr.op = OpCode::Nop;
        }

        m_program.append(instr);
    }

    if (!openLoopIndices.isEmpty()) {
        if (errorOut) *errorOut = "Unclosed loop block (missing loopEnd)";
        return false;
    }

    return true;
}

void ScriptEngine::execute()
{
    if (m_program.isEmpty()) return;

    m_ip = 0;
    m_running = true;
    m_loopStack.clear();
    m_swipeInProgress = false;
    emit scriptStarted();

    // Kick off first instruction via timer to avoid blocking the event loop
    m_stepTimer->setInterval(1);
    m_stepTimer->start();
}

void ScriptEngine::stop()
{
    m_running = false;
    m_swipeInProgress = false;
    m_stepTimer->stop();
    m_loopStack.clear();
    m_ip = 0;
}

void ScriptEngine::onStepTimer()
{
    if (!m_running) {
        m_stepTimer->stop();
        return;
    }

    // Swipe sub-stepping
    if (m_swipeInProgress) {
        m_swipeStep++;
        qreal t = static_cast<qreal>(m_swipeStep) / m_swipeTotalSteps;
        int cx = m_swipeX1 + static_cast<int>((m_swipeX2 - m_swipeX1) * t);
        int cy = m_swipeY1 + static_cast<int>((m_swipeY2 - m_swipeY1) * t);

        if (m_swipeStep >= m_swipeTotalSteps) {
            if (m_bridge) {
                m_bridge->touchMove(8, cx, cy);
                m_bridge->touchUp(8);
            }
            m_swipeInProgress = false;
            finishCurrentInstruction();
        } else {
            if (m_bridge) {
                m_bridge->touchMove(8, cx, cy);
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    if (m_ip >= m_program.size()) {
        m_running = false;
        m_stepTimer->stop();
        emit scriptFinished();
        return;
    }

    executeInstruction(m_program[m_ip]);
}

void ScriptEngine::executeInstruction(const Instruction &instr)
{
    emit commandExecuted(QString("ip=%1 op=%2").arg(m_ip).arg(static_cast<int>(instr.op)));
    emit progressChanged(m_ip, m_program.size());

    switch (instr.op) {

    case OpCode::Tap:
        if (m_bridge) {
            m_bridge->touchDown(7, instr.x1, instr.y1);
            m_bridge->touchUp(7);
        }
        finishCurrentInstruction();
        break;

    case OpCode::Swipe: {
        m_swipeTotalSteps = qMax(1, instr.duration / kSwipeStepIntervalMs);
        m_swipeStep = 0;
        m_swipeX1 = instr.x1; m_swipeY1 = instr.y1;
        m_swipeX2 = instr.x2; m_swipeY2 = instr.y2;
        if (m_bridge) {
            m_bridge->touchDown(8, instr.x1, instr.y1);
        }
        m_swipeInProgress = true;
        m_stepTimer->setInterval(kSwipeStepIntervalMs);
        // Don't advance IP — onStepTimer will call finishCurrentInstruction() when done
        break;
    }

    case OpCode::Wait:
        m_stepTimer->stop();
        // Schedule resume after delay
        QTimer::singleShot(instr.duration, this, [this]() {
            if (m_running) {
                finishCurrentInstruction();
                m_stepTimer->setInterval(1);
                m_stepTimer->start();
            }
        });
        break;

    case OpCode::KeyDown:
        // Emit as text — InputTranslator is hooked up by MainWindow via signals
        // For now, emit commandExecuted which MainWindow can intercept
        emit commandExecuted(QString("keyDown:%1").arg(instr.keyName));
        finishCurrentInstruction();
        break;

    case OpCode::KeyUp:
        emit commandExecuted(QString("keyUp:%1").arg(instr.keyName));
        finishCurrentInstruction();
        break;

    case OpCode::EnterShoot:
        emit commandExecuted("enterShoot");
        finishCurrentInstruction();
        break;

    case OpCode::ExitShoot:
        emit commandExecuted("exitShoot");
        finishCurrentInstruction();
        break;

    case OpCode::LoopBegin: {
        // Push loop state: (beginIdx, remaining iterations)
        int remaining = (instr.loopCount < 0) ? -1 : instr.loopCount;
        m_loopStack.append(qMakePair(m_ip, remaining));
        finishCurrentInstruction();
        break;
    }

    case OpCode::LoopEnd: {
        if (m_loopStack.isEmpty()) {
            emit scriptError("loopEnd without matching loop state");
            stop();
            return;
        }
        auto &top = m_loopStack.last();
        if (top.second < 0) {
            // Infinite loop — jump back to begin+1
            m_ip = top.first + 1;
            m_stepTimer->setInterval(1);
            m_stepTimer->start();
        } else {
            top.second--;
            if (top.second > 0) {
                m_ip = top.first + 1;
                m_stepTimer->setInterval(1);
                m_stepTimer->start();
            } else {
                m_loopStack.removeLast();
                finishCurrentInstruction();
            }
        }
        break;
    }

    case OpCode::Nop:
    default:
        finishCurrentInstruction();
        break;
    }
}

void ScriptEngine::finishCurrentInstruction()
{
    m_ip++;
    if (m_ip >= m_program.size()) {
        m_running = false;
        m_stepTimer->stop();
        emit scriptFinished();
        return;
    }
    // Next instruction on next timer tick
    m_stepTimer->setInterval(1);
    if (!m_stepTimer->isActive()) {
        m_stepTimer->start();
    }
}

// ── Hotkey binding ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

void ScriptEngine::bindToHotkey(int qtKey, const QString &scriptText)
{
    m_hotkeys.insert(qtKey, scriptText);
}

void ScriptEngine::unbindHotkey(int qtKey)
{
    m_hotkeys.remove(qtKey);
}

bool ScriptEngine::triggerHotkey(int qtKey)
{
    if (!m_hotkeys.contains(qtKey)) return false;

    // Stop any currently running script before starting the new one
    stop();
    QString err;
    if (!loadScript(m_hotkeys[qtKey], &err)) {
        emit scriptError(err);
        return true;
    }
    execute();
    return true;
}

--- FILE: ./LinStack/src/ScriptEngine.h ---
#ifndef SCRIPTENGINE_H
#define SCRIPTENGINE_H

#include <QObject>
#include <QString>
#include <QStringList>
#include <QList>
#include <QMap>
#include <QTimer>
#include <QQueue>

class UInputTouchBridge;

/**
 * @brief ScriptEngine — parse and execute LinStack macro script language.
 *
 * Supported commands:
 *   tap X Y                     — single touch down+up at pixel coords
 *   swipe X1 Y1 X2 Y2 DurMs    — linear multi-step swipe
 *   wait DelayMs                — pause execution for N milliseconds
 *   keyDown Key                 — simulate key press (Qt key name or code)
 *   keyUp Key                   — simulate key release
 *   enterShoot                  — activate aim-lock (FPS mode)
 *   exitShoot                   — deactivate aim-lock
 *   loop Count ... loopEnd      — repeat block Count times (-1 for infinite)
 *
 * Example script:
 *   tap 540 960
 *   wait 200
 *   swipe 200 800 200 400 300
 *   loop 3
 *     tap 900 600
 *     wait 100
 *   loopEnd
 */
class ScriptEngine : public QObject
{
    Q_OBJECT

public:
    explicit ScriptEngine(UInputTouchBridge *bridge, QObject *parent = nullptr);
    ~ScriptEngine() override;

    void setBridge(UInputTouchBridge *bridge);

    // Load script source text; compiles into instruction list
    bool loadScript(const QString &scriptText, QString *errorOut = nullptr);

    // Load from file path
    bool loadScriptFile(const QString &filePath, QString *errorOut = nullptr);

    // Start executing the loaded script from the beginning
    void execute();

    // Stop any running script immediately
    void stop();

    bool isRunning() const { return m_running; }

    // Bind a Qt key code to a script (scriptText stored directly)
    void bindToHotkey(int qtKey, const QString &scriptText);
    void unbindHotkey(int qtKey);

    // Returns true if the key was bound and a script was started
    bool triggerHotkey(int qtKey);

    // Current bound hotkeys
    QMap<int, QString> hotkeys() const { return m_hotkeys; }

signals:
    void scriptStarted();
    void scriptFinished();
    void scriptError(const QString &message);
    void commandExecuted(const QString &command);
    void progressChanged(int current, int total);

private slots:
    void onStepTimer();

private:
    enum class OpCode {
        Tap,
        Swipe,
        Wait,
        KeyDown,
        KeyUp,
        EnterShoot,
        ExitShoot,
        LoopBegin,
        LoopEnd,
        Nop
    };

    struct Instruction {
        OpCode op = OpCode::Nop;
        int x1 = 0, y1 = 0;
        int x2 = 0, y2 = 0;
        int duration = 0;     // ms for Wait / Swipe
        int loopCount = 0;    // -1 for infinite (LoopBegin)
        int loopTarget = -1;  // index of matching LoopBegin (for LoopEnd)
        QString keyName;
    };

    bool compile(const QStringList &lines, QString *errorOut);
    void executeInstruction(const Instruction &instr);
    void startSwipeExecution(const Instruction &instr);
    void finishCurrentInstruction();

    UInputTouchBridge   *m_bridge   = nullptr;
    QList<Instruction>   m_program;
    int                  m_ip       = 0;    // instruction pointer
    bool                 m_running  = false;

    // Loop stack: (loopBeginIndex, remainingIterations)
    QList<QPair<int,int>> m_loopStack;

    // Step timer for non-blocking execution
    QTimer *m_stepTimer = nullptr;

    // Swipe sub-state
    bool   m_swipeInProgress = false;
    int    m_swipeStep       = 0;
    int    m_swipeTotalSteps = 0;
    int    m_swipeX1 = 0, m_swipeY1 = 0;
    int    m_swipeX2 = 0, m_swipeY2 = 0;

    // Hotkey map: Qt key code → script text
    QMap<int, QString> m_hotkeys;
};

#endif // SCRIPTENGINE_H

void TitleBar::paintEvent(QPaintEvent *event)

void TitleBar::mousePressEvent(QMouseEvent *event)
{
    if (window()) {
        if (auto *canvas = window()->findChild<AndroidCanvas *>()) {
            if (canvas->isAimModeActive()) {
                canvas->setAimMode(false);
            }
        }
    }
    if (event->button() == Qt::LeftButton) {
        QWidget *child = childAt(event->position().toPoint());
        if (child == m_statusText || child == m_statusDot) {
            QMenu menu(this);
            menu.setStyleSheet(
                "QMenu { background-color: #0D121D; color: #F9FAFB; border: 1px solid #10B981; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px; }"
                "QMenu::item { padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; }"
                "QMenu::item:selected { background-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); color: #00FF66; }"
            );
            QAction *actRestartSession = menu.addAction("🔄 Restart Session");
            QAction *actRestartContainer = menu.addAction("⚡ Restart Container");

            QAction *chosen = menu.exec(m_statusText->mapToGlobal(QPoint(0, m_statusText->height() + 4)));
            if (chosen == actRestartSession) {
                emit restartSessionRequested();
            } else if (chosen == actRestartContainer) {
                emit restartContainerRequested();
            }
            event->accept();
            return;
        }

        if (child == nullptr || child == this || child == m_titleLabel || child == m_logoIconLabel) {
            m_isDragging = true;
            m_dragStartPos = event->globalPosition().toPoint();
            event->accept();
            return;
        }
    }
    QWidget::mousePressEvent(event);
}


void TitleBar::mouseMoveEvent(QMouseEvent *event)
{
    if (m_isDragging && (event->buttons() & Qt::LeftButton)) {
        QPoint globalPos = event->globalPosition().toPoint();
        QPoint delta = globalPos - m_dragStartPos;
        m_dragStartPos = globalPos;
        emit windowDragged(delta);
        event->accept();
        return;
    }
    QWidget::mouseMoveEvent(event);
}

void TitleBar::mouseReleaseEvent(QMouseEvent *event)
{
    if (event->button() == Qt::LeftButton) {
        m_isDragging = false;
    }
    QWidget::mouseReleaseEvent(event);
}

void TitleBar::mouseDoubleClickEvent(QMouseEvent *event)
{
    if (event->button() == Qt::LeftButton) {
        QWidget *child = childAt(event->position().toPoint());
        if (child == nullptr || child == this || child == m_titleLabel || child == m_logoIconLabel) {
            emit maximizeToggled();
            event->accept();
            return;
        }
    }
    QWidget::mouseDoubleClickEvent(event);
}

--- FILE: ./LinStack/src/DiagnosticsEngine.h ---
#ifndef DIAGNOSTICSENGINE_H
#define DIAGNOSTICSENGINE_H

#include <QObject>
#include <QString>
#include <QStringList>
#include <QList>
#include <QDateTime>
#include <QThread>

enum class CheckStatus {
    Passed,
    Warning,
    Failed
};

enum class DiagnosticCategory {
    KernelModule,
    ServiceSocket,
    ContainerRootfs,
    DisplaySurface
};

struct DiagnosticCheckResult {
    QString id;
    DiagnosticCategory category;
    QString name;
    CheckStatus status = CheckStatus::Passed;
    QString details;
    QString errorCode;
    QString remediationHint;
    bool canAutoHeal = false;
    bool requiresElevation = false;
};

struct HealthReport {
    QDateTime timestamp;
    bool isHealthy = true;
    bool hasWarnings = false;
    bool hasCriticalFailures = false;
    QList<DiagnosticCheckResult> checks;
    QString summary;

    QList<DiagnosticCheckResult> failedChecks() const;
    QList<DiagnosticCheckResult> warningChecks() const;
    QList<DiagnosticCheckResult> autoHealableChecks() const;
    QString formatReport() const;
};

class DiagnosticsWorker : public QObject
{
    Q_OBJECT

public:
    explicit DiagnosticsWorker(QObject *parent = nullptr) : QObject(parent) {}

public slots:
    void performChecks();

signals:
    void progressUpdated(int percent, const QString &checkName);
    void checkCompleted(const DiagnosticCheckResult &result);
    void diagnosticsFinished(const HealthReport &report);
};

class DiagnosticsEngine : public QObject
{
    Q_OBJECT

public:
    explicit DiagnosticsEngine(QObject *parent = nullptr);
    ~DiagnosticsEngine() override;

    // Asynchronous diagnostic execution (runs in background QThread)
    void runDiagnosticsAsync();
    bool isRunning() const { return m_isRunning; }

    // Synchronous diagnostic execution (blocking, for CLI or pre-flight)
    HealthReport runDiagnosticsSync();

    // Cache of the latest report
    HealthReport latestReport() const { return m_latestReport; }

signals:
    void progressUpdated(int percent, const QString &checkName);
    void checkCompleted(const DiagnosticCheckResult &result);
    void diagnosticsFinished(const HealthReport &report);

private slots:
    void handleDiagnosticsFinished(const HealthReport &report);

private:
    bool m_isRunning = false;
    HealthReport m_latestReport;
    QThread *m_workerThread = nullptr;
    DiagnosticsWorker *m_worker = nullptr;
};

#endif // DIAGNOSTICSENGINE_H

#include "Theme.h"

#include <QPainter>
#include <QPainterPath>
#include <QPen>
#include <QFontDatabase>

namespace Theme {

QPixmap renderIconPixmap(IconType type, const QColor &color, int size)
{
    // Render at 2x scale for crisp HiDPI
    const int scale = 2;
    QPixmap pixmap(size * scale, size * scale);
    pixmap.fill(Qt::transparent);

    QPainter p(&pixmap);
    p.setRenderHint(QPainter::Antialiasing, true);
    p.setRenderHint(QPainter::SmoothPixmapTransform, true);
    p.scale(scale, scale);

    QPen pen(color);
    pen.setCapStyle(Qt::RoundCap);
    pen.setJoinStyle(Qt::RoundJoin);
    pen.setWidthF(1.75);
    p.setPen(pen);

    const qreal w = size;
    const qreal h = size;

    switch (type) {
    case IconType::WindowMinimize: {
        pen.setWidthF(2.0);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w * 0.25, h * 0.55), QPointF(w * 0.75, h * 0.55));
        break;
    }
    case IconType::WindowMaximize: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.8);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        QRectF rect(w * 0.26, h * 0.26, w * 0.48, h * 0.48);
        p.drawRoundedRect(rect, 1.5, 1.5);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::WindowRestore: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.6);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        // Back square
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(w * 0.35, h * 0.22, w * 0.42, h * 0.42), 1.5, 1.5);
        // Front square with dark fill
        p.setBrush(ColorBgPanel);
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(w * 0.22, h * 0.35, w * 0.42, h * 0.42), 1.5, 1.5);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::WindowClose: {
        pen.setWidthF(2.0);
        p.setPen(pen);
        qreal cPad = w * 0.30;
        p.drawLine(QPointF(cPad, cPad), QPointF(w - cPad, h - cPad));
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w - cPad, cPad), QPointF(cPad, h - cPad));
        break;
    }
    case IconType::Search: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.8);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        qreal r = w * 0.22;
        QPointF center(w * 0.42, h * 0.42);
        p.drawEllipse(center, r, r);
        p.drawLine(QPointF(center.x() + r * 0.707, center.y() + r * 0.707),
                   QPointF(w * 0.78, h * 0.78));
        break;
    }
    case IconType::ClearText: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.6);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(ColorBgSurface);
        p.drawEllipse(QPointF(w * 0.5, h * 0.5), w * 0.35, h * 0.35);
        qreal c = w * 0.16;
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w * 0.5 - c, h * 0.5 - c), QPointF(w * 0.5 + c, h * 0.5 + c));
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w * 0.5 + c, h * 0.5 - c), QPointF(w * 0.5 - c, h * 0.5 + c));
        break;
    }
    case IconType::Help: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.6);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        p.drawEllipse(QPointF(w * 0.5, h * 0.5), w * 0.36, h * 0.36);
        QPainterPath path;
        path.moveTo(w * 0.40, h * 0.38);
        path.cubicTo(w * 0.40, h * 0.28, w * 0.60, h * 0.28, w * 0.60, h * 0.40);
        path.cubicTo(w * 0.60, h * 0.48, w * 0.50, h * 0.50, w * 0.50, h * 0.58);
        p.drawPath(path);
        p.setBrush(color);
        p.drawEllipse(QPointF(w * 0.5, h * 0.68), 1.2, 1.2);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::Fullscreen: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.8);
        p.setPen(pen);
        qreal s = w * 0.22;
        qreal l = w * 0.18;
        // Top-left
        p.drawLine(QPointF(s, s + l), QPointF(s, s));
        p.drawLine(QPointF(s, s), QPointF(s + l, s));
        // Top-right
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w - s - l, s), QPointF(w - s, s));
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w - s, s), QPointF(w - s, s + l));
        // Bottom-left
        p.drawLine(QPointF(s, h - s - l), QPointF(s, h - s));
        p.drawLine(QPointF(s, h - s), QPointF(s + l, h - s));
        // Bottom-right
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w - s - l, h - s), QPointF(w - s, h - s));
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w - s, h - s), QPointF(w - s, h - s - l));
        break;
    }
    case IconType::VolumeUp: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.7);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(color);
        QPainterPath cone;
        cone.moveTo(w * 0.22, h * 0.42);
        cone.lineTo(w * 0.34, h * 0.42);
        cone.lineTo(w * 0.50, h * 0.26);
        cone.lineTo(w * 0.50, h * 0.74);
        cone.lineTo(w * 0.34, h * 0.58);
        cone.lineTo(w * 0.22, h * 0.58);
        cone.closeSubpath();
        p.drawPath(cone);

        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);

    case IconType::Keymapper: {

        // Key grid
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w * 0.30, h * 0.38), QPointF(w * 0.36, h * 0.38));

            qreal a1 = (i * 360.0 / teeth) * M_PI / 180.0;
            qreal a2 = ((i * 360.0 / teeth) + 14.0) * M_PI / 180.0;
            qreal a3 = ((i * 360.0 / teeth) + 24.0) * M_PI / 180.0;

            QPointF p1(c.x() + rInner * std::cos(a1), c.y() + rInner * std::sin(a1));
            QPointF p2(c.x() + rOuter * std::cos(a2), c.y() + rOuter * std::sin(a2));

            if (i == 0) gear.moveTo(p1);
            else gear.lineTo(p1);
            gear.lineTo(p2);
            gear.lineTo(p3);
            gear.lineTo(p4);
        }

        p.drawPath(gear);

        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(w * 0.28, h * 0.18, w * 0.44, h * 0.64), 3.5, 3.5);
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w * 0.44, h * 0.25), QPointF(w * 0.56, h * 0.25));
        p.drawEllipse(QPointF(w * 0.50, h * 0.74), 1.6, 1.6);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::Shield: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.7);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        QPainterPath sh;
        sh.moveTo(w * 0.50, h * 0.20);
        sh.lineTo(w * 0.76, h * 0.30);
        sh.lineTo(w * 0.76, h * 0.56);
        sh.cubicTo(w * 0.76, h * 0.74, w * 0.50, h * 0.84, w * 0.50, h * 0.84);
        sh.cubicTo(w * 0.50, h * 0.84, w * 0.24, h * 0.74, w * 0.24, h * 0.56);
        sh.lineTo(w * 0.24, h * 0.30);
        sh.closeSubpath();
        p.drawPath(sh);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::Check: {
        pen.setWidthF(2.2);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w * 0.24, h * 0.52), QPointF(w * 0.44, h * 0.72));
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w * 0.44, h * 0.72), QPointF(w * 0.78, h * 0.30));
        break;
    }
    case IconType::Macro: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.7);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        // Play tape / scroll
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(w * 0.22, h * 0.26, w * 0.56, h * 0.48), 3.0, 3.0);
        // Play triangle inside
        p.setBrush(color);
        QPainterPath tp;
        tp.moveTo(w * 0.42, h * 0.38);
        tp.lineTo(w * 0.62, h * 0.50);
        tp.lineTo(w * 0.42, h * 0.62);
        tp.closeSubpath();
        p.drawPath(tp);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::FileManager: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.7);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        QPainterPath fld;
        fld.moveTo(w * 0.20, h * 0.32);
        fld.lineTo(w * 0.44, h * 0.32);
        fld.lineTo(w * 0.52, h * 0.40);
        fld.lineTo(w * 0.80, h * 0.40);
        fld.lineTo(w * 0.80, h * 0.72);
        fld.lineTo(w * 0.20, h * 0.72);
        fld.closeSubpath();
        p.drawPath(fld);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::MultiInstance: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.6);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        // Back instance
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(w * 0.34, h * 0.20, w * 0.44, h * 0.52), 2.5, 2.5);
        // Front instance
        p.setBrush(ColorBgPanel);
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(w * 0.20, h * 0.34, w * 0.44, h * 0.52), 2.5, 2.5);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::AndroidBackTriangle: {
        pen.setWidthF(2.0);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        QPainterPath tri;
        tri.moveTo(w * 0.34, h * 0.50);
        tri.lineTo(w * 0.64, h * 0.30);
        tri.lineTo(w * 0.64, h * 0.70);
        tri.closeSubpath();
        p.drawPath(tri);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::AndroidHomeCircle: {
        pen.setWidthF(2.0);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        p.drawEllipse(QPointF(w * 0.50, h * 0.50), w * 0.20, w * 0.20);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::AndroidRecentSquare: {
        pen.setWidthF(2.0);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(w * 0.32, h * 0.32, w * 0.36, h * 0.36), 2.0, 2.0);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::SwipeGesture: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.8);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        // Curved swipe arrow
        QRectF arcRect(w * 0.24, h * 0.26, w * 0.52, h * 0.52);
        p.drawArc(arcRect, 45 * 16, 180 * 16);
        // Arrow head
        p.setBrush(color);
        QPainterPath ah;
        ah.moveTo(w * 0.70, h * 0.32);
        ah.lineTo(w * 0.82, h * 0.36);
        ah.lineTo(w * 0.76, h * 0.48);
        ah.closeSubpath();
        p.drawPath(ah);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::SmartCast: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.7);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        p.drawEllipse(QPointF(w * 0.50, h * 0.50), w * 0.32, w * 0.32);
        p.drawEllipse(QPointF(w * 0.50, h * 0.50), w * 0.12, w * 0.12);
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w * 0.50, h * 0.14), QPointF(w * 0.50, h * 0.30));
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w * 0.50, h * 0.70), QPointF(w * 0.50, h * 0.86));
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w * 0.14, h * 0.50), QPointF(w * 0.30, h * 0.50));
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w * 0.70, h * 0.50), QPointF(w * 0.86, h * 0.50));
        break;
    }
    }

    return pixmap;
}

QIcon createIcon(IconType type, const QColor &color, int size)
{
    return QIcon(renderIconPixmap(type, color, size));
}

--- FILE: ./LinStack/src/main.cpp ---
#include <QApplication>
#include <QStyleFactory>
#include <QPalette>
#include <QSurfaceFormat>
#include <QLocalServer>
#include <QLocalSocket>
#include <QTimer>
#include "MainWindow.h"
#include "SettingsDialog.h"
#include "InitializationDialog.h"
#include "AndroidCanvas.h"
#include "KeymapperOverlay.h"
#include "Theme.h"

#include "SelfHealingManager.h"
#include "Logger.h"
#include "PathResolver.h"
#include <QProcess>

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
    // Install centralized thread-safe logger and Qt message handler
    Logger::installQtMessageHandler();
    LOG_INFO("Core", "=== LinStack 1.0 (Cyber Emerald Edition) initializing ===");

    // Configure hardware integration for both X11 (xcb_egl) and Wayland
    qputenv("QSG_RHI_BACKEND", "opengl");
    qputenv("QT_XCB_GL_INTEGRATION", "xcb_egl");

    if (qEnvironmentVariable("XDG_SESSION_TYPE") == "x11" || qEnvironmentVariableIsEmpty("WAYLAND_DISPLAY")) {
        qputenv("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "xcb");
    } else {
        qputenv("QT_WAYLAND_HARDWARE_INTEGRATION", "wayland-egl");
        qputenv("QT_WAYLAND_SERVER_BUFFER_INTEGRATION", "dmabuf-server");
        qputenv("QT_WAYLAND_CLIENT_BUFFER_INTEGRATION", "wayland-egl");
    }

    // Qt 6 High-DPI and GLES2 configuration
    QGuiApplication::setHighDpiScaleFactorRoundingPolicy(Qt::HighDpiScaleFactorRoundingPolicy::PassThrough);

    QSurfaceFormat glFormat;
    glFormat.setRenderableType(QSurfaceFormat::OpenGLES);
    glFormat.setVersion(2, 0);
    glFormat.setSwapInterval(1);
    QSurfaceFormat::setDefaultFormat(glFormat);

    QApplication app(argc, argv);
    app.setApplicationName("LinStack");
    app.setApplicationDisplayName("LinStack 1.0");
    app.setApplicationVersion("1.0.0");
    app.setOrganizationName("LinStack Project");

    bool isScreenshotMode = false;
    QString launchPackage;
    QString installApkPath;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        QString arg = argv[i];
        if (arg.startsWith("--screenshot")) {
            isScreenshotMode = true;
        } else if (arg == "--launch" && i + 1 < argc) {
            launchPackage = argv[++i];
        } else if (arg == "--install" && i + 1 < argc) {
            installApkPath = argv[++i];
        } else if (!arg.startsWith("-") && arg.endsWith(".apk", Qt::CaseInsensitive)) {
            installApkPath = arg;
        }
    }

    if (!isScreenshotMode) {
        QString serverName = "LinStack_IPC_" + QString::fromLocal8Bit(qgetenv("USER"));
        if (serverName == "LinStack_IPC_") {
            serverName = "LinStack_IPC_default";
        }

        QLocalSocket clientSocket;
        clientSocket.connectToServer(serverName);
        if (clientSocket.waitForConnected(400)) {
            LOG_INFO("Core", "LinStack is already running. Forwarding launch command via IPC...");
            QString msg = !installApkPath.isEmpty() ? ("INSTALL:" + installApkPath) : (launchPackage.isEmpty() ? "ACTIVATE" : ("LAUNCH:" + launchPackage));
            clientSocket.write(msg.toUtf8() + "\n");
            clientSocket.waitForBytesWritten(1000);
            clientSocket.disconnectFromServer();
            return 0;
        }

        QLocalServer::removeServer(serverName);
    }

    // Fast non-session pre-flight diagnostic check (kernel binder / modules)
    // Note: session is NOT started here; MainWindow initializes the embedded compositor first
    // Diagnostics run asynchronously from MainWindow so the UI opens immediately without delay

    // Apply dark cyber palette
    QPalette cyberPalette;
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::Window, Theme::ColorBgDark);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::WindowText, Theme::ColorTextPrimary);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::Base, Theme::ColorBgDarkAlt);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::AlternateBase, Theme::ColorBgSurface);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::ToolTipBase, Theme::ColorBgPanel);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::ToolTipText, Theme::ColorTextPrimary);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::Text, Theme::ColorTextPrimary);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::Button, Theme::ColorBgSurface);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::ButtonText, Theme::ColorTextPrimary);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::Highlight, Theme::ColorEmerald);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::HighlightedText, Theme::ColorBgDark);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::PlaceholderText, Theme::ColorTextDim);
    app.setPalette(cyberPalette);

    // Apply global stylesheet
    app.setStyleSheet(Theme::cyberEmeraldStyleSheet());

    // Support CLI screenshot flags for headless validation and standalone dialog preview
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (QString(argv[i]) == "--screenshot-init" && i + 1 < argc) {
            QString path = argv[i + 1];
            InitializationDialog dlg;
            dlg.show();
            app.processEvents();
            QPixmap pix = dlg.grab();
            pix.save(path);
            return 0;
        }
        if (QString(argv[i]) == "--screenshot-settings" && i + 1 < argc) {
            QString path = argv[i + 1];
            SettingsDialog dlg;
            dlg.show();
            app.processEvents();
            QPixmap pix = dlg.grab();
            pix.save(path);
            return 0;
        }
    }

    MainWindow window;

    if (!isScreenshotMode) {
        QString serverName = "LinStack_IPC_" + QString::fromLocal8Bit(qgetenv("USER"));
        if (serverName == "LinStack_IPC_") {
            serverName = "LinStack_IPC_default";
        }
        auto *ipcServer = new QLocalServer(&app);
        if (ipcServer->listen(serverName)) {
            QObject::connect(ipcServer, &QLocalServer::newConnection, [ipcServer, &window]() {
                while (QLocalSocket *client = ipcServer->nextPendingConnection()) {
                    QObject::connect(client, &QLocalSocket::readyRead, [client, &window]() {
                        QByteArray data = client->readAll();
                        QString msg = QString::fromUtf8(data).trimmed();
                        if (msg.startsWith("INSTALL:")) {
                            QString apk = msg.mid(8).trimmed();
                            LOG_INFO("Core", "IPC APK install requested: " + apk);
                            window.installApkFile(apk);
                        } else if (msg.startsWith("LAUNCH:")) {
                            QString pkg = msg.mid(7).trimmed();
                            LOG_INFO("Core", "IPC launch requested for package: " + pkg);
                            window.bringToFront();
                            window.launchApp(pkg);
                        } else if (msg == "ACTIVATE") {
                            window.bringToFront();
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        }
    }

    window.show();

    if (!installApkPath.isEmpty()) {
        QTimer::singleShot(600, [&window, installApkPath]() {
            window.installApkFile(installApkPath);
        });
    } else if (!launchPackage.isEmpty()) {
        QTimer::singleShot(400, [&window, launchPackage]() {
            window.launchApp(launchPackage);
        });
    }

    // Support CLI screenshot flags for headless validation and UI preview
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (QString(argv[i]) == "--screenshot" && i + 1 < argc) {
            QString path = argv[i + 1];
            app.processEvents();
            window.resize(1280, 768);
            window.show();
            app.processEvents();
            QPixmap pix = window.grab();
            pix.save(path);
            return 0;
        }
        if (QString(argv[i]) == "--screenshot-keymapper" && i + 1 < argc) {
            QString path = argv[i + 1];
            window.resize(1280, 768);
            window.show();
            // trigger keymapper overlay
            QMetaObject::invokeMethod(&window, "handleKeymapperToggle", Q_ARG(bool, true));
            app.processEvents();
            QPixmap pix = window.grab();
            pix.save(path);
            return 0;
        }
        if (QString(argv[i]) == "--screenshot-keymapper-edit" && i + 1 < argc) {
            QString path = argv[i + 1];
            window.resize(1280, 768);
            window.show();
            // trigger keymapper overlay in Edit Mode
            QMetaObject::invokeMethod(&window, "handleKeymapperToggle", Q_ARG(bool, true));
            auto *canvas = window.findChild<AndroidCanvas*>();
            if (canvas && canvas->keymapperOverlay()) {
                canvas->keymapperOverlay()->setMode(KeymapperOverlay::Mode::Edit);
            }
            app.processEvents();
            QPixmap pix = window.grab();
            pix.save(path);
            return 0;
        }
        if (QString(argv[i]) == "--screenshot-init" && i + 1 < argc) {
            QString path = argv[i + 1];
            InitializationDialog dlg;
            dlg.show();
            app.processEvents();
            QPixmap pix = dlg.grab();
            pix.save(path);
            return 0;
        }
        if (QString(argv[i]) == "--screenshot-settings" && i + 1 < argc) {
            QString path = argv[i + 1];
            SettingsDialog dlg;
            dlg.show();
            app.processEvents();
            QPixmap pix = dlg.grab();
            pix.save(path);
            return 0;
        }
        if (QString(argv[i]) == "--screenshot-diagnostics" && i + 1 < argc) {
            QString path = argv[i + 1];
            RecoveryDialog dlg;
            HealthReport report;
            report.isHealthy = false;
            report.hasCriticalFailures = true;
            report.summary = "Subsystem fault detected: Binder IPC interface missing / unreachable.";

            DiagnosticCheckResult binderCheck;
            binderCheck.id = "kernel_binder";
            binderCheck.category = DiagnosticCategory::KernelModule;
            binderCheck.name = "Kernel Binder Interface";
            binderCheck.status = CheckStatus::Failed;
            binderCheck.errorCode = "E_BINDER_MISSING";
            binderCheck.details = "Neither /dev/binder nor /dev/binderfs/binder were found with valid rw permissions.";
            binderCheck.remediationHint = "Run 'modprobe binder_linux' or allow linStack elevated repair to mount binderfs.";
            report.checks.append(binderCheck);

            DiagnosticCheckResult serviceCheck;
            serviceCheck.id = "systemd_service";
            serviceCheck.category = DiagnosticCategory::ServiceSocket;
            serviceCheck.name = "LinStack Systemd Container Service";
            serviceCheck.status = CheckStatus::Warning;
            serviceCheck.errorCode = "W_SERVICE_INACTIVE";
            serviceCheck.details = "linstack-container.service unit is currently inactive.";
            serviceCheck.remediationHint = "Attempt automated service restart via systemctl.";
            report.checks.append(serviceCheck);

            dlg.setReport(report);
            dlg.show();
            app.processEvents();
            QPixmap pix = dlg.grab();
            pix.save(path);
            return 0;
        }
    }

    return app.exec();
}

#include "SelfHealingManager.h"
#include "Logger.h"
#include "Theme.h"

#include <QVBoxLayout>
#include <QHBoxLayout>
#include <QPainter>
#include <QProcess>
#include <QFileInfo>
#include <QDir>
#include <QThread>
#include <QElapsedTimer>
#include <QApplication>
#include <QScrollBar>
#include <QGraphicsDropShadowEffect>
#include <QWindow>
#include <QMouseEvent>
#include <QFrame>
#include <QStandardPaths>
#include <QTimer>
#include "PathResolver.h"

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SelfHealingManager Implementation
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

SelfHealingManager::SelfHealingManager(QObject *parent)
    : QObject(parent)
{
    connect(&m_engine, &DiagnosticsEngine::progressUpdated, this, &SelfHealingManager::diagnosticsProgress);
    connect(&m_engine, &DiagnosticsEngine::diagnosticsFinished, this, &SelfHealingManager::handleDiagnosticsFinished);
}

SelfHealingManager::~SelfHealingManager() = default;

void SelfHealingManager::startDiagnosticsAsync(bool autoHeal, QWidget *parentUi)
{
    m_autoHeal = autoHeal;
    m_parentUi = parentUi;
    LOG_INFO("SelfHealing", "Initiating asynchronous diagnostic pipeline...");
    m_engine.runDiagnosticsAsync();
}

void SelfHealingManager::handleDiagnosticsFinished(const HealthReport &report)
{
    emit diagnosticsFinished(report);

    const auto warns = report.warningChecks();
    const auto fails = report.failedChecks();

    bool hasBlockingIssue = !fails.isEmpty();
    if (!hasBlockingIssue) {
        for (const auto &c : warns) {
            if (c.requiresElevation || c.id == "KERNEL_BINDER" || c.id == "RAW_MOUSE_INPUT") {
                hasBlockingIssue = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    if (!hasBlockingIssue) {
        LOG_INFO("SelfHealing", "Diagnostics verified all critical subsystems healthy.");
        if (m_recoveryDialog && m_recoveryDialog->isVisible()) {
            m_recoveryDialog->setStatus("All critical subsystems healthy! Ready.", false);
            m_recoveryDialog->accept();
        }
        return;
    }


    LOG_WARN("SelfHealing", QString("Diagnostics reported issues/warnings: %1").arg(report.summary));

    // Step 1: Attempt non-elevated programmatic fixes first
    bool progFixed = executeProgrammaticFixes(report);

    // Step 2: Check if any failed or warning checks require root elevation (e.g., binderfs)
    bool hasElevatedIssues = false;
    for (const auto &c : fails) {
        if (c.requiresElevation) {
            hasElevatedIssues = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!hasElevatedIssues) {
        for (const auto &c : warns) {
            if (c.requiresElevation || c.id == "KERNEL_BINDER") {
                hasElevatedIssues = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    if (hasElevatedIssues || (!progFixed && report.hasCriticalFailures)) {
        LOG_FAULT("SelfHealing", "FAULT_REQUIRES_ATTENTION",
                  "Unresolved faults or critical warnings remain. Presenting recovery options.",
                  "Launch elevated auto-heal or check logs.");
        showRecoveryDialog(report, m_parentUi);
    }
}

bool SelfHealingManager::executeProgrammaticFixes(const HealthReport &report)
{
    bool anyAttempted = false;
    bool allSuccess = true;

    for (const auto &c : report.checks) {
        if (c.status == CheckStatus::Passed || c.requiresElevation) {
            continue;
        }

        anyAttempted = true;
        emit healingStarted(QString("Resolving: %1").arg(c.name));

        if (c.id == "ADB_SOCKET") {
            LOG_INFO("SelfHealing", "Auto-remediating ADB socket: starting adb server and connecting to 127.0.0.1:5555");
            QProcess p;
            p.start("adb", QStringList() << "start-server");
            p.waitForFinished(3000);

            QProcess pConnect;
            pConnect.start("adb", QStringList() << "connect" << "127.0.0.1:5555");
            pConnect.waitForFinished(3000);
            Logger::instance().logSubprocess("adb connect 127.0.0.1:5555", pConnect.exitCode(),
                                             pConnect.readAllStandardOutput(), pConnect.readAllStandardError());
        } else if (c.id == "ROOTFS_OVERLAY") {
            LOG_INFO("SelfHealing", "Ensuring user storage directory exists with correct permissions...");
            QString dir = QStandardPaths::writableLocation(QStandardPaths::AppLocalDataLocation);
            if (dir.isEmpty()) {
                dir = QDir::homePath() + "/.local/share/linStack";
            }
            QDir().mkpath(dir);
        }
    }

    if (anyAttempted) {
        emit healingFinished(allSuccess, "Programmatic fixes applied.");
    }
    return allSuccess;
}

bool SelfHealingManager::executeElevatedFixes(const HealthReport &report)
{
    emit repairStarted();
    emit healingStarted("Executing elevated kernel & service repair via pkexec...");

    QStringList commands;
    QString resDir = PathResolver::resolveResourcesDir();
    QString coreDir = PathResolver::resolveCoreDir();

    // 1. Ensure core backend is installed if missing
    if (!QFileInfo::exists("/usr/bin/linstack") && !coreDir.isEmpty()) {
        commands << QString("make -C \"%1\" install 2>/dev/null || true").arg(coreDir);
    }

    // 2. Ensure container config exists and images_path points to resolved resources
    if (!QFileInfo::exists("/var/lib/linstack/linstack.cfg")) {
        commands << QString("linstack init -f -i \"%1\" 2>/dev/null || true").arg(resDir);
    } else if (!resDir.isEmpty()) {
        commands << QString("sed -i 's|images_path = .*|images_path = %1|' /var/lib/linstack/linstack.cfg 2>/dev/null || true").arg(resDir);
    }

    // 3. Kernel binder IPC module & filesystem check
    bool needBinder = false;
    for (const auto &c : report.checks) {
        if (c.id == "KERNEL_BINDER" && c.status != CheckStatus::Passed) {
            needBinder = true;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (needBinder || !isBinderAccessible()) {
        // Check if binderfs is already mounted (kernel built-in binder, e.g. Fedora 6.x)
        bool binderfsAlreadyMounted = QFileInfo::exists("/dev/binderfs/binder");
        bool binderDevExists = QFileInfo::exists("/dev/binder");

        if (!binderfsAlreadyMounted && !binderDevExists) {
            // Module not loaded at all — attempt modprobe then mount binderfs
            commands << "modprobe binder_linux devices=binder,hwbinder,vndbinder 2>/dev/null || true";
            commands << "mkdir -p /dev/binderfs";
            commands << "mount -t binder binder /dev/binderfs 2>/dev/null || true";
        }
        // Always try to fix permissions on whichever nodes exist
        commands << "chmod 0666 /dev/binder /dev/binderfs/binder /dev/vndbinder /dev/hwbinder 2>/dev/null || true";
    }

    // 4. Raw mouse input permissions for smooth 1:1 Aim Lock on Wayland
    commands << "echo 'KERNEL==\"mice\", SUBSYSTEM==\"input\", MODE=\"0666\"' > /etc/udev/rules.d/99-linstack-raw-mouse.rules 2>/dev/null || true";
    commands << "chmod 0666 /dev/input/mice 2>/dev/null || true";

    // 5. Ensure container daemon service is enabled and restarted
    commands << "systemctl enable --now linstack-container.service 2>/dev/null || true";
    commands << "systemctl restart linstack-container.service 2>/dev/null || true";

    QString bashCmd = commands.join(" && ");
    LOG_INFO("SelfHealing", QString("Spawning pkexec command: %1").arg(bashCmd));

    QProcess proc;
    proc.start("pkexec", QStringList() << "bash" << "-c" << bashCmd);

    if (!proc.waitForFinished(20000)) {
        LOG_CRITICAL("SelfHealing", "pkexec repair timed out after 20 seconds.");
        emit repairFinished(false);
        emit healingFinished(false, "Elevated repair timed out.");
        return false;
    }

    int exitCode = proc.exitCode();
    QString stdOut = proc.readAllStandardOutput();
    QString stdErr = proc.readAllStandardError();
    Logger::instance().logSubprocess(QString("pkexec bash -c '%1'").arg(bashCmd), exitCode, stdOut, stdErr);

    bool success = (exitCode == 0);
    emit repairFinished(success);
    emit healingFinished(success, success ? "Elevated repair completed successfully." : "pkexec repair failed.");

    if (success) {
        ensureSessionRunning();
    }
    return success;
}

void SelfHealingManager::showRecoveryDialog(const HealthReport &report, QWidget *parent)
{
    if (!m_recoveryDialog) {
        m_recoveryDialog = new RecoveryDialog(parent);

        connect(m_recoveryDialog, &RecoveryDialog::autoHealRequested, this, [this]() {
            m_recoveryDialog->setStatus("Running automated elevated healing...", true);
            QThread::msleep(200);

            // Execute elevated repair in background or process
            bool ok = executeElevatedFixes(m_engine.latestReport());
            if (ok) {
                m_recoveryDialog->setStatus("Repair finished! Re-running diagnostics...", true);
                m_engine.runDiagnosticsAsync();
            } else {
                m_recoveryDialog->setStatus("Repair encountered an error. Check logs below.", false);
            }
        });

        connect(m_recoveryDialog, &RecoveryDialog::recheckRequested, this, [this]() {
            m_recoveryDialog->setStatus("Re-scanning system health...", true);
            m_engine.runDiagnosticsAsync();
        });

        connect(m_recoveryDialog, &RecoveryDialog::ignoreAndContinue, this, [this]() {
            LOG_WARN("SelfHealing", "User elected to ignore diagnostic warnings and continue execution.");
            m_recoveryDialog->accept();
            ensureSessionRunning();
        });
    }

    m_recoveryDialog->setReport(report);
    m_recoveryDialog->show();
    m_recoveryDialog->raise();
    m_recoveryDialog->activateWindow();
}

// ── Backward-compatible helper methods ────────────────────────────────────────

bool SelfHealingManager::isBinderAccessible()
{
    bool devBinder = QFileInfo::exists("/dev/binder") && QFileInfo("/dev/binder").isReadable();
    bool binderfs = QFileInfo::exists("/dev/binderfs/binder") && QFileInfo("/dev/binderfs/binder").isReadable();
    return devBinder || binderfs;
}

bool SelfHealingManager::isSessionActive()
{
    QProcess proc;
    PathResolver::configureProcess(&proc, QStringList() << "status");
    proc.start();
    if (!proc.waitForFinished(1500)) {
        proc.kill();
        proc.waitForFinished(300);
        return false;
    }
    QString output = proc.readAllStandardOutput() + proc.readAllStandardError();
    return output.contains("RUNNING", Qt::CaseInsensitive) && !output.contains("STOPPED", Qt::CaseInsensitive);
}

bool SelfHealingManager::ensureSessionRunning()
{
    QString runtimeDir = QStandardPaths::writableLocation(QStandardPaths::RuntimeLocation);
    if (runtimeDir.isEmpty()) runtimeDir = "/tmp";
    QString socketPath = runtimeDir + "/wayland-linstack-0";

    // Enforce environment variables
    qputenv("WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "wayland-linstack-0");
    qputenv("LINSTACK_WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "wayland-linstack-0");
    qputenv("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR", runtimeDir.toUtf8());

    if (isSessionActive()) {
        LOG_INFO("SelfHealing", "LinStack session is already active. Launching show-full-ui on wayland-linstack-0...");

        QProcess *uiProc = new QProcess(this);
        connect(uiProc, &QProcess::readyReadStandardOutput, this, [uiProc]() {
            const QString out = QString::fromUtf8(uiProc->readAllStandardOutput()).trimmed();
            if (!out.isEmpty()) LOG_INFO("UI[STDOUT]", out);
        });
        connect(uiProc, &QProcess::readyReadStandardError, this, [uiProc]() {
            const QString err = QString::fromUtf8(uiProc->readAllStandardError()).trimmed();
            if (!err.isEmpty()) LOG_WARN("UI[STDERR]", err);
        });
        connect(uiProc, QOverload<int, QProcess::ExitStatus>::of(&QProcess::finished), this, [uiProc](int code, QProcess::ExitStatus) {
            LOG_INFO("UI", QString("linstack show-full-ui process exited with code %1").arg(code));
            uiProc->deleteLater();
        });

        QProcessEnvironment uiEnv = QProcessEnvironment::systemEnvironment();
        uiEnv.insert("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR", runtimeDir);
        uiEnv.insert("WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "wayland-linstack-0");
        uiEnv.insert("LINSTACK_WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "wayland-linstack-0");
        uiProc->setProcessEnvironment(uiEnv);
        PathResolver::configureProcess(uiProc, QStringList() << "show-full-ui");
        uiProc->start();
        return true;
    }

    // Verify embedded compositor socket exists before starting session
    int socketWaitRetries = 0;
    while (!QFile::exists(socketPath) && socketWaitRetries < 20) {
        QThread::msleep(100);
        socketWaitRetries++;
    }

    if (!QFile::exists(socketPath)) {
        LOG_WARN("SelfHealing", QString("Embedded Wayland socket %1 not found yet. Deferring session start.").arg(socketPath));
        return false;
    }
    LOG_INFO("SelfHealing", QString("Verified active embedded Wayland socket: %1. Starting session.").arg(socketPath));

    LOG_INFO("SelfHealing", "Starting LinStack session with WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-linstack-0...");
    QProcess *proc = new QProcess(this);
    connect(proc, &QProcess::readyReadStandardOutput, this, [proc]() {
        const QString out = QString::fromUtf8(proc->readAllStandardOutput()).trimmed();
        if (!out.isEmpty()) LOG_INFO("Session[STDOUT]", out);
    });
    connect(proc, &QProcess::readyReadStandardError, this, [proc]() {
        const QString err = QString::fromUtf8(proc->readAllStandardError()).trimmed();
        if (!err.isEmpty()) LOG_WARN("Session[STDERR]", err);
    });
    connect(proc, QOverload<int, QProcess::ExitStatus>::of(&QProcess::finished), this, [proc](int code, QProcess::ExitStatus) {
        LOG_INFO("Session", QString("linstack session start process exited with code %1").arg(code));
        proc->deleteLater();
    });

    QProcessEnvironment env = QProcessEnvironment::systemEnvironment();
    env.insert("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR", runtimeDir);
    env.insert("WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "wayland-linstack-0");
    env.insert("LINSTACK_WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "wayland-linstack-0");
    proc->setProcessEnvironment(env);
    PathResolver::configureProcess(proc, QStringList() << "session" << "start");
    proc->start();

    // Trigger show-full-ui after session starts
    QTimer::singleShot(2500, this, [this, runtimeDir]() {
        QProcess *uiProc = new QProcess(this);
        connect(uiProc, &QProcess::readyReadStandardOutput, this, [uiProc]() {
            const QString out = QString::fromUtf8(uiProc->readAllStandardOutput()).trimmed();
            if (!out.isEmpty()) LOG_INFO("UI[STDOUT]", out);
        });
        connect(uiProc, &QProcess::readyReadStandardError, this, [uiProc]() {
            const QString err = QString::fromUtf8(uiProc->readAllStandardError()).trimmed();
            if (!err.isEmpty()) LOG_WARN("UI[STDERR]", err);
        });
        connect(uiProc, QOverload<int, QProcess::ExitStatus>::of(&QProcess::finished), this, [uiProc](int code, QProcess::ExitStatus) {
            LOG_INFO("UI", QString("linstack show-full-ui process exited with code %1").arg(code));
            uiProc->deleteLater();
        });

        QProcessEnvironment uiEnv = QProcessEnvironment::systemEnvironment();
        uiEnv.insert("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR", runtimeDir);
        uiEnv.insert("WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "wayland-linstack-0");
        uiEnv.insert("LINSTACK_WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "wayland-linstack-0");
        uiProc->setProcessEnvironment(uiEnv);
        PathResolver::configureProcess(uiProc, QStringList() << "show-full-ui");
        uiProc->start();
    });

    return true;
}

bool SelfHealingManager::checkHealth()
{
    // Fast synchronous check
    HealthReport rep = m_engine.runDiagnosticsSync();
    if (!rep.isHealthy) {
        LOG_WARN("SelfHealing", QString("checkHealth() detected issues: %1").arg(rep.summary));
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool SelfHealingManager::promptRepair()
{
    HealthReport rep = m_engine.latestReport();
    if (rep.checks.isEmpty()) {
        rep = m_engine.runDiagnosticsSync();
    }

    RecoveryDialog dlg(nullptr);
    dlg.setReport(rep);

    connect(&dlg, &RecoveryDialog::autoHealRequested, this, [this, &dlg, &rep]() {
        dlg.setStatus("Executing auto-repair...", true);
        bool ok = executeElevatedFixes(rep);
        if (ok) {
            dlg.accept();
        } else {
            dlg.setStatus("Auto-repair failed. Review logs or continue anyway.", false);
        }
    });

    connect(&dlg, &RecoveryDialog::ignoreAndContinue, &dlg, &QDialog::accept);

    return (dlg.exec() == QDialog::Accepted);
}

bool SelfHealingManager::executeRepair()
{
    HealthReport rep = m_engine.latestReport();
    return executeElevatedFixes(rep);
}

    m_btnAutoHeal->setStyleSheet(
